locality: Habitat in foſſis hinter Monplaiſir .

locality: Habitat ad ſalinas bey Salze um die Gradirwerke herum copioſe.
additional information: Ex hac Sal alcali et artificum Soda praeparatur. Planta ſalsa, hinc a pecoribus expetita. Aceto condita eſculenta Anglis. Linn.

morphology: foliis ſuperioribus oualibus, floribus androgynis.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen Cyprena , et alibi.
additional information: Flores maſculi et feminei distincti in eadem planta.

morphology: foliis omnibus linearibus apice bifidis, flor. hermaphroditis.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen die Poleymühle .
additional information: Folia apice paullulum emarginata.

locality: H. in dumetis im Gnez ; beym Weinberge , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. LIGUSTRI Folia. In ſcorbutica dentium laxitate cum foliis gargarizationes fiunt. Vog.

morphology: ſpicis terminalibus, foliis ternis inaequaliter ſerratis.
locality: H. ad Salam in der Hinterluke ; ad Albim hinter Monplaiſir .
additional information: Spicae laxiores.

morphology: ſpicis terminalibus, foliis oppoſitis lanceolatis, ſerratis acuminatis.
locality: H. in dumetis im Gnez ; im Friedrichswerder .
additional information: Planta procera, ſpicis longis denſis.

morphology: ſpica terminali, fol. oppoſitis, crenatis, obtuſis, caule adſcendente ſimpliciſſimo.
locality: H. in ſiccis beym Zeizer Buſche ; bey Friederikenberg .

morphology: ſpicis lateralibus pedunculatis, fol. oppoſitis, caule procumbente.
locality: H. in ſyluaticis gegen Friederikenberg .
additional information: Offic. VERONICAE Herba. Vulneraria eſt externo vſu. Interne in phthiſi, tuſſi, calculo renum laudatur. Loco Theae Chinenſis vſurpari poteſt. Vog. Hoffm.

morphology: racemo terminali ſubſpicato, foliis ouatis glabris crenatis.
locality: H. in gramineis in der Lindenallee , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Flores fere albi, venis purpureis picti.

morphology: racemis lateralibus, fol. ouatis planis, caule repente.
locality: H. in foſſis bey Walternienburg ; Gödniz , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. BECCABVNGAE Herba. Conducit in obſtructionibus viſcerum. Eſt et antiſcorbuticum. Vog.

morphology: racemis lateralibus, fol. lanceolatis ſerratis, caule erecto.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen Cyprena , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: racemis lateralibus alternis, pedicellis pendulis, foliis linearibus integerrimis.
locality: H. ad paludes am Wege nach Pömelte ; auch bey Döben .
additional information: Racemi capillares, laxi, diuaricati.

morphology: racemis lateralibus longiſſimis, fol. ouatis rugoſis dentatis obtuſiuſculis, caulibus procumbentibus.
locality: H. im Buſche gegen Tochheim .
additional information: Eſt Teucrium verum Berolinenſium, cuius vſum diaeteticum Theae iubent ſubſtituere. Haller.

morphology: racemis lateralibus, fol. oblongo-ouatis ſerratis, caulibus proſtratis.
locality: H. in gramineis bey der kleinen Weidenallee ; beym Weinberge , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Calyces quinquefidi.

morphology: racemis lateralibus, fol. ouatis rugoſis dentatis ſeſſilibus, caule bifariam piloſo.
locality: H. in pomariis, pratis, vbique.
additional information: Folia loco Theae vſurpantur. Calycina foliola inaequalia lanceolata.

morphology: flor. ſolitariis, fol. cordatis inciſis pedunculo breuioribus.
locality: H. in cultis copioſe.
additional information: Calycina foliola ouata aequalia.

morphology: flor. ſolitariis, fol. cordatis inciſis pedunculo longioribus.
locality: H. in campis gegen Zeiz , et alibi.
additional information: Calycina foliola lanceolata inaequalia. Caules erecti. Corolla calyce minor.

morphology: flor. ſolitariis, fol. cordatis planis quinquelobis.
locality: H. in cultis et aruis vbique.

morphology: flor. ſolitariis, fol. digitato-partitis, pedunculis calyce longioribus.
locality: H. in agris an der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: flor. ſolitariis, fol. digitato-partitis, pedunculis calyce breuioribus.
locality: H. in ſterilibus am Damme hinter Monplaiſir ; bey Tochheim .
additional information: Caulis erectus ſtrictus.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis serratis, flor. pedunculatis.
locality: H. in pratis humidis über der Elbe gegen Gödniz , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. GRATIOLAE Herba. Aluum potenter mouet. Contra vermes prodeſt. Hydropicis in primis deſtinatur, et qui quartana febre laborant. Vog. Qualitas eximia, cauta. Linn.

morphology: tetrandra, ſpicis filiformibus paniculatis, fol. multifido-laciniatis, caule ſolitario.
locality: H. auf dem Anger an der Elbe ; in Walternienburg ad ſepes copioſe .
additional information: Offic. VERBENAE Herba. Vis adſtringens, vſu dubio. Linn. Externe in inflammationibus proſicua. Radix cucumeribus condiendis addita gratum iis conciliat ſaporem. Flores albo-ruſeſcentes.

morphology: foliis ſinuato-ſerratis.
locality: H. ad foſſas hinter Walternienburg , et alibi.
additional information: Succus nigricante colore quaeuis adeo pertinaciter inficit, vt elui nequeat. Linn. Exſiccatur ſcilicet planta et cum vitriolo coquitur, ſicque colore nigro telae linteae aliaque tinguntur. Etiam errones, Aegyptios ſeſe dicentes, faciem hoc ſucco inficere perhibentur.

morphology: fol. cordato-lanceolatis vndulatis biſerratis maculatis acutis, bracteis coloratis flore breuioribus.
locality: H. ad marginem ſyluae über der Elbe , dem Schloſſe gegen über, rarius.

morphology: fol. cordato-oblongis crenatis, ſummis amplexicaulibus, verticillis ſubnudis, corollis galea glutinoſis.
locality: H. ad margines agrorum bey der kleinen Weidenallee ; hinter Monplaiſir am Damme , frequens.
additional information: Offic. HORMINI Folia, Semen. Flatus diſſipat: fluorem album ſiſtit. Semen ſuauiſſimum odorem ſpirat. Cum melle argemas et albugines oculorum purgat. Vog.

morphology: caule erecto, racemis pluribus, foliis ouatis.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche ; im Walde über der Elbe , copioſe.
additional information: In haemorrhoidibus externe in forma cataplasmatis, interne in infuſo prodeſſe poſſe dicitur.

morphology: ſpica oblonga ouata, floſculis ſubpedunculatis ariſta longioribus.
locality: H. auf dem Anger ; am Zeizer Buſche , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Odorem gratum foeno conciliat, et ab equis, bobus et ouibus libenter comeditur. Schreber.

morphology: flor. triandris dioicis, fol. pinnatis integerrimis.
locality: H. in humidis hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle .

morphology: flor. triandris, fol. omnibus pinnatis.
locality: H. ad foſſas beym Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. VALERIANE MINORIS Radix. Vſus hodie in viſu acuendo et nebulis oculo obuerſantibus diſpellendis frequentiſſimus. Vog. Neruinum eſt egregium. Odor radicis vernalis felibus gratiſſimus.

morphology: flor. triandris, caule dichotomo, fol. linearibus. Locuſta olitoria, fructu ſimplici.
locality: H. in campis frequens, et colitur in hortis .
additional information: Folia in acetariis hiberno tempore adhibentur. Succus prodeſt contra calculum renum. Hypochondriacorum ſummum eſt ſolamen. Boerh.

morphology: corollis imberbibus, petalis interioribus ſtigmate minoribus, fol. enſiformibus.
locality: H. in foſſis vbique .
additional information: Offic. ACORI PALVSTRIS Radix. Radix adſtringit. In puluere ſumta ventriculi flacciditatem emendat. Vog.

morphology: corollis imberbibus, germinibus trigonis, caule tereti, fol. linearibus.
locality: H. in pratis von Kleinroſenburg nach Aken hin.
H. in campis gegen Zeiz ; auch daſelbſt auf der alten Schanze .

morphology: culmo ſubtriquetro folioſo, flor. faſciculatis, fol. ſetaceis.
locality: H. in paludibus turfoſis an der Nuthe gegen die Poleymühle .

morphology: culmo triquetro nudo, vmbella triphylla, pedunculis ſimplicibus inaequalibus, ſpicis confertis lanceolatis.
locality: H. in paludibus gegen die Poleymühle .

morphology: culmo triquetro nudo, vmbella trifida, pedunculis ſimplicibus inaequalibus, ſpicis confertis linearibus.
locality: H. ad paludes am Wege nach Pömelte ; auch am Graben den Anger hinunter .

morphology: culmo tereti nudo, ſpica ſubouata, terminali.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen den Weinberg , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Recens ſuibus eſt pabulum gratiſſimum.

morphology: culmo ſtriato nudo, ſpica biualui terminali longitudine calycis, radicibus ſquamula interſtinctis.
locality: H. in depreſſis turfoſis unten bey der Lindenallee , et alibi.
additional information: Culmus leuiter ſtriatus. Spica parua, ſaepe vnius tantum lineae. Inter radiculas inſident radicibus corpuſcula parua nigra ouata petiolata.

morphology: culmo tereti nudo ſetiformi, ſpica ouata biualui, ſeminibus nudis.
locality: H. in inundatis am Graben gegen Cyprena ; auch über der Elbe in der Allee .

morphology: culmo tereti nudo, ſpicis ouatis pluribus pedunculatis terminalibus.
locality: H. in paludibus am Wege nach Pömelte , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Et hic ſcirpus a ſuibus comeditur. Ad tuguria tegenda, ad ſellas plectendas adhibetur.

morphology: culmo tereti nudo, ſpicis ſubgloboſis glomeratis pedunculatis, inuolucro diphyllo inaequali mucronato.
locality: H. in arenoſis in vnico loco bald hinter Walternienburg am Wege nach Zerbſt .

morphology: culmo triquetro, panicula conglobata foliacea, ſpicularum ſquamis trifidis; intermedia ſubulata. | Varietas minor ſpiculis omnibus ſubſeſſilibus offenditur
locality: H. in foſſis bey Cyprena , et alibi, frequens. | in humidiuſculis bey Döben am Wege nach Calbe .

morphology: culmo triquetro folioſo, vmbella foliacea, pedunculis nudis ſupradecompoſitis, ſpicis confertis.
locality: H. in alnetis bey Walternienburg ; Gödniz , et alibi.
additional information: Ab equis comeditur; non a ſuibus.

morphology: culmis teretibus, fol. planis, ſpicis pedunculatis.
locality: H. in humidis gegen die Poleymühle ; auch gegen Badez , et alibi.
additional information: Puluinaria pauperum ex pappo. Pappus etiam laudatur in vulneribus recentibus et ambuſtis.

morphology: ſpica ſetacea recta ſecunda.
locality: H. in aggeribus ad viam bey der Windmühle zwiſchen Bazez und Sachſendorf .
additional information: Foenimeſſoribus inuiſum gramen, cum falcem obtundat. Euellitur ſaepe a cornicibus ob laruas Tipularum radices depaſcentium. Linn.

morphology: ſpica verticillata, racemulis quaternis, inuolucellis vnifloris biſetis, culmis diffuſis.
locality: H. in hortis inter olera frequens .
additional information: Inuolucella ſpinulis retro ſpectantibus hiſpida: hinc veſtibus facile adhaerent.

morphology: ſpica tereti, inuolucellis bifloris faſciculato-piloſis, ſeminibus neruoſis.
locality: H. in campis gegen den Zeizer Buſch , et alibi.
additional information: Simillimum praecedenti: ſed molle eſt, nec aſperum, digitis ſurſum ductis. Inuolucella ſaepe purpurea.

morphology: ſpica teretis inuolucellis bifloris faſciculato-piloſis, feminibus vndulato-rugoſis.
locality: H. in campis poſt meſſem vbique .
additional information: Pedunculus valde ſulcatus. Inuolucella, vbi ſpica matura eſt, ſemper lutea ſunt ſ. fulua, et ſemina maiora, quam praecedentium.

morphology: ſpicis alternis Coniugatisque, ſpiculis ſubdiuiſis, glumis ariſtatis hiſpidis, rachi quinquangulari.
locality: H. ad foſſas paſſim ; auch am Elbdamme , und im Sande an der Elbe .
additional information: Spicae in ſolo ſicciori magis muticae; in humidiori magis longiusque ariſtatae eſſe ſolent.

morphology: ſpicis digitatis baſi interiore nodoſis, floſc. geminis muticis, vaginis foliorum punctatis. Digitaria foliis ſubhirſutis, caule debili, ſpicis verticillatis, ſcapo ancipiti. Hall. Helv. n. 1526.
locality: H. varietas vaginis foliorum piloſis, inter olera im Herzogsgarten ; varietas vaginis foliorum glabris, in arenoſis ſterilibus hinter Walternienburg am Wege nach Zerbſt .
additional information: Gramen dactylon eſculentum Bauhini a priori tantum cultura differt.

morphology: culmo ſpicato erecto, glumis villoſis.
locality: H. in pratis et verſuris vbique.
additional information: Inter gramina praeſtantiora referendus, ideoque colendus.

morphology: culmo ſpicato infracto.
locality: H. ad ſcrobes et ſoſſas frequens .
additional information: In lacubus natans eſt . Linn.

morphology: ſpica cylindrica longiſſima ciliata, culmo erecto.
locality: H. in pratis frequens .

morphology: panicula oblonga ventricoſa ampla.
locality: H. ad Albim et ad foſſas copioſe .
additional information: Inſeruire poteſt tectis ruſticorum. Etiam a pecoribus comeditur. Varietas folio variegato in horto botanico iam ſpontanea.

morphology: petalo exteriore ariſta recta ſtricta longiſſima, panicula patula.
locality: H. in agris et verſuris frequens .
additional information: Vitium agrorum. Ab ouibus non comeditur.

morphology: panicula capillari patente, calyc. ſubulatis aequalibus hiſpidiuſculis coloratis, floſculis muticis.
locality: H. in verſuris, pomariis, pratis , copioſe.

morphology: panicula laxa, calyc. muticis aequalibus, culmo repente.
locality: H. ad margines foſſarum hinter Cyprena .

morphology: panicula ſecunda glomerata.
locality: H. in gramineis in der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Gramen durum. A canibus comeditur pro vomitu excitando. Calyx 4-florus.

morphology: ariſtis lanatis.
locality: H. in aridis rechter Hand bey Friederikenberg .

morphology: ariſtis nudis rectis, calyc. ſemine longioribus, fol. intus laeuibus.
locality: H. ad vias bey Zeiz ; auf dem Mukrener Berge , et alibi.

morphology: foliis planis, panicula patente, petalis baſi villoſis ariſtatisque; ariſta recta breui.
locality: H. in pratis hinter Monplaiſir ; im Gnez ; im Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Prata reddit inaequalia: ſed gramen eſt praeſtans. Schreb.

morphology: foliis ſetaceis, culmis ſubnudis, panicula diuaricata, pedunculis flexuoſis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme .
additional information: Vterque floſculus gaudet ariſta tortili longitudine floris, petalorum baſi externe inſerta.

morphology: fol. ſetaceis; ſummo ſpathaceo paniculam inferne obuoluente.
locality: H. in ſterilibus gegen Monplaiſir ; in editis arenoſis trans Albim , copioſe.
additional information: Panicula deflorata longius e vagina exit. Gramen colore pallido ab aliis diſtinguitur. A pecoribus vix comeditur. Ariſta baſi glumae inſerta, longitudine calycis, in medio quaſi coronata denticulis minutis; infra coronulam fuſca, superius pallidior, clauata.

morphology: petalis imberbibus, panicula nutante ſimplici.
locality: H. in editis gegen Friederikenberg .

morphology: panicula coarctata, floribus cylindricis. Mant. 2. p. 325. Aira caerulea. Sp. Pl. p. 95.
locality: H. im Buſche über der Elbe ; im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt .
additional information: Ob pedicellum apice capitatum inter floſculos exſurgentem ad Melicas relata. Pabulum a pecoribus expetitum.

morphology: ſpiculis ouatis, calyce floſculis breuiore.
locality: H. beym Zeizer Buſche , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Locuſtae ſemper tremulae.

morphology: panicula diffuſa, ſpiculis ſexfloris linearibus.
locality: H. in foſſis bey Cyprena , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Floſculi 5-10. Culmus ſaepe ſexpedalis. Inter gramina in aquis creſcentia, cum a pecoribus libenter comedatur, vtiliſſimum. Schreb.

morphology: panicula diffuſa, ſpiculis trifloris baſi pubeſcentibus, culmo erecto tereti.
locality: H. in pratis; ad vias vbique .
additional information: Floſculi apice colorati, magis flaui, quam in reliquis. Spiculae ſaepius biflorae. Hoc gramen et duo ſequentia ſunt vulgatiſſima, et praeſtans pecoris pabulum.

morphology: panicula diffuſa, ſpiculis quadrifloris pubeſcentibus, culmo erecto tereti.
locality: H. in hortis, pratis , frequens.
additional information: Antherae flauae. Panicula oblonga, conferta, ut fere imbricata conſpiciatur.

morphology: panicula diffuſa, ſpiculis quinquefloris glabris, culmo erecto tereti.
locality: H. in pratis vbique .
additional information: Antherae caeruleſcentes. Numerus floſculorum variat.

morphology: panicula diffuſa angulis rectis, ſpiculis obtuſis, culmo obliquo compreſſo.
locality: H. in hortis et ad vias .
additional information: Ramuli bini ex eodem loco. Spiculae floſculis tribus, quatuor aut quinque. Pabulum bonum.

morphology: panicula coarctata ſecunda, culmo obliquo compreſſo.
locality: H. in muris im Schloßgarten ; im Paradiſe , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Spiculis diſtichis ſexfloris.

morphology: panicula attenuata, ſpiculis ſubbifloris mucronatis ſcabris, culmo incuruo.
locality: H. im Gnez ; im Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Ramuli bini vel plures erecti. Spiculae bini vel triflorae; graciliores, quam congenerum. Gramen tenerum, procerum.

morphology: panicula ſecunda patentiuſcula, ſpiculis quadrifloris.
locality: H. in aridis am Damme gegen Monplaiſir .
additional information: Culmi baſi tuberoſa. Egregium pabulum ouium. Gled.

morphology: panicula ſpicata, calyc. ſubpiloſis ſubquadrifloris pedunculo longioribus, petalis ariſtatis. Aira criſtata. Sp. Pl. p. 94.
locality: H. auf dem Anger gegen Monplaiſir copioſe.
additional information: Antherae purpureae. Variat ſpiculis villoſis et glabris. Vix a pecolibus comeditur.

morphology: panicula ſecunda coarctata ariſtata, culmo tetragono nudiuſculo, fol. ſetaceis.
locality: H. in verſuris aridis hinter Colphus ; in der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi.
additional information: Spiculae floſculis quatuor aut quinque. Hoc gramen primarium eſt pabulum ouibus. Linn.

morphology: panicula ſecunda ſcabra, ſpiculis sexfloris ariſtatis: floſculo vltimo mutico, culmo ſemitereti.
locality: H. auf dem Elbdamme bey der Gurgel , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: F. ouinae ſimilis, ſed maior, foliis latioribus. Culmus intra paniculam ſcaber. Color maturitatis ruber. Etiam haec ouibus praebet pabulum gratum. Schreb.

morphology: panicula ſecunda oblonga, ſpic. oblongis laeuibus, fol. ſetaceis.
locality: H. in muris horti in Zeiz , et alibi.
additional information: Locuſtae floſculis 4-7. Ramuli ſolitarii remoti breues. ** Panicula aequali.

morphology: panicula ſecunda erecta, ſpiculis ſub-ariſtatis; exterioribus teretibus.
locality: H. in gramineis in den Alleen ; im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Ariſtae breuiſſimae. Locuſtae flosculis 6-8. Pabulum praeſtantiſſimum. Linn.

morphology: panicula ramoſa erecta, ſpiculis ſubſeſſilibus teretibus muticis.
locality: H. in foſſis vbique .
additional information: Semina, Grana Mannae dicta, vſibus menſarum inſeruiunt. Colliguntur in primis in Polonia, Pruſſia, Marchia, vnde ad nos exportantur.

morphology: panicula patente, ſpic. ouatis; ariſtis rectis, ſem. diſtinctis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes frequens .
additional information: Segeti immixtus panem amarum et ingratum reddit. Tingit colore viridi. Linn.

morphology: panicula erectiuſcula, ſpicis ouatis pubeſcentibus; ariſtis rectis, fol. molliſſime villoſis.
locality: H. in gramineis in der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Similis B. ſecalino: ſed albido-pubeſcens, geniculis craſſioribus ſubtus valde hirſutis. Vaginae ſtriatae. Panicula breuius pedicellata. Spiculae plerumque ſeptem-florae. Citius matureſcit, quam congeneres.

morphology: panicula patula, ſpic. oblongis diſtichis, glumis ſubulato-ariſtatis.
locality: H. ad ſepes im Schloßgarten bey der Brücke , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: panicula erecta, ſpiculis ſubteretibus ſubulatis nudis submuticis. Mant. 2. p. 186.
locality: H. am Elbdamme beym Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Locuſtae viridi-ſpadiceae, modo ariſtatae modo muticae; ſpiculis ſaepe nouem. Planta reptatrix, vt triticum repens. Schreb.

morphology: panicula nutante, ſpiculis ouato-oblongis.
locality: H. ad margines agrorum am Wege nach Werkleiz ; am Elbdamme , et alibi.
additional information: Folia pagina ſuperiore pubeſcentia pilis albidis. Spiculae ſupra griſeae, ſubtus virides, decemflorae.

morphology: panicula nutante, ſpic. linearibus.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe und im Schloßgarten ; auch im trockenen Sande hinter Monplaiſir .

morphology: panicula nutante, ſpic. quadrifloris; ariſtis breuioribus.
locality: H. im Walde über der Elbe ; auch im Gnez , und an den Zäunen bey Gethſemane .
additional information: Panicula valde laxa. Pedunculi bini, longo ſpatio nudi. Folia latitudine digiti.

morphology: culmo indiuiſo, ſpic. alternis ſubſeſſilibus teretibus ſubariſtatis.
locality: H. im Gnez ; im Zeizer Buſche ; frequens.

morphology: paniculata, calyc. bifloris, floſc. hermaphrodito ſubmutico, maſculo ariſtato.
locality: H. in gramineis fertilibus am Elbdamme ; in der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: In Gallia, vt pabulum praeſtans, ſub nomine Raygraſs colitur, et prae Lolio perenni culturam meretur.

morphology: paniculata, calyc. trifloris, floſc. omnibus ariſtatis baſique piloſis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes copioſe.
additional information: Vitium agrorum.

morphology: ſubſpicata, calyc. ſubtrifloris baſi piloſis, foliis planis pubeſcentibus. Spec. Pl. p. 1665.
locality: H. in aggeribus ſiccis am Wege gegen den Weinberg , et alibi.
additional information: Panicula coarctata in ſpicam; ramuli tamen ſatis longi, qui tempore floreſcendi diſtenduntur. Spiculae teretes, minores quam in congeneribus, triflorae, quadriflorae. Floſculi baſi, etiam diſco, piloſi. Ariſtae mediocres, longitudine fere ſpicularum. Folia pagina ſuperiori pilis albis molliſſimis obſita. Pabulum pecoribus bonum.

morphology: panicula laxa, calyc. trifloris breuibus, floſc. omnibus ariſtatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi paſſim.

morphology: ſubſpicata, calyc. quinquefloris.
locality: H. in ſiccis auf dem Anger beym Zeizer Buſche , et alibi.
additional information: Ariſtae longae nigrae.

morphology: calyc. quinquefloris, panicula laxa.
locality: H. in foſſis et ſtagnis vbique.
additional information: Culmis vtuntur gypſarii ad tecta incruſtanda. Pecoribus nocet. Schreb.

morphology: calyc. vnifloris, panicula erecta, foliis ſubtus glabris.
locality: H. am Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Corollae ariſtatae.

morphology: calyc. vnifloris, laeuibus, corollis lanuginoſis, culmo ramoſo.
locality: H. im Kuhwerder bey der Elbe .

morphology: calyc. vnifloris, ſol. inuolutis mucronato-pungentibus.
locality: H. in arenoſis gleich beym Schloſſe Friederikenberg .
additional information: Huc adlata planta, vt ferunt, ex Ieueria, iam permanet: caeteroquin in noſtris regionibus nondum viſa. Ad arenam mobilem coërcendam facit.

morphology: calyc. quadrifloris fubulatis acuminatis, fol. planis.
locality: H. in agris, hortis, verſuris vbique .
additional information: Offic. GRAMINIS Radix. Virtute ſaponacea gaudet, qua in glandulis et viſceribus obſtructis reſerandis praeſtantiſſima. Vog. Agricolis inuiſum.

morphology: floſculis lateralibus maſculis ariſtatis, inuolucris intermediis ciliatis. | Varietas β. Gramen ſpicatum ſecalinum minus. Vaill. pariſ. 83.
locality: H. α. auf dem Schloßhofe ; ad vias et ſepes frequens ; β. in verſuris gegen den Weinberg , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Varietas β. duplo anguſtior, altior, erectior et magis fuſca.

morphology: ſpica nutante arcta, ſpiculis rectis inuolucro deſtitutis; infimis geminis.
locality: H. inter virgulta beym erſten Teiche in der Lindenallee ; ad ſepes paſſim .
additional information: Multum ſimilis Tritico repenti: ſed radix fibroſa, nec repens vaginoſa, vt in illo. Locuſtae ariſtatae, ariſtis ſpicula ſua multo longioribus.

locality: H. ad vias, verſuras vbique .
additional information: Multum aliquot abhinc annis, vt pabulum praeſtans, in ſcriptis oeconomorum commendatum eſt: ſed eſt durum et humile, nec a pecoribus libenter comeditur, niſi ab equis.

morphology: ſpica ariſtata, ſpiculis compreſſis multifloris.
locality: H. in agris inter ſegetes frequens .
additional information: Vitium hordei in primis: nam aſſumtum in cereuiſia temulentos facit homines et caput tentat. Mitius in pane. Linn.

morphology: bracteis pinnatifidis.
locality: H. ad vias gegen den Weinberg , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Ab ouibus libenter comeditur. Schreb.

morphology: floribus vmbellatis.
locality: H. ad vias im Schloßgarten , et alibi, frequens.
H. in riuulis ex editis arenoſis defluentibus unterhalb Gödniz .

morphology: foliis ſeſſilibus ſerratis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi in aggeribus et ad vias , copioſe.
additional information: Varietas huius eſſe creditur Dipſacus ſatiuus, qui eſt paleis recuruatis: hoc vtuntur fullones ad tibialia aliaque praeparanda.

morphology: foliis petiolatis appendicularis.
locality: H. am Damme gegen Walternienburg , et alibi, frequens.
H. in ſubhumidis gegen Friederikenberg paſſim.
additional information: Offic. MORSVS DIABOLI Radix; Herba. Radicis virtus traumatica. Ad gargariſmos, in primis in anginis, et ad cataplasmata uſurpatur. Vog. Folia tingunt lanas viridi colore. Linn.

morphology: corollulis quadrifidis radiantibus fol. pinnatifidis inciſis, caule hiſpido.
locality: H. ad margines agrorum um Colphus ; um Gnadau , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. SCABIOSAE Radix, Flores. In pectoris morbis enixe laudata a Boerhaauio. Qualitas debilis. Linn.

morphology: corollulis quinquefidis radiantibus, fol. radicalibus ouatis crenatis, caulinis pinnatis ſetaceis.
locality: H. in aridis editis hinter Tochheim ; auch auf trockenen Reinen hinter Gnadau .

morphology: corollulis quinquefidis radiantibus, foliis bipinnatis linearibus.
locality: H. in verſuris ſiccis gegen Zeiz und um Gnadau und Döben , frequens.

vernacular name: Wegebreit mit glatten Blättern; breiter Wegerich.
morphology: fol. ouatis glabris, ſcapo tereti, ſpica floſculis imbricatis.
locality: H. in hortis, ad vias vbique .
additional information: Offic. PLANTAGINIS Radix, Herba, Semina. Contra tabem vtiliter datur vel ſuccus vel decoctum. Vlcera ſanat qualiacumque, Semina in Dyſenteria laudantur. Vog.

morphology: fol. ouato-lanceolatis pubeſcentibus, ſpica cylindrica, ſcapo tereti.
locality: H. in ambulacris hortorum, ad vias , vbique.
additional information: Antherae violaceae. Semina auiculis gratum pabulum.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis, ſpica ſubouata nuda, ſcapo angulato.
locality: H. ad vias, agros , copioſe.
additional information: Radix praemorſa eſt. Succus foliorum in recentibus vulneribus prodeſt. Caeterum eaedem vires, ac P. maioris.

morphology: fol. ſemicylindraceis integerrimis baſi lanatis, ſcapo tereti.
locality: H. in ſabulosis im Kuhwerder , auch bey Döben auf dem Anger .
additional information: Antherae luteae. Folia baſi parum lanata in noſtris inuenta.

morphology: fol. linearibus dentatis, ſcapo tereti.
locality: H. in arenoſis humidis bey Döben .
additional information: Spica ante floreſcentiam nutans.

morphology: caule ramoſo herbaceo, fol. ſub-dentatis recuruatis, capitulis aphyllis.
locality: H. in arenoſis hinter Monplaiſir copioſe.
additional information: Offic. PSYLLII Semen. Mucilago ex ſeminibus aqua calida extracta lubricat et conſolidat: vnde in fiſſuris papillarum, ad ambuſta et ardores oculorum confert illita. Vog. Caules diffuſi villoſi; folia viſcida.

locality: H. in pratis über der Elbe hinter Grünberg frequens.
additional information: Offic. PIMPINELLAE ITALICAE Radix. Radix vulneraria et tonica. Ad dyſenteriam et pulmonum vlcera laudatur. Pecori pabulum gratum et ſalutare praebet.

morphology: fol. quaternis obouatis inaequalibus, caulibus diffuſis.
locality: H. ad foſſas am Gnez et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: fol. ſenis lanceolatis retrorſum, ſerrato-aculeatis mucronatis rigidis, corollis fructu maioribus.
locality: H. in turfoſis an der Nuthe gegen die Poleymühle ; auf Ranies , et alibi.
additional information: Pericarpia glabra.

morphology: fol. ſenis lanceolatis carinatis ſcabris retrorſum aculeatis, geniculis ſimplicibus, fructibus glabris.
locality: H. in campis gegen die Windmühlen , et alibi.
additional information: Affine G. Aparines, ſed minus. Spec. Pl. p. 154. In agris montoſis et aſperis vbique occurrit ſeminibus minus aſperis maioribus et teſticulatis, ſupinum et per terram ſtratum; inquit Ruppius Ien. p. 5. Notandum tamen, eandem plantam modo fructibus glabris, modo hiſpidis apparere.

vernacular name: Gelbes Meyerkraut; Labkraut; unſerer Frauen Bettſtroh.
morphology: fol. octonis linearibus ſulcatis, ramis floriferis breuibus.
locality: H. ad vias et verſuras vbique .
additional information: Offic. GALLII LVTEI Herba. Antherae defloratae fiunt fuſcae. Comae coagulo miſcentur pro caſeis conficiendis. Epilepticis et Hyſtericis in Gallia praeſcribitur. Linn.

morphology: fol. octonis ouato-linearibus ſubſerratis patentiſſimis mucronatis, caule flaccido, ramis patentibus.
locality: H. ad verſuras am Wege gegen den Weinberg , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Caulis anguloſus glaber. Flores albi.

morphology: fol. quaternis lanceolatis trineruiis glabris, caule erecto, fem. hiſpidis.
locality: H. in pratis , wo man nach Kleinroſenburg geht.
additional information: Radicibus lanae tinguntur rubrae.

morphology: fol. octonis lanceolatis, carinis ſcabris retrorſum aculeatis, geniculis villoſis, fruct. hiſpidis.
locality: H. in ſepibus , cultis, frequens.
additional information: Ad diſcutiendas ſtrumas cum axungia tritam laudant. Vog.

morphology: fol. octonis lanceolatis, florum faſciculis pedunculatis.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche , rarius.
additional information: Offic. MATRISYLVAE Herba. Odor ſuaueolens. Pellit inſecta et acaros. Linn. Vrinam mouet, et expellit exanthemata. Vog. Cereuiſiae et vino ſaporem gratum conciliat. Flos tubuloſus: semina lappacea.

morphology: fol. ſenis, flor. ſeſſilibus terminalibus aggregatis.
locality: H. in campis vbique.
additional information: Folia floralia ciliata, ſupra hiſpida. Fructus glabri.

locality: H. im Buſche bey Breitenhagen .
additional information: Semina laeuia: flos albus: caulis tripedalis. Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 8. Radices ad lanas rubro colore, inficiendas adhibentur. Linn.

morphology: fol. quaternis ellipticis eneruiis laeuiuſculis, pedunc. diuaricatis trichotomis, ſem. ſcabris. Galium rotundifolium. Sp. Pl. 156. Aſperula rotundifolia. Mant. p. 330.
locality: H. vltra term. Fl. Barb. in syluis bey Nödliz .

morphology: fol. omnibus verticillatis, floribus terminalibus.
locality: H. in verſuris bey Gnadau ; in editis bey Tochheim , frequens.

morphology: arborea, vmbellis inuolucrum aequantibus.
locality: H. in ſepibus im Schloßgarten und in Gnadau .
additional information: Drupa eſculenta, roborans. Loeſecke. Frutex ad ſepes et opera topiaria.

morphology: arborea, cymis nudis, ramis rectis.
locality: H. im Gnez et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Lignum duriſſimum tornatoribus acceptum.

morphology: foliis lobatis.
locality: H. iam ſpontanea in horto botanico: ſed in pratis noſtris nondum adhuc inuenta.
additional information: Offic. ALCHEMILLAE Radix, Herba. Traumatica eſt interno et externo vſu. Vog. Folia amaricantia et adſtringentia vſu frequentiore digna videntur. Gled.

morphology: floribus ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. Var. α. am Elbdamme , et alibi in ſepibus et inter linum ; Var. β. Epithymum ſ. Cuſcuta minor, in aridis inter Serpyllum am Wege beym Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Offic. CVSCVTAE Herba; item EPITHYMI Herba. Planta paraſitica absque omni radice contra ſolem volubilis adſcendit plantas, quas emiſſis vaſis exhaurit. Amaroris adſtrictionisque particeps in decocto ventriculum et alia viſcera roborare dicitur. Vog. Dubia. Linn.

locality: H. in campis gegen Zeiz et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Percepier Anglorum. Eſt aperiens, vrinam excitat: menſtrua retenta prouocat. Boerh. Variat piſtillo vnico.

morphology: ramis procumbentibus.
locality: H. auf dem Anger , frequens.
additional information: Variat floribus corollatis et apetalis.

morphology: fol. oblongo-ouatis petiolatis natantibus.
locality: H. in ſtagnis am Wege nach Pömelte , et alibi frequens.
additional information: Aquas piſcibus acceptas reddit. Linn.

morphology: fol. cordatis amplexicaulibus.
locality: H. in ſtagnis bey Dornburg .

morphology: fol. lanceolatis planis in petiolos deſinentibus.
locality: H. ſub aqua am Graben von Colphus nach Cyprena copioſe.
additional information: Folia venis reticulata, ſtriis obliquis decuſſata, pellucida.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis alternis oppoſitisue, vndulatis ſerratis.
locality: H. im Teiche bey Colphus , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: fol. ſetaceis parallelis approximatis diſtichis.
locality: H. in foſſis et paludibus gegen Cyprena ; auch beym Ausfluß der Nuthe in die Elbe .

morphology: fol. linearibus oppoſitis alternisque diſtinctis baſi patentibus, caule tereti.
locality: H. in paludibus gegen Cyprena , et alibi.
additional information: Potamogeton minimum capillaceo folio. Bauh. prodr. 101. Caulis capillaceus et folia capillacea: planta tamen notabilis longitudinis.

morphology: caule tuberculato hiſpido, fol. caulinis lanceolatis hiſpidis, flor. ſpicatis lateralibus.
locality: H. in hortis, campis, verſuris, vbique .
additional information: Flores apibus gratiſſimi ſunt.

morphology: ſem. laeuibus, coroll. vix calycem ſuperantibus, fol. lanceolatis,
locality: H. ad dumeta zwiſchen Klein- und Großroſenburg , rarius. Auch bey Kloſter Lütſchen, (Liezke;) Rupp. Ien. p. II.
additional information: Offic. LITHOSPERMI f. Milii ſolis ſemen; ſed fruſtra. Linn. Vog.

morphology: ſem. rugoſis, cor. vix calycem ſuperantibus.
locality: H. in cultis vbique .
additional information: Radix recens cutem tingit colore rubro.

morphology: fol. ouato-lanceolatis decurrentibus.
locality: H. am Elbdamme hinunter frequens. Copioſiſſime in ſaliceto unter dem Kuhwerder , vbi varietas flore purpureo vulgaris.
additional information: Offic. CONSOLIDAE MAIORIS Radix, Herba, Flores. Mucilaginosa, glutinans primaria, antihaemoptica radix. Linn.

morphology: fol. integerrimis caule erecto, cal. fructeſcentibus inflatis pendulis.
locality: H. ad margines agrorum an der Pfingſtwieſe bey Gnadau , et alibi.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis hiſpidis, calyc. floreſcentibus erectis.
locality: H. in agris an der Lindenallee , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Planta tota hiſpida.

morphology: calyc. fructus compreſſis.
locality: H. ad muros auf dem Schloßhofe ; in der Lindenallee , et alibi.

morphology: ſtaminibus corolla breuioribus, fol. lato-lanceolatis tomentoſis seſſilibus.
locality: H. am Elbdamme ; ſonderlich hinter Monplaiſir in arenoſis , copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. CYNOGLOSSAE Radix, Herba. Odor plantae virulentus. Internus vſus ſuſpectus. Externe in cataplaſmate ad ambuſta vſurpatur. Vog. Non editur a pecoribus, niſi forte a capris.

morphology: foliis lanceolatis, ſpicis imbricatis ſecundis.
locality: H. in ruderatis über der Elbe unter dem Wirthshauſe; hinter Monplaiſir beym alten Dammbruche ; copioſe.
additional information: Offic. BUGLOSSI Radix, Herba. Corollae primo die rubrae, dein violaceae. Herba tenera primo vere cum olere coquitur. Succus eius cum magno ſucceſſu in Pleuritide datur. Boerh. Superflua. Linn.

morphology: ſeminibus laeuibus, foliorum apicibus calloſis. α. Aruenſis, foliis hirſutis. ß. Paluſtris, foliis glabris.
locality: H. α. in agris, ß. ad fossas , frequens.
additional information: Aruenſis contuſa oculis inflammatis inter duplicatum linteum applicata egregie ſuccurrit. Vog.

morphology: ſemin. aculeis glochidibus, fol. lanceolatis piloſis.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe , et alibi, rarius.

morphology: foliis indiuiſis, caule procumbente. α. Flore phoeniceo. ß. Flore coeruleo.
locality: H. α. in hortis et campis vbique; ß. in agris bey Zens frequens.
additional information: Offic. ANAGALLIDIS Herba. Euigilat hora 8, obdormit poſt meridiem. Contra Maniam et morſum canis rabidi laudatur. Boerh. In hunc vſum nuper denuo valde commendata eſt in ſcriptis periodicis. Sed Scopoli Flor. Carniol. plantulae huius tantopere praedicatas vires vix credit.

morphology: paniculata, racemis terminalibus.
locality: H. am Elbdamme ; im Kuhwerder , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Nulla eſt medica virtute. Boerh.

morphology: racemis lateralibus pedunculatis.
locality: H. ad fossas hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle .
additional information: Corolla partita ad baſin vsque, interiectis dentibus breuiſſimis, apicibus petali fuluo-punctatis. Flores ſaepius sexfariam diuiſi.

morphology: fol. ſubcordatis, flor. ſolitariis, caule repente.
locality: H. ad fossas beym Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. NUMMVLARIA Herba. Vulneraria eſt interno vſu et externo, et fluxus ſanguinis varios coërcet. Vog.

morphology: H. varietas officinalis, limbo corollarum concauo, beym
locality: Weinberge ; an der Böſener Mark , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. PRIMVLAE VERIS Radix, Herba, Flores. Radix ſuaueolens. Floribus impraegnatur vinum. Herba oleracea in acetariis. Ad cephalalgiam vertiginemque flores in infuſo adhibentur.

morphology: fol. ſubdentatis, pedicellis longiſſimis, corollis calyce breuioribus. Spec. Pl. App. p. 1668.
locality: H. in arenoſis hinter Monplaiſir am Damme, gegen den treugen Buſch .
additional information: Altitudo totius plantae duarum vnciarum et vltra. Folia radicalia conferta ouato-oblonga, parum dentata. Caulis nudus pilis breuiſſimis rigidis, vt tota planta, veſtitus. Vmbella pedicellis 5-12, longitudine fere ipſius ſcapi. Inuolucrum vmbellae polyphyllum, foliolis oblongis acutis. Flores albi.

morphology: pedunculis verticillato-multifloris.
locality: H. in foſſis über der Elbe bey der Nuthe nach Flöz hin, et alibi.
additional information: Herba ſub aqua occultatur; florum ſpica emergit. Capſula ſphaerica: ſemina anguloſa.

locality: H. in pratis vliginoſis gegen die Poleymühle copioſe.
additional information: Offic. TRIFOLII FIMBRINI ſ. AQVATICI Herba. Vermes necat puluis cum infuſo. Radix premente annona pani ſuccedit. Planta caeterum in multis morbis, in primis chronicis, praeſtantiſſima.

morphology: fol. ſagittatis vtrimque acutis, pedunculis ſubunifloris.
locality: H. in cultis et agris vbique.
additional information: Vitium agrorum. Corolla rubro et albo colore variat.

morphology: fol. ſagittatis poſtice truncatis, pedunculis tetragonis vnifloris.
locality: H. am Graben im Schloßgarten ; in dumetis et ſepibus paſſim.
additional information: Foliorum margo fuſcus.

morphology: pericarpiis ſpinoſis, erectis ouatis, fol. ouatis glabris.
locality: H. in ruderatis am Elbdamme ; bey Walternienburg , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. DATVRAE Semina. Semen externe narcotico ſcopo commendari ſolet. Interne necat, niſi antidoto, quale acetum eſt, ſuccurratur tempeſtiue, Vog.

morphology: fol. amplexicalilibus ſinuatis, flor. ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. in ruderatis vbique .
additional information: Offic. HYOSCYAMI Radix, Herba, Semina. Inſigne narcoticum. Folia per ſe vel laste ſubacta omnes dolores mitigant impoſita. Mures pelluntur proiectis per domum radicibus. Radix et ſemina venena ſunt.

morphology: fol. decurrentibus vtrimque tomentoſis, caule ſimplici.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. VERBASCI Herba, Flores. Folia contuſa ſanant recentia vulnera. Decoctum lenit Tenesmum. Radicis decoctum in tuſſi prodeſt.

morphology: fol. ouatis vtrimque tomentoſis; inferioribus petiolatis.
locality: H. in aſperis am ſteilen Elbufer oberhalb Tochheim .
additional information: Folia ouara, minime cordata, crenata; non decurrentia. Flores intra ſingulas bracteas quatuor, quorum intermedius primum, tum inſimus, demum laterales florent. Sp. Pl. p. 253.

morphology: fol. cuneiformi-oblongis.
locality: H. trans Albim paſſim; bey Dornburg copioſe.
additional information: Caulis ramoſus. Folia inferiora ouali-oblonga, baſi attenuata; radicalia longe petiolata. Flores albi ſ. flaui. Villi ſtaminum pallidi.

morphology: fol. cordato-oblongis petiolatis.
locality: H. ad viam bey Zerbſt gegen das Friedrichsholz , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. VERBASCI Radix. Vires vt in V. Thapſo. Planta apibus grata. Caulis adſperſus pilis ramoſis. Flores maiores, quam V. Lychniti; minores quam V. Phlomoidi. Villi ſtaminum purpurei.

morphology: fol. ouatis nudis crenatis radicalibus, caule ſubnudo racemoſo.
locality: H. in editis hinter Tochheim gegen Stekby hin; auch hinter Kleinroſenburg nach Aken zu.
additional information: Deſcriptionem completam vide Syſt. Veget. ed. 13. p. 183.

morphology: fol. amplexicaulibus oblongis glabris, pedunculis ſolitariis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme ; am Graben gegen den Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Necat animalcula, quae libros corrodunt. Boerh.

morphology: caule inermi fruteſcente flexuoſo, fol. ſuperioribus haſtatis, racemis cymoſis.
locality: H. in ſepibus ; in faulen Weiden in der Weidenallee .
additional information: Offic. DVLCAMARAE Stipites. Infufum mundificans ſanguinem praeſtat omni ex lignis exoticis parato. Eximia in febribus phlogiſticis, ſcabie, lochiis ſuppreſſis et rheumatiſmo. Linn.

morphology: caule inermi herbaceo, fol. ouatis dentato-angulatis, racemis diſtichis nutantibus. | α. S. nigrum vulgatum, foliis ouatis angulatis, acinis nigris. β. S. nigrum villoſum, ramis teretibus villoſis, foliis angulatis ſubuiiloſis, acinis luteis.
additional information: Offic. SOLANI Herba. Planta odore moſchi eſt, in primis var. ß. Vis repellens et anodyna. Contuſa fronti impoſita capitis dolores lenit. Vog. Qualitas viroſa. Linn.

morphology: fol. geminis integris acutis, caule herbaceo inferne ſubramoſo.
locality: H. ad muros im Schloßgarten ; über der Saale zwiſchen Groß- und Kleinroſenburg copioſe.
additional information: Offic. ALKEKENGI Herba, Baccae, Semina. Baccae recentes, ſi ſex ad duodecim pro doſi ſumantur, vt reſoluens et diureticum maxime laudantur. Loeſecke.

locality: H. ad piſcinam bey Badez ; in foſſis zwischen Gnadau und Döben , frequens.

morphology: fol. radicalibus reniformibus, caulinis linearibus.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: E floribus pigmentum viride paratur. Linn. Folia radicalia aeſtate pereunt.

morphology: foliis ſtrictis; radicalibus lanceolato-oualibus panicula patula.
locality: H. am Zeizer Buſche gegen die Felder nach Gnadau zu; auch an der Allee über der Elbe .
additional information: Flores parui. Calyx ad baſin laciniarum vtrimque denticulo liuido. Caules diffuſi.

morphology: fol. vndulatis; radicalibus lanceolato-oualibus, panicula coarctata.
locality: H. in gramineis im Gnez , frequens.
additional information: Racemus terminalis. Rami ſimiles, breuiores, erecti. Caulis angulatus ſcaber. Folia parum vndulata. Radix primo vere ad acetaria adhiberi poteſt.

morphology: fol. radicalibus obouatis, caulinis lanceolato-linearibus ſubſerratis ſeſſilibus remotis.
locality: H. in ſyluaticis über der Elbe dem Schloſſe gegen über.

morphology: fol. cordato-lanceolatis, caule ramoſo, flor. ſecundis ſparſis, calyc. reflexis.
locality: H. in hortis inter olera, in agris frequens .
additional information: Vitium hortorum.

morphology: caule angulato, fol. petiolatis, calyc. ciliatis, pedunculis trifidis.
locality: H. in dumetis in Cyprena , et alibi.

morphology: caule angulato ſimplici, flor. ſeſſilibus, capitulo terminali.
locality: H. in ſiccis gramineis bey der Elbfähre ; bey der Gnadauer Windmühle ; auf dem Mühlinger Berg .

morphology: ſpinis terminalibus, flor. quadrifidis dioicis, fol. ouatis, caule erecto.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi in ſepibus et dumetis , copioſe.
additional information: Offic. SPINAE CERVINAE Baccae. Tingit cortex | luteo colore. Baccarum maturarum ſuccus cum alumine eſt ſuccus viridis pictorum. Syrupus baccarum eſt ad cachexiam, hydropem, arthritidem vtilis.

morphology: inermis, flor. monogynis hermaphroditis, fol. integerrimis.
locality: H. auf der Burg hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi in dumetis .
additional information: Offic. FRANGULAE Cortex. Gemmis hibernis deſtituitur. Cortex purgans eximium in hydrope: in obſtipatione boum certa medicina. Linn.

morphology: flor. plerisque quadrifidis, foliis ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Plerique flores et fructus quadifariam diuiduntur: ſed flore primario conuenit cum congeneribus. Lignum rigidiſſimum ad fuſos et colos inſeruit. Fructus necat oues. Carbones rebus delineandis praeſtant corylinis. Frutex ad ſepes viuas eximius. Linn.

morphology: inerme, racemis glabris pendulis, flor. planiuſculis.
locality: H. in dumetis am Elbdamme gegen den Gnez ; auch im Gnez .
additional information: Offic. RIBIVM RVBRORVM Baccae. Vis refrigerans. Vſus in febribus phlogiſticis, putridis; fiti, aeſtu. Linn.

morphology: inerme, racemis piloſis, flor. oblongis.
locality: H. im Buſche bey Friederikenberg ; auch bey Walternienburg .
additional information: Offic. RIBIS NIGRI Herba, Baccae. Rob in angina praeſtans. Infuſum ſtipitum in febribus exanthematicis et boum febri dyſenterica. Qualitas praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: ramis aculeatis, petiolorum ciliis piloſis, baccis hirſutis.
locality: H. in ſepibus et dumetis , im Gnez , et alibi. Colitur in hortis frequens.

morphology: ramis aculeatis, baccis glabris, pedicellis bractea monophylia.
locality: H. in ſepibus bey Calbe , et alibi.

morphology: fol. ouatis lobatiſque.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe ; in den Hecken auſſen im Schloßgarten .
additional information: Offic. HEDERAE ARBOREAE Lignum, Folia, Reſina, Baccae. Folia vlceribus impoſita ea exſiccant: aceto macerata clauos pedum ſanant. Praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: flor. verticillatis nudis, caul. procumbentibus.
locality: H. in agris arenoſis zwiſchen Tochheim und Friederikenberg ; auch hinter Walternienburg am Fußſteige nach Zerbſt .
additional information: Calyx coloratus facit, vt plantula floribus albis eſſe videatur. Hinc forſan diffenſus ratione petalorum. Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 99.

locality: H. ad foſſas bey Döben .
additional information: In Gen. Pl. ed. 6. p. 114. calyx nullus et corolla campanulata plantulae huic tribuitur. Re vera elegantem habet corollulam albo rubroque variam. Sed quia perſiſtit; dictus eſt calyx. Caeterum habet fortaſſe terra circa Doeben aliquid ſalſi ob propinquitatem Salinarum Salzenſium . Hinc Plantago maritima, Glaux maritima, Triglochin maritimum plantae ibi vulgares.

morphology: racemo foliato, fol. linearibus.
locality: H. in editis aridis hinter Dornburg rechter Hand an der Straſſe nach Burg .
additional information: Flores communiter quadrifidi et caulis procumbens. Mant. 2. p. 345. Non eſt, amiciſſimo Schreber. monente, planta alpina, ſed in collibus variis, vt in Vogtlandia etiam ipſe vidi, frequens creſcit. Sic etiam Iacquinus Vind. p. 213.

morphology: fol. ouatis baſi barbatis, caule erecto, vmbell. proliferis.
locality: H. in dumetis in Cyprena , et alibi; paſſim.
additional information: Offic. VINCETOXICI ſ. HIRVNDINARIAE Herba, Radix. Exanthemata pellit. Linn. Ingreditur radix Estentiam alexipharmacam Stahlii et Puluerem Scillae compoſitum. Loeſecke.

morphology: corollis quinquefidis campanulatis oppoſitis pedunculatis, fol. linearibus.
locality: H. in editis humidis zwiſchen Tochheim und Friederikenberg linker Hand am Wege .

morphology: coroll. quinquefidis infundibuliformibus, caule dichotomo, piſtillo ſimplici. | Var. α. maior. Var. β. Centaurium minus pumilum ramoſiſſimum.
locality: H. α. auf Reinen bey Döben , et alibi; β. am Graben bey Colphus gegen Cyprena hin, et alibi in humidiuſculis .
additional information: Offic. CENTAVRII MINORIS Herba, Flores. Planta amariſſima. Pediculi decocto occiduntur. Cachecticis, Hypochondriacis, Podagrae et morbis quibuscumque ab acido, ſalutaris. Linn. Stamina tubo corollae impoſita; antherae ſpirales; ſtylus vnicus: hinc characteri Chironiae in tantum magis reſpoudet, quam Gentianae.

morphology: herbacea decumbens, foliis ſubulatis ſpinosis ſcabris, calycibus marginatis axillaribus.
locality: H. in arenoſis an der Elbe hinter Monplaiſir .

morphology: fol. triangulari-ſagittatis integerrimis, ſpic. compoſitis aphyllis axillaribus.
locality: H. am Stadtthore gegen das Fürſtenhaus , et alibi in ruderatis , copioſe.
additional information: Offic. BONI HENRICI Herba. Vulneraria eſt et hydragoga, ſi recens oedematibus admoueatur. Radix exhibetur ouibus phthiſicis. Turiones cocti vt Aſparagi eduntur.

morphology: fol. triangularibus ſubdentatis, racemis confertis ſtrictiſſimis cauli approximatis longiſſimis.
locality: H. ad ſepes bey Monplaiſir , et alibi, paſſim.

morphology: fol. cordato-triangularibus obtuſiuſculis dentatis, racemis erectis compoſitis ſubfolioſis caule breuioribus.
locality: H. am Elbhafen bey der Elbe ; in ſtagnis exſiccatis an der Elbe hinter Monplaiſir copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. ATRIPLICIS SYLVESTRIS Herba. Caules decumbentes. Suibus noxia fertur. Vis dubia: vſus incertus. Linn.

morphology: fol. ouatis nitidis dentatis acutis, racemis ramoſis nudis.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe frequens.
additional information: Gaules patuli. Folia lucida, glabra, argute dentata.

morphology: fol. rhomboideo-triangularibus eroſis poſtice integris, ſummis oblongis, racemis erectis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes et olera copioſiſſime .
additional information: Planta matura albicat. Racemi recti, conglobati; ſpicis alternis, ſeſſilibus confertis.

morphology: fol. rhomboideis dentato-ſinuatis, racem. ramoſis subfoliatis.
locality: H. inter olera vbique .
additional information: Affine nimium C. albo. Caulis viridis, angulis purpuraſcentibus. Folia ramea lanceolata, integerrima, | vix vno aletroue dente. Racemi filiformes, diuiſi, longi, nudi. Calyces fructus argute pentagoni. Folia tenera vere inter olus recipiuntur.

morphology: fol. cordatis angulato-acuminatis, racemis ramosis nudis.
locality: H. inter olera tut Paradiſe , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Reliquis magis foetet.

morphology: fol. ouato-oblongis repandis, racemis nudis ſimplicibus glomeratis.
locality: H. am Elbhafen ; in Pömelte ad fimeta , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: fol. integerrimis rhomboideo-ouatis, flor. conglomeratis axillaribus.
locality: H. in campis an der kleinen Weidenallee ; ad muros am Hofe des Seminarii ; et alibi.
additional information: Offic. VVLVARIAE Herba. Hircinum odorem ſpargit. Electuarium hyſtericum Fulleri ex hac planta. Inuſitata, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. integerrimis ouatis, caule decumbente, cymis dichotomis aphyllis axillaribus.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Piſcibus in piſcinis gratiſſima eſca.

morphology: foliis ſubulatis ſemicylindricis. Kali minus album ſemine ſplendente. C. B. P. p. 289.
locality: H. ad ſalinas in Salze bey den Gradirwerken copioſe.

morphology: glabra.
locality: H. in arenoſis auf dem Anger ; hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. HERNIARIAE Herba. Contra oculorum caliginem in trageae vel eſſentiae forma laudatur; item ad hernias et calculi morbos. Exoleta, dubia. Linn.

morphology: fol. duplicato-ſerratis; baſi inaequalibus.
locality: H. in noſtris dumetis et ſylvis vbique .
additional information: Offic. VLMI Cortex medius. Cortex in Hydrope laudatur. Puluis foliorum in colicis doloribus prodeſt. Varietas longioribus florum et ſeminum petiolis, Rupp. Ien. p. 330. apud nos frequens eſt, et a noſtris Quitschen appellatur. Citius creſcit: folia ſunt maiora: lignum non tam durum, ac in altera.

morphology: fol. radicalibus amplexicaulibus pinnato-lanceolatis.
locality: H. auf dem Anger copioſe.
additional information: Offic. ERYNGII Radix, Herba. Radix condiri ſolet, et eius turiones more Aſparagi eſculenti ſunt, Puluis foliorum in hydrope commendatur.

morphology: fol. peltatis, vmbell. quinquefloris.
locality: H. in humidis gegen die Poleymühle , et alibi trans Albim frequens.
additional information: Umbella ſimplex, e centro prolifera. Styli 2 diſtantes.

morphology: fol. radicalibus ſimplicibus, floſculis omnibus ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Offic. SANICVLAE Herba. Vulneraria planta inter primarias, omnium conſenſu. Linn.

morphology: foliolis pinnatifidis laeuibus, flor. vniformibus.
locality: H. im Schloßgarten am Graben , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: In Dyſenteria vtuntur Scani. Caules decorticati a Camſchattis comeduntur. Linn. Etiam ſpiritus potabilis e caulibus paratur. Gmelin.

morphology: ſtolonifera, fol. caulinis pinnatis filiformibus fiſtuloſis.
locality: H. im Graben auf dem Anger , et alibi in foſſis et ſtagnis frequens.
additional information: Bouibus noxiam non eſſe, conſtat experimento. Linn. Inuolucrum, vniuerſale nullum.

morphology: inuolucro vniuerſali ſubnullo, vmbella bifida, inuolucellis pentaphyllis.
locality: H. in agris bey Zens .
additional information: Deſcriptio Mant. 2. p. 351.

morphology: ſem. hiſpidis, petiolis ſubtus neruoſis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. DAVCI SYLVESTRIS Semina. Accenſetur ſeminibus calidis quatuor minoribus. Singulare eſt, quod in media vmbella ſaepius floſculus imperfectus atro-rubens inueniatur. Daucus ſatiuus ſola cultura differt.

morphology: vmbell. confertis radiatis, foliolis lanceolatis inciſo-ſerratis.
locality: H. ad virgulta am Weinberge ; auch daſelbst im Felde .
additional information: Corolla radiata, alba. Deſcriptio completa Mant. 2. p. 350. Planta rarior.

morphology: vmbell. confertis, foliolis ouato-lanceolatis pinnatifidis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Semina aſpera et flores rubentes ab aliis vmbellatis hanc plantam facile diſtinguunt.

morphology: fol. quinquies tripartitis filiformibus linearibus.
locality: H. auf der Hähniſchen Wieſe gegen Gelinde .
additional information: Offic. PEVCEDANI Radix. Ad veſicae cruciatus et tuſſim facit; ventrem leniter emollit. Vog. Vitium pratorum.

morphology: foliolis pinnatifidis, laciniis oppoſitis; inuolucro vniuerſali diphyllo.
locality: H. an der Lindenallee , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Folia lanceolata, quasi carinata. Flores lutei, extus albidi. Caulis angulatus.

morphology: ſeminibus ſtriatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme ; in ruderatis et cultis , frequens.
additional information: Caulis maculatus. Pecora hanc plantam reſpuunt. Sub nomine Cicutae hodie vſurpatur in Hydrope, Cancro aliisque morbis grauibus; vt Stoerkius ex profeſſo docuit.

morphology: foliolis diuaricatis.
locality: H. in pratis ſyluaticis hinter der Poleymühle ; auch auf der Höhe hinter Tochheim .
additional information: Ramuli foliorum angulos obtuſos cum petiolo faciunt. In | Saxoniae ſuperioris officinas inde ab aliquo tempore introducta eſt, vt vrinam mouens et mucum abſtergens. Vog. Infuſum in Gonorrhoea proſuit. Schmiedel.

morphology: inuolucris vniuerſalibus nullis, fol. perfoliatis.
locality: H. in hortis inter olera paſſim .
additional information: Offic. PERFOLIATAE Semina, Herba. Cum aceto cocta herba et calide adplicata in gangliis curandis prodeſt. Inuolucella ouata mucronata.

morphology: vmbell. ſimplicibus alternis pentaphyllis ſubtrifloris.
locality: H. in ſiccis beym Damme am Wege nach Pömelte ; auch in der Weidenallee gegen Monplaiſir .
additional information: Inuolucrum 3-phyllum, breue. Inuolucella ſetacea, breuia. Vmbellulae axillares, paruae. Flores lutei.

morphology: fol. pinnatis, vmbella terminali.
locality: H. im Elbwerder , et alibi in foſſis, copioſe.
additional information: Nocuiſſe bobus radicem eſam conſtat. Linn.

morphology: fol. pinnatis, vmbellis axillaribus ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. ad paludes unterhalb Gödniz gegen Dornburg zu.
additional information: Inuolucrum vniuerſale in hac ſpecie ſaepe deeſt.

morphology: foliolis linearibus decurrentibus connatis.
locality: H. bey der Bleichſchenke am Elbdamme ; ad margines agrorum et inter ſegetes vbique.

morphology: ſublacteſcens, radice vnica.
locality: H. in alnetis hinter Walternienburg an der Nuthe .
additional information: Foliolis abſciſſis lac ſufficiens prouenit. Foliola terminalia elongata. Radix feruidiſſima a Lapponibus loco Tabaci maſticatur. Linn.

vernacular name: Roßfenchel; Angelike mit fein getheilten Blättern.
morphology: caule ſulcato acutangulo, inuolucro vniuerſali euanido, piſtillis fructus reflexis.
locality: H. in dumetis im Zeizer Buſche , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Poſt deſcriptiones ipſius Linnei Sp. Pl. p. 351. S. N. 12. p. 207. Reygeri Ged. P. 2. p. 61. aliorumque, dubia planta vlterius non eſſe poteſt.

morphology: fol. aequalibus ouato-lanceolatis ſerratis.
locality: H. im Buſche gegen Saalhorn , et alibi in dumetis, copioſe .
additional information: Offic. ANGELICAEA SYLVESTRIS Radix, Semen. Radix pertinet ad alexipharmaca, carminatiua, cephalica, vterina. Loeſecke. Semina capiti inſperſa pediculos occidunt.

morphology: foliis conformibus.
locality: H. in hortis inter olera frequens .
additional information: Caueant coqui, ne folia loco Apii Petroſelini in cibum adhibeant, cum dementent eſu. Anſeribus deleteria planta eſt. Linn.

morphology: ſemin. roſtro longiſſimo.
locality: H. in agris bey den Windmühlen , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: ſemin. nitidis ouato-ſubulatis, vmbellis ſeſſilibus lateralibus.
locality: H. ad ſepes im Paradiſe , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Offic. CEREFOLII Herba, Semina. Folia in iuſculis adhibentur. Succus hydropicis, tuſſientibus, haemorrhoidariis ſolatium. Linn.

morphology: ſemin. ouatis hiſpidis, coroll. vniformibus, caule laeui.
locality: H. an der Mauer des Schloßhofes , et alibi, paſſim.

morphology: caule laeui ſtriato, geniculis tumidiuſculis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. CICVTARIAE Herba. Exoleta, ſuperflua. Linn. Indicat ſolum fertile et foecundum.

morphology: caule laeui geniculis tumido, baſi hirto.
locality: H. in dumetis et ad ſepes frequens ; im Gnez ; copioſiſſime.
additional information: Caulis ſexpedalis, laeuis, ruso-ſuſco-maculatus; inferne ad duo genicula vsquc hirſutus. Auſtriaci et Pannones huius radices, antequam cauleſcat, atque herbam tenellam inter prima veris acetaria vſurpant. Rupp. Ien. p. 283.

morphology: caule ſcabro, geniculis tumidis.
locality: H. am Graben im Schloßgarten , et alibi ad ſepes, frequens.
additional information: Caulis adſperſus punctis purpuraſcentibus et pilis albis patulis. Vmbellae virgines dormientes cernuae. Vmbellulae in medio abortientes.

morphology: foliorum ramificationibus diuaricatis.
locality: H. im Schloßgraben , et alibi in foſſis et ſtagnis copioſiſſime .
additional information: Caules ad brachii craſſitiem accreſcunt. Equis lethalis ob curculionem caules inhabitantem. Linn. Semen ſingularem famam in Saxonia inferiore nactum eſt ad vulnera, abſceſſus, fracturas. Vog.

morphology: petiolis rameis membranaceis ventricoſis emarginatis.
locality: H. in prato ſyluatico beym Zeizer Buſche ; auch am Mühlinger Berge .
additional information: Caulis ſpithameus et vltra, ſtriatus. Flores albicanti-ſubuiolacei. Iacq. Vind. p. 225. cuius deſcriptio cum noſtra planta bene conuenit.

morphology: vmbellis oppoſitifoliis, petiolis marginatis obtuſis.
locality: H. in vliginoſis alnetis unterhalb Gödniz , rarius.
additional information: Offic. CICVTAE Herba viridis. Foliola oblonga ſerrata. Non homini ſolum; ſed et bobus praeſentaneum eſt venenum. Capris ſalutaris et gratus cibus eſt, ſecundum Lucretium. Emplaſtrum de Cicuta ex hac, non e Conio, parari debet. Linn.

locality: H. in pratis vbique.
additional information: Offic. CARVI Semina. Radices Paſtinacis delicatiores ſunt in cibo. Folia tenera iuſculis incoquuntur. Semen eſt contra Colicam flatulentam; ventriculum roborat; in Tertiana non flocci faciendum. Culinaris, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. ſimpliciter pinnatis.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe ; auf der groſſen Wieſe , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. PASTINACAE Radix, Semina. Vitium pratorum apud nos. Radix eſculenta, et ex hac ſatiua orta eſt: ſpontanea tamen pratenſis ſuſpecta habetur. Immo et culta radix diuturno vſu ſyſtema neruoſum laedere creditur. Semen prodeſſe dicitur ad febres tertianas.

morphology: fructibus compreſſis.
locality: H. inter olera in hortis et campis paſſim .
additional information: Offic. ANETHI Herba, Flores, Semina. Herba condiuntur cucumeres, caſei, olera. Stomachicum eſt et carminatiuum: recens praeſtantius exſiccato. Culinaris, trita, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. caulinis ſummis ternatis.
locality: H. in den Hecken am Schloßgraben , et alibi ad ſepes et in dumetis copioſe .
additional information: Ex herba verno tempore olus paratur.

morphology: fol. caulinis cuneiformibus.
locality: H. in foſſis bey Kleinmühlingen .
additional information: Offic. APII Radix, Herba, Semina. Cultura mitefactum editur: ſylueſtre vero et foetidum noxium eſt. Linn. Semen obſtructiones ſoluit. Radix diuretica eſt.

morphology: fol. pinnatis; foliolis radicalibus ſubrotundis, ſummis linearibus.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee , et alibi in ſiccis , frequens.
additional information: Offic. PIMPINELLAE NOSTRATIS Radix, Herba, Semina. Radix humores reſoluit; ſudorem et vrinam mouet aſthmatique et anorexiae auxiliatur; vt in his morbis nihil vtilius infuſione eius, aut eſſentia, aut puluere dari poſſit. Vog.

morphology: foliolis omnibus lobatis; impari trilobo.
locality: H. ad aggerem beym Felde an der kleinen Weidenallee am Anger hin , et alibi.
additional information: Foliola lobata, ſerrata, quaſi oleo inuncta, venoſa. Petioli compreſſi. Mant. p. 219. Pabulum egregium armentorum.

morphology: fol. lobatis, petiolis glanduloſis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi in dumetis , frequens.
additional information: Flores laterales cymae ſteriles maiores, ſpecie plenitudinis: hortenſis arbor, huius varietas, ſemper ſterilis. Lignum inſeruit pro pectinibus textorum.

morphology: cymis tripartitis, ſtipulis foliaceis, caule herbaceo.
locality: H. in ſepibus beym Elbdamme , rarius.
additional information: Offic. EBVLI Radix, Folia, Flores, Baccae, Semina. Vis Sambuci nigrae, ſed ſortior. Herba horreis immiſſa mures pellere dicitur.

morphology: cymis quinquepartitis, caule arboreo.
locality: H. ad ſepes bey den Fiſcherhäuſern , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. SAMBVCI Cortex interior, Folia, Flores, Baccae, Semina. Flores Theae inſtar inſunduntur et ſunt anodyna, emolliente et diſcutiente virtute prae- | diti. Arboris vmbra noxia. Gallinas baccae necant Trita, eximia. Linn.

morphology: petalis bipartitis, fol. ouato-cordatis.
locality: H. in hortis et cultis vbique .
additional information: Antiſcorbutica et phthiſicis ſalutaris eſca aeſtimatur. Folia et ſemina auiculas nutriunt.

locality: H. in arena an der Elbe gegen das Fährhaus ; hinter Monplaiſir copioſe.
H. in humidis gegen Stekby hin.
additional information: Offic. HEPATICAE ALBAE Herba, Flores. Contra Cardialgiam coquitur planta cum cereuiſia. Florum nectaria elegantiſſima. Scapum nonnihil contorquet.

morphology: calycibus capſulisque mucronatis, petalis crenatis, fol. lanceolatis alternis, caule ſubſolitario.
locality: H. hodie inter ſegetes paſſim .
additional information: Offic. LINI Semina. Oleum in morbis pectoris cochleatim ſumtum valde efficax eſt: externe ad ambuſta vtiliſſimum. Vog. Vſus oeconomicus notiſſimus.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis ouato-lanceolatis, caule dichotomo, corollis acutis.
locality: H. in gramineis beym Zeizer Buſche , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. LINI CATHARTICI Herba. Purgat planta macerata; ſed non ſemper ſine torminibus. Arthriticis conducit. Flores ante antheſin penduli.

morphology: foliis oppositis, caule dichotomo, floribus tetrandris tetragynis.
locality: H. in agris arenoſis humidis zwiſchen Tochheim und Friederikenberg ; am Wege nach Stekby hin.
additional information: Planta parua duarum triumue vnciarum, ob ramulos plurimos arbuſculam referens.

morphology: ſcapis radicatis, fol. orbiculatis.
locality: H. in turfoſis inter ſphagnum paluſtre an der Nuthe gegen die Poleymühle zu.
additional information: Offic. RORIS SOLIS Herba. Flos euigilat hora 9. clauditur hora 12. ante meridiem. Linn. Succus ex | sudans verrucas clauosque tollere fertur. Ros in foliis denſatus et collectius ab Alchemiſtis aeſtimatur. Vog.

morphology: ſcapo ſimplici capitato, fol. linearibus.
locality: H. in aridis auf dem Anger gegen Monplaiſir , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: In hortis arenoſis ſata, ornat eos continuis floribus. Varietas maior ad margines agrorum zwiſchen Döben und Mühlingen occurrit.

locality: H. in agris an der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi.

morphology: pedunculis racemoſis.
locality: H. in ſepibus bey Salze gleich bey den Gradirwerken .
additional information: Offic. BERBERIDIS Baccae, Cortex, Semen. Vis refrigerans, attenuans, antiputredinoſa, tonica. Vſus in febribus putridis, Cholera, Ictero. Praeſtans. Linn. Succus baccarum ſuccedaneum citri. Stipulae vel folia in ſpinas tranſeunt.

morphology: caule planifolio bulbifero, fol. crenulatis; vaginis ancipitibus, ſtamin. tricuſpidatis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Corollae purpuraſcentes. Stamina alba. Spatha mucronata. Cum oleribus vere coqui poteſt. Sapor in | lacte, immo et in butyro, percipitur: hinc noſtri hoc allium in paſcuis euellere ſolent.

morphology: caule teretifolio bulbifero, ſtam. tricuſpidatis.
locality: H. in verſuris hinter Colphus .
additional information: Bulbi acuminati, criniti. Capitulum ſaepius geminum.

morphology: caule teretifolio bulbifero, fol. ſcabris ſemiteretibus ſubtus ſulcatis, ſtam. ſimplicibus.
locality: H. cum praecedente ; auch im Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Culmus bipedalis et tripedalis, non ſtriatus. Spatha diphylla, longa, ſubulata; valuula altera in folium ſetiforme longiſſimum excurrente. Folia fiſtuloſa.

morphology: ſcapo nudo ancipiti, fol. linearibus canaliculatis, ſubtus ſubangulatis, vmbella faſtigiata.
locality: H. im Kuhwerder copioſe.
additional information: Scapus ſuperne parum angulato-ſtriatus. Petala interiora apice patentia, omnia lateribus conniuentia.

morphology: ſcapo nudo adaequante folia teretia ſubulato-filiformia.
locality: H. im Kuhwerder copioſe.
additional information: Porrum ſectiuum iuncifolium ſeu ſectile in vſu domeſtico notum cum hoc vnum idemque eſſe, docet Linneus Fl. Suec. edit. 2. p. 105. Ipſe plantam in hortum transplantaui, et expertus ſum. In vrina pellenda, diſſoluendo calculo et vlceribus internis laudatur. Vog.

morphology: ſcapo nudo.
locality: H. in nemoribus über der Elbe bey Grünberg ; im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt frequens.
additional information: Offic. LILII CONVALLII Flores. Recentes flores | fragrantes; ſicci narcotici. Puluis ſternutatorius inde paratur. Baccae in morbis conuulſiuis et ſpaſmodicis prodeſſe dicuntur.

morphology: fol. alternis amplexicaulibus, caule ancipiti, pedunc. axillaribus ſubunifloris.
locality: H. in nemoribus bey Tochheim über die Poleymühle hin.
additional information: Offic. SIGILLI SALOMONIS Radix. Pianta ſpithamea, vix pedalis. Flores maiores, quam in C. multiflora. Radix inflammationes diſcutit; interne eius decoctum contra tuſſim eſt: ob cosmeticam virtutem celebris.

morphology: fol. alternis amplexicaulibus, caule tereti. pedunc. axillaribus multifloris.
locality: H. bey Zerbſt im Friedrichsholze .

morphology: foliis cordatis, flor. tetrandris.
locality: H. in alnetis an der Nuthe hinter Walternienburg .

morphology: fol. planis, ſcapo ramoſo, corollis planis, piſtillo recto.
locality: H. im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt .
additional information: Caulis altus ramoſus.

morphology: fol. planis, ſcapo ſimpliciſſimo, coroll. planis, piſtillo declinato.
locality: H. im Buſche bey Friederikenberg , et alibi in editis arenoſis ſterilibus trans Albim .
additional information: Scapus ſaepe ramoſus, perinde ac ramoſi; ſed flores maiores et ſtylus declinatus Liliaginem ab A. ramoſo diſtiuguunt.

morphology: ſcapo anguloſo diphyllo, pedunc. vmbellatis ſimplicibus.
locality: H. in ſepibus im Schloßgarten ; im Gnez copioſiſſime.
additional information: In annonae caritate bulbi eſculenti ſunt.

morphology: ſcapo angulato diphyllo, pedunc. vmbellatis ramoſis.
locality: H. in agris am Wege nach Pömelte ; auch ad ſepes im Schloßgarten .
additional information: Differt quod minus, et petala habeat acuminatiſſima; praecipue quod pubeſcat, cum O. luteum glabrum ſit.

morphology: flor. corymboſis, pedunc. ſcapo altioribus, filam. baſi dilatatis.
locality: H. in gramineis in der kleinen Weidenallee .
additional information: In hortis, vbi ſemel introductum, difficulter eradicatur. Stercus columbinum cape emtum in obſidione Hieroſolymitana. Linn.

morphology: flor. ſecundis pendulis, nectario ſtamineo campaniformi.
locality: H. in ſepibus et gramineis im Schloßgarten .
additional information: Neapoli innotuit circa 1570. Linn.

morphology: caule herbaceo tereti erecto, fol. ſetaceis, ſtipulis paribus.
locality: H. ad margines agrorum bey der kleinen Weidenallee ; im Kuhwerder , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. ASPARAGI Radix, Semina. Cultura tranſiit | in Aſparagum ſatiuum. Sed etiam huius ſpontaneae plantae turiones in vſum culinae a noſtris colliguntur. Radix aperiens eſt. Turiones liberalius comeſti ſanguinis mictum producere poſſunt.

locality: H. in ſtagnis an der Nuthe bey der Poleymühle copioſe.
additional information: Offic. CALAMI VVLGARIS Radix. Eſt ſtomachicum et roborans. Radix ſacharo condiri ſolet. Pulueriſata aromatum Indicorum ſuccedaneum eſſe poſſet.

morphology: culmo nudo ſtricto, capitulo laterali.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen Pömelte ; an der Nuthe gegen die Poleymühle copioſe.
additional information: Medulla huius et ſequentium ad lucernas inſeruit. Indicat ſolum ſubtus aquoſum.

morphology: culmo nudo ſtricto, panicula laterali.
locality: H. ad foſſas beym Weinberge , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Similis praecedenti: ſed flores non, vt in illo, in capitulum compactum collecti, verum in paniculam effuſi. Ad corbes plectendas vtilis.

morphology: culmo nudo, apice membranaceo incuruo, panicula laterali.
locality: H. in humidiuſculis beym Weinberge; bey der Böſener Mark, et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: Cis Albim hic est vulgatissimus; vt trans Albim in vligi nosis l. conglomeratus. A iunco effuso distinguitur panicula laterali longius pedicellata, culmo canescente rigidiore, et apice post florescentiam inflexo.

morphology: fol. nodoſo-articulatis, petalis obtuſis.
locality: H. ad foſſas gegen Colphus , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Articuli foliorum ſentiuntur, ſi folia per digitos ducantur.

morphology: fol. linearibus canaliculatis, capſulis obtuſis.
locality: H. in paſcuis um Döben , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Radix aliquantum bulboſa. Corymbus communis et partiales inaequales. Capſulae ouatae, fuſcae, nitidae.

morphology: culmo dichotomo, fol. angulatis, flor. ſolitariis ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. in humidis am Graben gegen Cyprena , et alibi.

morphology: fol. planis piloſis, corymbo ramoſo.
locality: H. hinter Dornburg in arenoſis editis .
additional information: Flores rufeſcentes.

morphology: fol. planis ſubpiloſis, ſpicis ſeſſilibus pedunculatisque.
locality: H. in ſterilibus bey Tochheim , et alibi.

morphology: flor. apetalis.
locality: H. ad foſſas über der Nuthe nach Flöz zu; et alibi in humidis .
additional information: Petalis rarius inſtruitur: vidimus tamen petala, ſed admodum fugacia et non omnia, ſed ſaepius tantum 1, 2, 3.

morphology: foliis planis lanceolatis erectis.
locality: H. in pratis bey Steuz .
additional information: Rarior apud nos planta. Fl. vltimo auctumno, ita quidem, vt tantum flos nudus proueniat, fructificatio autem ſequenti vere fiat. Offic. COLCHICI Radix. Eſt vehemens, et interne purgat cum ſaeuiſſimis ſymptomatibus. Hodie nouis factis experimentis famam in re medica acquiſiuit, vt Conium, Datura, et alia venena putata.

vernacular name: Salzkraut; Binſengras mit einer langen Aehre.
morphology: capſ. trilocularibus sublinearibus.
locality: H. in pratis am ſauren Ziez ; bey Gelinde , et alibi.
additional information: Boum delicatiſſimum pabulum et condimentum. Linn. Radix fibroſa.

morphology: capſ. ſexlocularibus ouatis.
locality: H. in paſcuis humidis turfoſis bey Döben .
additional information: Etiam hoc gramine delectantur boues, vtpote ſalſo. Linn.

morphology: flor. hermaphr. valuulis integris graniferis, fol. lanceolatis vndulatis acutis.
locality: H. inter olera ; am Elbdamme ; et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Decoctum radicis ſcabiem tollit; ſemina contuſa Dyſenteriam. Linn.

morphology: flor. hermaphr. valuulis dentatis graniferis, fol. linearibus.
locality: H. in humidis an der Stadtmauer bey der hohen Brücke , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Radix rubra.

morphology: flor. hermaphr. valuulis dentatis graniferis, fol. cordato-oblongis acuminatis.
locality: H. im Buſche über der Elbe bey Grünberg , et alibi in humidis, frequens.
additional information: Offic. LAPATHI ACVTI Radix, Herba, Semina. Radix eſt ad ſanguinem purificandum. Semina ingrediuntur Eſſentiam antiſcorbuticam. Loeſecke. Caulis ſtriatus, folia venoſa longa. Valuularum dentes vtrimque plures, inaequales, longitudine diametri ipſius valuulae.

morphology: flor. hermaphr. valuulis dentatis graniferis, fol. cordato-oblongis obtuſiuſculis crenulatis.
locality: H. ad Albim auſſerhalb des Schloßgarten , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Folia dilutius virentia, interdum maculis rubris notata.

morphology: flor. hermaphr. valuulis integerrimis nudis, fol. cordatis glabris acutis.
locality: H. in paludibus hinter Monplaiſir ; an der Nuthe gegen Flöz , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. HERBAE BRITANNICAE Radix. Vlcera cacoethica ſanat radix interne et externe vſurpata, tamquam vnicum aſylum magnam famam nuper adepta. Eximia. Linn.

morphology: flor. hermaphr. fol. cordato-haſtatis, caule tereti.
locality: H. ad ſepimentum am Herzogsgarten beym Elbdamme .
additional information: Offic. ACETOSAE ROTUNDIFOLIA Herba. Vis refrigerans: vſus in ſcorbuto. Linn. Forſan olim in horto cultus; nunc ſpontaneus.

morphology: flor. dioicis, fol. oblongis ſagittatis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. ACETOSAE NOSTRATIS Radix, Herba, Semina. Decoctum et ſuccus expreſſus in febribus et in ſcorbuto praeſtantiſſimus. Praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: flor. dioicis, fol. lanceolato-haſtatis.
locality: H. in aridis auf dem Anger , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: fol. ouatis acutis, fruct. obtuſe trigonis.
locality: H. am Teiche bey der Lindenallee , et alibi in foſſis et ſtagnis , copioſe.
additional information: Habet vim acrem et penetrantem. Boerh. Hinc veſicas admota excitat. Iumentis venenum eſſe dicitur.

morphology: fol. lineari-lanceolatis, fruct. globoſo-ſquarroſis.
locality: H. in ſtagnis bey Gommern .
additional information: Euigilat circa tempus meridianum, tumque facilius reperitur. Linn.

morphology: floribus heptandris.
locality: H. ad plateas vrbis ; bey Monplaiſir , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. HIPPOCASTANI cortex. Cortex in numero febrifugorum poſitus eſt; ſed ab aliis ſine effectu repertus. Ad exemplum aliorum quorundam Floriſtarum, vt claſſis paupercula non plane vacaret, recenſere placuit arborem ſpecioſam; licet affirmare non poſſim, eam apud nos ſponte creſcere.

morphology: fol. ſparſis lineari-lanceolatis, flor. inaequalibus.
locality: H. in ſiccis duris am ſteilen Elbufer oberhalb Tochheim .
additional information: Planta ſpecioſa. Radix ſub terra exſerit ſtolones copioſiſſimos albos craſſos et eſculentos. Linn. Foliorum infuſum epotum, Ruſſis vſitatum, inebriat. Gmel.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis lanceolatis ſerratis decurrenti-amplexicaulibus. | α. Flore magno rubro; β. Flore paruo pallido.
locality: H. α. in humidis unterhalb Gödniz ; β. bey den Pröbsſümpfen , et alibi.
additional information: Folia inaequaliter ſerrata, inferioribus alternis, ſuperioribus oppoſitis. Germen villoſum. Petala ſemibifida.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis ouatis dentatis.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche ; bey Tochheim , et alibi.
additional information: Caulis molliſſimus rufeſcens. Folia glabra tomento vix conſpicuo. Planta in editis et iuxta foſſas creſcit.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis denticulatis, imis oppoſitis; caule tetragono.
locality: H. ad foſſas bey Colphus , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Folia tenera macula liuida. Summitas adhuc tenella nutans.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis lanceolatis integerrimis, petalis emarginatis, caule erecto.
locality: H. in humidis zwiſchen Gödniz und Dornburg .
additional information: Folia obſolete dentata. Siliquae pedunculatae.

morphology: fol. ouato-lanceolatis planis, caule muricato-villoſo.
locality: H. in arenoſis hinter Monplaiſir ; auf dem Werder den Schifmühlen gegen über, et alibi, frequens.
additional information: E Virginia 1614 adlata, Linn. In hortis colitur, tumque radices, ad modum Apii graueolentis, in cibos et ad acetaria recipiuntur.

morphology: pedunc. vnifloris, fol. ſerratis ouatis deciduis, caule angulato.
locality: H. in alneto bey Gommern .
additional information: Offic. MYRTILLI Baccae. Refrigerant et ad haemoptyſin et ſiſtendos alui fluxus adhibentur. Vog.

morphology: antheris ariſtatis, coroll. campanulatis ſubaequalibus calycibus duplicatis, fol. oppoſitis ſagittatis.
locality: H. trans Albim paſſim; hinter Tochheim copioſiſſime.
additional information: Mel apes ex hac planta prae reliquis hauriunt: hinc apiaria a noſtris quotannis trans Albim mittuntur, vt inde auctumno melle grauia redeant. Decoctum veſicae calculos comminutos expellere creditum. Vog.

morphology: flor. pentandris ſemidigynis, ſpica ouata.
locality: H. varietas terreſtris am Elbdamme et alibi; varietas aquatica im Teiche hinter den Baraken , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Var. aquatica ſtaminibus flore breuioribus; terreſtris longioribus. Stupenda metamorphoſis plantae ex ſolo: in ſiccis erecta ſcabra triſtis; in aquoſis natans glabra et laeta. Linn.
