morphology: flor. hexandris ſemidigynis, fol. lanceolatis, ſtipulis ſubmuticis.
locality: H. an der Elbe gegen das Brückthor ; im Graben am Gnez , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. PERSICARIAE Herba. Sapor plantae eſt vrens; vnde guſtu diſtinguitur. Succus et puluis eſt ad purificanda vlcera. Loeſecke.

morphology: flor. hexandris digynis, ſpicis ouato-oblongis, fol. lanceolatis, ſtipulis ciliatis.
locality: H. in hortis inter olera; in agris ſubhumidis, et alibi, copioſe .
additional information: Folia ſubtus tomentoſa. Variat foliis non maculoſis; maculoſis; et ferrum equinum referentibus; etiam floribus albis et rubris. Ad gangraenam ſiſtendam, vlcera repurganda et contra calculum laudatur. Vog.

morphology: flor. octandris trigynis axillaribus, fol. lanceolatis, caule procumbente herbaceo.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe ; in viis, cultis vbique .
additional information: Offic. CENTVMNODIAE Herba. Variat pro ratione ſoli admodum magnitudine, item floribus rubris et albis. Vbi aliae plantae in viis pedibus conculcantur, haec laete luxuriat. Semina, praecipue auctumni tempore, a paſſeribus et columbis auide quaeruntur. In ſanguinis profluuiis et ad prolapſus vtiliſſima. In aqua vel vino infunditur. Vog.

morphology: fol. cordato-ſagittatis, caule erectiuſculo inermi, ſeminum angulis aequalibus.
locality: H. in agris arenoſis trans Albim , um Friederikenberg , Flöz , et alibi, frequens; indigena pridem facta.
additional information: Vſus in culina notiſſimus. Semina, vt reliqua cerealia, habent virtutem lenientem, abſtergentem, temperantem. Loeſecke.

morphology: fol. cordatis, caule volubili angulato, flor. obtuſatis.
locality: H. in agris an der Lindenallee , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Antherae violaceae. Racemi ex alis, Flores etiam ad baſin pedunculi communis. Folia olerum modo eſculenta.

morphology: fol. cordatis, caule volubili laeui, floribus carinato-alatis.
locality: H. im Gnez .
additional information: Valuulis ſeminum margine membranaceis albis et caule longius diffuſo diſtinguitur. Antherae albae.

locality: H. im Buſche, wenn man von der Poleymühle nach Tochheim gehet rechter Hand; auch zwiſchen Gödniz und Dornburg ad alneta .
additional information: Capitulum cubicum. Flores laterales 5-fidi, partium numero quinario. Planta Moſchi odorem ſpargit.

locality: H. in ſylua hinter Kleinroſenburg .
additional information: Offic. PARIDIS Herba, Radix, Baccae. Narcotica planta. Externe folia contuſa impoſita carbunculos exſtinguunt.

locality: H. in foſſis et ſtagnis vbique .
additional information: Planta ſpecioſa inter carices et typhas eminens et ſtagna decorans.

morphology: floribus lateralibus octandris; terminali decandro.
locality: H. in ſyluis extra terminos Fl. Barb. in Brands Heide bey Wieſenburg , et alibi.
additional information: Paraſitica radicum Odorem ſpargit gratum. Color totius plantae flauus.

morphology: ſtaminibus adſcendentibus, piſtillo declinato.
locality: H. paullo vltra terminos Fl. Barb. in ſyluis über Lindau bey Nödliz .
additional information: Offic. PYROLAE Herba. Vis corroborans, adſtringens. Linn.

morphology: flor. racemoſis diſperſis, ſtaminibus piſtillisque rectis.
locality: H. cum praecedente .
additional information: Habitus floris Conuallariae maialis ſimillimus.

morphology: racemo vnilaterali.
locality: H. cum praecedentibus.

morphology: calyc. fructus patulis.
locality: H. in agris frequens .
additional information: Folia rariora, viridia; floſculi parui; calyces acuti virides.

morphology: calyc. fructus clauſis.
locality: H. auf dem Walle bey Zeiz ; bey Friederikenberg in arenosis .
additional information: Folia crebriora incana; floſculi maiores; calyces obtuſiores albeſcentes. Huius radici menſe Iunio adhaeret Coccus Polonicus.

morphology: foliis alternis.
locality: H. in humidis bey Stekby und Steuz .
additional information: Flos primarius decandrus, reliqui octandri.

morphology: fol. caulinis reniformibus lobatis, caule ramoſo, radice granulata.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche ; auf Reinen bey Döben , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. SAXIFRAGAE ALBAE Radix, Herba, Flores, Semina. Lithontripticam virtutem habere creditur. Exoleta, inſida, ſuperflua. Linn.

morphology: fol. caulinis cuneiformibus trifidis alternis, caule erecto ramoſo.
locality: H. auf dem Altan im Schloßgarten .

morphology: fol. linearibus planis, calycibus aphyllis, caule dichotomo, petalis crenatis.
locality: H. in campis gegen Zeiz , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: cal. cylindricis, fol. ouato-lanceolatis.
locality: H. ad ſepes bey den Gärten der Fiſcherhäuſer ; in mera arena trans Albim bey dem Gaſthofe ; et alibi.
additional information: Offic. SAPONARIAE Radix, Herba, Semina. Amariſſima planta. Pulcre abſtergit; coagula bilis et ſanguinis reſoluit. Vog.

morphology: calyc. pyramidatis quinquangularibus, fol. ouatis acuminatis seſſilibus.
locality: H. in agris gegen Eikendorf .

morphology: flor. ſubaggregatis, ſquamis calycinis ouatis ariſtatis tubum ſubaequantibus, fol. trineruiis.
locality: H. ad vias gegen Zeiz , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: flor. aggregatis faſciculatis, ſquamis calycinis lanceolatis villoſis tubum aequantibus.
locality: H. in dumetis am Weinberge ; im Zeizer Buſche .

morphology: flor. aggregatis capitatis, ſquamis calycinis ouatis obtuſis muticis tubum ſuperantibus.
locality: H. trans Salam am Damme oberhalb Großroſenburg .

morphology: flor. ſolitariis, ſquamis calycinis lanceolatis binis, coroll. crenatis.
locality: H. in ſiccis am Zeizer Buſche ; auch über der Elbe dem Schloſſe gegen über.

morphology: fol. ouatis acutis petiolatis neruosis.
locality: H. in der kleinen Weidenallee in hohlen Weiden, et alibi, frequens .
additional information: Folia in petiolos deſinentia.

morphology: fol. ſubouatis acutis ſeſſilibus, coroll. calyce breuioribus.
locality: H. ad vias et muros im Schloßgarten ; auf dem Anger , et alibi.
additional information: Odor oleoſus nauſeoſus.

morphology: fol. filiformibus, ſtipulis membranaceis vaginantibus. α. Campeſtris; β. marina.
locality: H. α. ad vias auf dem Anger ;über der Elbe in Sandfeldern: β. bey Pömelte in via humida .
additional information: Var. β. euigilat mane inter horam 9 et 10; obdormit inter 2 et 3. Eſt foliis pedunculisque pubeſcenti-viſcidis. Calyx tegit dimidiam capſulam.

morphology: fol. cordatis petiolatis, panicula pedunculis ramoſis.
locality: H. trans Albim im Buſche bey Grünberg .
additional information: A Ceraſtio aquatico probe diſtinguenda, cum quo multum conuenit. Fl. Suec, p. 150.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis ſerrulatis, petalis bifidis.
locality: H. trans Albim in dumetis gegen Dornburg .

morphology: fol. linearibus integerrimis, floribus paniculatis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: foliis oblongis acuminatis oppoſitis integerrimis seſſilibus, pedunculis ramoſis.(Non in Linneo.) Boehm. Lipſ. n. 374.
locality: H. in vliginoſis alnetis bey Gommern ; auch hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle .

morphology: calyc. campanulatis, petalis diſtantibus, pericarpiis coloratis, ramis diuaricatis.
locality: H. in dumetis im Gnez und am Elbdamme .

morphology: calyc. ſubgloboſis glabris reticulato-venoſis, capſ. trilocularibus, coroll. ſubnudis.
locality: H. in ſiccis gegen Friederikenberg ; um Gnadau ; auch vor dem Gnez .
additional information: In Eryſipelate externe vſurpatur a Gotlandis. Linn. Vt olus vere, antequam cauleſcat, in Franconia comeditur.

morphology: flor. dioicis, petalis linearibus indiuiſis.
locality: H. trans Albim in editis ſiccis hinter Tochheim , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Floribus hermaphroditicis etiam a nobis ſaepius inuentus. Conf. Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 126.

morphology: petalis bifidis, flor. lateralibus ſecundis cernuis, panicula nutante.
locality: H. in ſylvaticis montoſis gegen Tochheim , rarius; im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt frequens.

morphology: calyc. decemangularibus, dentibus tubum aequantibus, caule dichotomo, petalis bifidis.
locality: H. in agris an der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſe.
flowering time: Fl. Iunio et ſeqq, vsque in auctumnum.
additional information: Cauli frequenter adhaerent inſecta minora emortua, quae ſucco viſcido, quo planta obducitur, implicata ſunt. Florem aeſtate odoratum, auctumno inodorum eſſe, vt Ruppius Ien. p. 116. adnotat, nondum obſeruare potui.

morphology: flor. faſciculatis faſtigiatis, fol. ſuperioribus cordatis glabris, petalis integris.
locality: H. in hortis inter olera rarius , ſemine procul dubio olim illato.
additional information: Etiam haec caule eſt viſcido, hinc Muſcipulae nomen, ad quas Ruppius refert Ien. p. 125. iure gerere poteſt.

morphology: fol. planiuſculis ſerratis, corymbo folioſo, caule erecto.
locality: H. in agris humidiuſculis beym Weinberge ; an der Saale gegen Werkleiz , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. TELEPHII Radix. Folia contuſa externe ad ambuſta adplicata laudantur. Exoleta, infida. Linn.

morphology: fol. ſubulatis ſparsis baſi ſolutis; inferioribus recuruatis.
locality: H. in montoſis ſiccis bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Colitur in noſtris hortis, et ſub nomine Tripmadame ad iuſcula et acetaria adhibetur.

morphology: fol. ſubulatis quinquefariis confertis baſi ſolutis, floribus cymoſis.
locality: H. in aridis bey Gödniz ; im Buſche bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Praecedenti admodum affine: hinc a Linn. o olim Fl. Suec. p. 153. coniunctum; poſtmodum autem ſeparatum eſt. Hoc foliis glaucis, craſſius ſubulatis, quinquefariam imbricatis; illud foliis viridibus, tenuius ſubulatis, inferioribus, vt hamus, recuruatis. Spec. Pl. p. 618.

morphology: fol. oblongis obtuſis teretiuſculis ſeſſilibus patentibus, cyma ramoſa.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradieſe copioſe .
additional information: Flos albus.

morphology: fol. ſubouatis adnato-ſeſſilibus gibbis erectiuſculis alternis, cyma trifida.
locality: H. in muris et ſterilibus vbique .
additional information: Offic. SEDI MINORIS Herba. Scorbuti et Quartanae medicina eximia. Linn. Suſpenſum in hypocauſto temperato per aliquot menſes viget et floret. Idem in S. reflexo et aliis ſedis obſeruari poteſt. Hinc eſt, quod ſeda tam difficulter exſiccari et herbariis inſeri queant.

morphology: fol. ſubouatis adnato-ſeſſilibus gibbis erectiuſculis ſexfariam imbricatis.
locality: H. in ſiccis auf dem Anger an der Elbe ; bey Tochheim .
additional information: Praecedenti ſimillimum. Sed ſapor non acris; caules ſimplices, nec ramoſi; folia ternata vel ſexfariam oblique imbricata; flores in ramo cymae raro vitra tres.

morphology: fol. verticillatis, flor. decandris.
locality: H. in agris vbique .
additional information: In agris arenoſis, vbi Medicago aut Trifolium aegre creſcunt, haec Spergula, vt pabulum pro pecoribus optimum ſeri poteſt; quod in Luſatia inferiore et alibi fieri ſolet.

morphology: fol. verticillatis, flor. pentandris.
locality: H. in aridis rechter Hand bey Friederikenberg , et alibi in arenoſis trans Albim .
additional information: Simillima S. aruenſi; ſed magis glabra, floribus pentandris. Mant. 2. p. 390. Porro haec eſt vernalis et fugax; illa aeſtiua et auctumnalis diutius durans. Levſ. Hall. p. 81. Deniqne ſemina S. pentandrae ſunt orbiculata, compreſſa, nigra, margine foliaceo candido cincta.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis ſubulatis laeuibus, caul. ſimplicibus.
locality: H. in arenoſis humidis unterhalb Gödniz frequens.
additional information: Planta puſilla. Flores ſolitarii niuei.

morphology: fol. ouatis, petalis calyci aequalibus, caulibus diffuſis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: erectum villoſo-viſcoſum.
locality: H. in gramineis in der kleinen Weidenallee .

morphology: flor. pentandris, petalis emarginatis.
locality: H. in aridis ſiccis auf dem Anger an der Elbe , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Filamenta 5 ſterilia, 5 antherifera.

morphology: fol. lineari-lanceolatis obtuſis glabris, coroll. calyce maioribus.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, copioſiſſime.

morphology: fol. cordatis ſeſſilibus, flor. ſolitariis, fruct. pendulis.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee , et alibi ad foſſas, frequens .
additional information: Deſcriptio completa Flor. Suec. p. 157.

morphology: hirſuta, calyc. corollam aequantibus, petalis integris nudis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes nimis frequens .
additional information: Semina in copia pani immixta eum coeruleum et grauem faciunt. Radix ad haemorrhagias a nonnullis laudata.

morphology: petalis quadrifidis, fructu ſubrotundo.
locality: H. in pratis humidis an der Elbe hinter dem Gnez ; über der Elbe , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: petalis ſubintegris.
locality: H. in montoſis ſyluaticis bey Tochheim , rarius; im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt copioſe.
additional information: Caulis articuli ſuperiores ſuperna parte viſco nigricante illiti ſunt. In hortis flore pleno colitur.

morphology: floribus dioicis.
locality: H. am Graben im Schloßgarten ; im Gnez frequens.
additional information: Variat flore rubro et albo. Varietas rubra plerumque tenerior eſt, quam alba.

morphology: ſcapo vnifloro, fol. ternatis, obcordatis, radice dentata.
locality: H. trans Albim in ſylua dem Schloſſe gegen über, rarius; in Brands Heide copioſe.
additional information: Offic. ACETOSELLAE Herba. Tota planta acidula citro delicatior. Foliola coelo pluuioſo eriguntur, ſereno dependent.

morphology: pedunc. vmbelliferis, caule ramoſo diffuſo.
locality: H. inter olera im Herzogsgarten , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Annua. Haec ſpecies in officinis priori ſaepe ſubstituitur. Leyſ. Hall. p. 84.

morphology: fol. cuneiformibus, flor. ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. in hortis inter olera copioſe .
additional information: Offic. PORTVLACAE Herba, Semina. Corollam explicat circa meridiem hora 11-12. Caeterum flores clauſi, qui etiam in decerpta planta mox clauduntur. In iuſcula et acetaria recipitur. Bilis feruorem ſiſtit et putredinem cohibet.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis cordato-lanceolatis, flor. ſpicatis dodecandris.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi ad foſſas et ſtagna copioſiſſime .
additional information: Radix adſtringit; diarrhoeis medetur, et in laxitate a diarrhoea et dyſenteria ſuperſtite vtilis eſt. Haen. Haller. Ad coria praeparanda vtiliter adhiberi poteſt. Gled.

morphology: fol. alternis linearibus, flor. hexandris.
locality: H. in foſſis exſiccatis bey Colphus , et alibi ad ſtagna, frequens .
additional information: Numerus antherarum variat ad 8. Petala fugacia. Deſcriptionem et iconem dedit Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 147.

morphology: fol. caulinis pinnatis, impari petiolato; fruct. hiſpidis.
locality: H. ad verſuras agrorum an der Lindenallee , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. AGRIMONIAE Herba. Morbis ab obſtructione profectis ſuccurrit.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis integris baſi vtrimque vnidentatis, calyc. quadrifidis.
locality: H. in gramineis am Elbdamme hinter Monplaiſir ; hinter Werkleiz ; gegen die Fähre ; et alibi.
additional information: Inflexo cacumine ſolem, etiam noctu, ſequitur. Tingit lanas albas luteo, coeruleas, vti commune, viridi colore. Linn.

morphology: foliis omnibus trifidis; inferioribus pinnatis.
locality: H. in ſiccis am Mühlinger Berge .

morphology: vmbella trifida, dichotoma; inuolucellis ouatis, fol. integerrimis obouatis petiolatis.
locality: H. inter olera in hortis frequens .
additional information: Petala lunata.

morphology: vmbella trifida, dichotoma; inuolucellis lanceolatis, foliis linearibus.
locality: H. in campis gegen Zeiz , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Petala lunata. Fructus laeuis.

morphology: vmbella quinquefida; bifida; inuolucellis ſubouatis, foliis lanceolatis obtuſis integerrimis.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Exſiccatione nigra euadit. Inuolucella ſubtiliſſime ſerrata. Fructus ruber muricatus. Petala integra.

morphology: vmbella quinquefida; trifida; dichotoma; inuolucellis obouatis, fol. cuneiformibus ſerratis.
locality: H. in hortis et agris vbique .
additional information: Offic. ESVLAE Herba. Vmbella ſolem ſequitur. Succus corroſiuus exulcerat inſtar cantharidum. Verrucas, Clauos, Odontalgiam tollit. Linn.

morphology: vmbella quinquefida; trifida; dichotoma; inuolucellis carina piloſis, fol. ſerratis lanceolatis, capſ. verrucoſis.
locality: H. im Elbwerder ; im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: vmbella multifida; bifida; inuolucellis ſubcordatis, petalis ſubbicornibus, ramis ſterilibus, foliis vniformibus.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Rami ſaepe fertiles vniflori.

morphology: vmbella multifida; dichotoma; inuolucellis ſubcordatis, ramis ſterilibus foliis ſetaceis, caulinis lanceolatis.
locality: H. auf dem Anger gegen Monplaiſir ; in arenoſis trans Albim , copioſiſſime.
additional information: Petala lunata. Fructus laeuis. Huc refertur varietas foliis punctis croceis notatis, ſeu Eſula degener, quae cum illa frequens inuenitur; ſed vix cum floribus.

morphology: vmbella multifida; ſubtrifida; bifida; inuolucellis ouatis, fol. lanceolatis, ramis ſterilibus.
locality: H. ad foſſas hinter den Baraken , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. ESVULAE Radix, Cortex radicis. Radix purgante vi infamis; decocta in lacte ſpecificum anthelminticum perhibetur. Vog. Petala integra. Fructus verrucoſus.

morphology: foliis ciliatis, propaginibus paten-tibus. Hauswurz.
locality: H. in muris am Paradiſe .
additional information: Offic. SEMPERVIVI MAIORIS Herba. Succus ambuſtis ſuccurrit, et cum melle Aphthis. Linn. Propagines cum pauco puluere tecto impoſitas laete creſcere vidimus.

morphology: flor. racemosis; fol. deciduis baſi ſubtus biglanduloſis.
locality: H. in nemore hinter Werkleiz gegen die Saalfähre .
additional information: Facias nauſeoſae tamen a pueris conquiruntur: iis Dyſenteria a Fennonibus curatur. Linn.

morphology: vmbellis ſubpedunculatis, fol. ouato-lanceolatis glabris conduplicatis.
locality: Fl. im Gnez , et alibi in dumetis .
additional information: Offic. CERASORVM RVBRORVM Fructus, Nuclei, Gummi. Fructus acidi ſitim exſtinguunt, febrium ardores demulcent, ſtomacho auxiliantur. Vog.

morphology: vmbellis ſeſſilibus, fol. ouato-lanceolatis ſubtus pubeſcentibus conduplicatis.
locality: H. trans Albim um Gehren , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. CERASORVM NIGRORVM Fructus. Sunt antiſpaſmodica et temperante virtute. Aqua ceraſorum nigrorum inde paratur, contuſis baccis cum nucleis.

morphology: pedunculis ſubſolitariis, fol. lanceolato-ouatis conuolutis, ramis muticis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi in dumetis et nemoribus noſtris, frequens .
additional information: Lubricans et eccoprotica vis eſt exſiccatis. Decoctum inſeruit infuſioni foliorum Sennae et Rhabarbari. Vog. Gemmae-floriferae aphyllae.

morphology: pedunculis geminis, fol. ouatis subuilloſis conuolutis, ramis ſpineſcentibus.
locality: H. ad ſepes in Gethſemane ; auch über der Nuthe rechter Hand ehe man nach Flöz kommt.
additional information: Fructus aceto conditi menſae inſeruiunt.

morphology: pedunculis ſolitariis, fol. lanceolatis glabris, ramis ſpinosis.
locality: H. in ſepibus et dumetis vbique .
additional information: Offic. ACACIAE NOSTRATIS Cortex, Flores, Fructus. Flores aluum purgant; ſanguinem purificant. Baccae vinum fragrantiſſimum ſapidiſſimumque reddunt. Pratorum et agrorum vitium, quia radix repit. Trita, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. cordatis ſeptangulis; lobis infimis diuaricatis.
locality: H. im Lietzker Holze hinter Gehren .
additional information: Baccae edules.

morphology: foliis obtuſis ſubtrifidis ſerratis.
locality: H. in ſepibus et dumetis vbique .
additional information: Frutex pro ſepibus praeſtantiſſimus, tonſilis, non reptans, ſpinoſus.

morphology: fol. pinnatis vtrimque glabris.
locality: H. an der Lindenallee , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. SORBI AVCUPARIAE Baccae. Aluum ſiſtunt baccae. Roub earum ad idem efficax, et ad menſes et haemorrhoides a nonnullis commendatum. Vog.

morphology: inermis, fol. lanceolatis ſubtus tomentoſis, flor. ſolitariis ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. in nemoribus in der Vorderluke gegen Saalhorn ; auch gegen dem Schloſſe über im Buſche über der Elbe .
additional information: Offic. MESPILI Fructus. Stomacho gratus eſt fructus aluumque ſupprimit; hinc vbi praeter modum liquida eſt, conducens. Vog.

morphology: fol. ſerratis laeuibus, floribus corymboſis.
locality: H. im Kuhwerder , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Arbor ſylueſtris ſpinoſa mater ſatiuarum. Varietates 80 recenſuit Millerus in Diction. Hortulanorum.

morphology: fol. ſerratis, vmbellis ſeſſilibus.
locality: H. im Gnez ; bey Grünberg ; et alibi in dumetis et ſyluis frequens .
additional information: Succus pomorum acidus ſpaſmos tollit inunctus Linn. Poma nuper in morbis pecorum epidemicis valde commendata ſunt. Poma Borsdorfiana, quae vt reliqua, ſunt huius varietates, officinas ingrediuntur, atque refrigerant, reficiunt et aluum ducunt. Caeterum Malus ſylueſtris in nemoribus noſtris diligenter inſeritur et inoculatur, quo fit, vt nemora noſtra ſint paene totidem horti frugiferi.

morphology: fol. pinnatis, foliolis vniformibus ſerratis, caule herbaceo, floribus corymboſis.
locality: H. in verſuris gegen Weſpen , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Offic. SAXIFRAGAE RVBRAE Radix, Herba. Radix auſtera. Ad alui fluxus et calculum laudatur. Exoleta, infida, ſuperflua. Linn.

morphology: fol. pinnatis, impari maiore lobato, flor. cymoſis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: germinibus globoſis pedunculisque glabris, caule aculeis ſparſis rectis, petiolis ſcabris, foliolis acutis.
locality: H. in ſepibus in Gethſemane , rarius.
additional information: Flores flaui. Folia odoratiſſima.

morphology: germinibus globoſis pedunculisque glabris, caule petiolisque aculeatis, floribus cymoſis. Mant. 2. p. 245. Roſa aruenſis candida. C. B. P. p. 484. Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 139.
locality: H. im treugen Buſche hinter Monplaiſir .

morphology: germinibus globoſis glabris, pedunc. hiſpidis, caule petiolisque aculeatiſſimis.
locality: H. ad agrorum limites zwiſchen den Windmühlen und Cyprena .
additional information: Fl. cum praecedentibus. Fructus maturus niger euadit.

morphology: germinibus globoſis pedunculisque hiſpidis, caule aculeis ſarſis, petiolis aculeatis, foliis tomentoſis.
locality: H. in dumetis hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle hin.
additional information: Fructus maior, quam in reliquis.

morphology: germinibus ouatis pedunculisque glabris, caule petiolisque aculeatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi in ſepibus et dumetis, copioſe .
additional information: Offic. ROSAE SYLVESTRIS Flores, Fungi ſ. Bedeguar; Cynosbati exacinati Semina. Baccae exacinatae iuſcula conſtituunt. Fructus ventriculum roborat. Petala biloba. Bracteae 2 oppoſitae, ciliatae. Petala incarnata.

morphology: germinibus ouatis glabris, pedunculis hiſpidis, caule petiolisque aculeatis.
locality: H. in ſepibus bey Calbe gegen Bromby ; auch bey Cyprena , rarius.
additional information: Offic. ROSAE ALBAE Flores. In Ophthalmia et Leucorrhoea vſurpatur. Trita, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: foliis quinato-pinnatis ternatisque, caule aculeato, petiolis canaliculatis.
locality: H. in dumetis im Gnez und über der Elbe .
additional information: Offic. RVBI IDAEI Fructus, Folia. Turget fructus grato ſucco, cuius analeptica, reficiens et refrigerans virtus in pretio habetur. Vog.

morphology: foliis ternatis ſubnudis, lateralibus bilobis, caule aculeato tereti.
locality: H. ad agros et in agris hinter Monplaiſir ; et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Caulis inter ſtrigoſitatem adſperſus aculeis tenuiſſimis. Vitium agrorum.

morphology: foliis quinato-digitatis ternatisque, caule petiolisque aculeatis.
locality: H. in dumetis gegen den Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Differt a praecedente caulibus longioribus ſubangulatis, foliis ſubtus ſubuilloſis, baccis laeuibus.

morphology: caule erectiuſculo, foliis seſſilibus.
locality: H. in aridis bey Tochheim , et alibi paſſim.
additional information: Offic. TORMENTILLAE Radix, Herba. Radix habet virtutem adſtringentem. Dentes labentes etiam firmat. Vog. Trita, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: flagellis reptantibus.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. FRAGARIAE Fructus, Herba. Baccae refrigerant, humectant, ſudorem et vrinam cient. Baccis recentibus copioſe quotannis comeſtis, per plures annos a Podagra fatali prorſus liber euaſit Linneus Fl. Suec. p. 175.

morphology: fol. pinnatis ſerratis, caule repente, pedunculis vnifloris.
locality: H. auf dem Anger , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. ANSERINAE Herba. Vulneraria eſt. Succus expreſſus et linteo adplicatus fronti coërcet haemorrhagiam narium. Vog. Radix hiberno tempore elixata ab Anglis comeditur. Raius.

morphology: fol. pinnatis, caule dichotomo decumbente.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe ; am Graben hinter den Baraken , et alibi.

morphology: fol. quinatis cuneiformibus inciſis ſubtus tomentoſis, caule erecto.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: fol. radicalibus quinatis acute ſerratis retuſis, caulinis ternatis, caule declinato.
locality: H. in ſterilibus gegen Monplaiſir ; auch über der Elbe in arenoſis , frequens.
additional information: Variat macula ad baſin petalorum fulua et non fulua.

morphology: fol. quinatis apice conniuenti-ſerratis, caulibus filiformibus procumbentibus, receptaculis hirſutis.
locality: H. in aridis arenoſis hinter Walternienburg am Wege gegen die Poleymühle hin.

morphology: fol. quinatis, caule repente, pedunculis vnifloris.
locality: H. auf dem Anger , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. PENTAPHYLLI Radix, Herba. Vulnerariam eſſe et adſtringentem, hinc ad viſcerum imbellicitates ventrisque et ſanguinis fluxus proficuam multi contendunt. Vog.

locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. CARYOPHYLLATAE Radix, Herba. Folia vlceribus adplicata ea expurgant. Radix primo vere ambroſiaca cereuiſiam fragrantiorem facit et ab aceſcentia conſeruat. Linn.

morphology: H. trans Albim ad paludosa bey Friederikenberg.
locality: H. trans Albim ad paludoſa bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Radix tingit lanas rubro colore. Ictericis radicis decoctum prodeſt. Gled.

morphology: capſ. subgloboſis toroſis hiſpidis, caule folioſo multifloro.
locality: H. in agris zwiſchen Gnadau und Döben .
additional information: Capſulae ouatae, torulis canaliculatae, ſetis incuruis rigidis ſurſum ſpectantibus denſe armatae. Setae caulinae cauli adpreſſae. Folia caulina ternato-pinnatifida.

morphology: capſ. clauatis hiſpidis, caule folioſo multifloro.
locality: H. inter ſegetes gegen Weſpen , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: capſulis glabris globoſis, caule piloſo multifloro, fol. pinnatifidis inciſis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes vbique .
additional information: Offic. PAPAVERIS ERRATICI ſ. RHOEADIS Herba, Flores. In morbis pectoris tam acutis quam catarrhalibus flores in infuſo, puluere aut extracto vtiliſſime dantur. Vog.

morphology: capſ. oblongis glabris, caule multifloro, ſetis adpreſſis, fol. pinnatifidis inciſis.
locality: H. in agris bey Colphus , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: pedunculis vmbellatis.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe ; in ruderatis frequens .
additional information: Offic. CHELIDONII maioris Radix, Herba. Succus flauus acris Herpetem occidit, Hydropem et ſaepe Tabem ſanat. Rarior, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: ſuffruticoſus procumbens, ſtipulis lanceolatis, foliis oblongis reuolutis ſubpiloſis.
locality: H. in aridis hinter Tochheim an der Elbe hinauf.

morphology: floribus nectario deſtitutis.
locality: H. in ſyluis auf Ranies ; in der Lindenallee , culta.
additional information: Offic. TILIAE Flores, Cortex interior, Carbones. Flores temperant ac roborant. Folia commanducata vtilia ad oris vlcera. Apibus flores mel praeſtant optimum. Funes e cortice aqua macerato conficiuntur. Duplex datur varietas; altera folio maiori ſubtrilobo, | citius florens, Großblättrige Linde : altera folio minori duriori, ſerius vernans et florens, Steinlinde . Illa ad ambulacra plantanda praefertur.

morphology: fol. cordatis integerrimis, calyce pentaphyllo maiore. | fol. cordatis integerrimis, calyce pentaphyllo maiore.
locality: H. in ſtagnis am Anger , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Suibus radices et folia accepta, Radix cum lacte contrita gryllos blattasque occidit. Linn.

morphology: fol. cordatis integerrimis, calyce quadrifido.
locality: H. in ſtagnis bey der alten Burg , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. NYMPHAEAE ALBAE Radix, Flores. Humectant et refrigerant flores et anodyni ſunt. Planta ſpecioſa corolla naturali multiplicata. Euigilat hora 7. tumque ſupra aquam eleuat florem: obdormiens circa quartam veſpertinam clauſum florem demittit in aquae ſuperficiem. Linn.

morphology: nectariis monophyllis, caule subdiuiſo.
locality: H. inter ſegetes frequens .
additional information: Offic. CONSOLIDAE REGALIS Flores. Acris ſuccus florum eſt externe ad aperiendos abſceſſus.

morphology: piſtillis quinis, petalis integris, capſ. turbinatis.
locality: H. in campis editis bey Mühlingen .

morphology: fol. enſiformi-triangulis ciliatoaculeatis.
locality: H. in ſtagnis in den Pröbsſümpfen ; auch bey Dornburg , frequens.
additional information: Stamina numeroſa putata mera ſunt fila nectarina; cum in iis cauitates pro polline nullae obſeruari queant. Ergo apud nos flores non ſunt hermaphroditi, ſed planta eſt dioica. Character eius genericus ſecundum I. G. Zinnium in Comment. ſoc. reg. ſcient. Gotting. tomo 3. p. 425. hic eſt: MASC. Spatha 2-phylla. Cal. 3-phyllus. Cor. 3-petala. Nectar. Fila numeroſa in orbem poſita. Stamina 12. FEM . Spatha 2-phylla. Cal. Cor. et Nect. vt in maſc. Styli 6. Capſ. 6-locularis, polyſperma, infera. Pertinet igitur potius ad Dioeciam Dodecandriam, quam ad Polyandriam. Ita et Schreberus , cum quo exemplaria noſtra quondam communicaui.

morphology: fol. pinnatis; foliolis cordatis scandentibus.
locality: H. im Gnez , auch im Buſche über der Elbe .
additional information: Variat foliolis integris et inciſis. Planta eſt valde acris et ad veſicas excitandas adhiberi poteſt. Hall.

morphology: fol. pinnatis; foliolis ouato-lanceolatis integerrimis, caule erecto, flor. pentapetalis tetrapetalisque.
locality: H. ad margines ſyluae trans Albim wo man nach Dornburg gehet.

morphology: foliis ſexpartitis, flor. cernuis.
locality: H. in gramineis hinter Monplaiſir gegen die Elbe .
additional information: Dignoſcitur apicibus soliorum purpuraſcentibus et caulis nebula caeruleſcente.

morphology: foliolis lanceolato-linearibus integerrimis.
locality: H. im Kuhwerder ; auch im Friedrichswerder gegen das Fährhaus .

morphology: caule folioſo ſulcato, panicula multiplici erecta.
locality: H. ad dumeta in der Gurgel ; hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. THALICTRI Radix. Flaua radix ad Icterum prodeſſe dicitur.

locality: H. in humidis in der Gurgel , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Flores huius nondum aperti inſtar Capparum praeparari poſſunt.

morphology: pedunculo inuolucrato, petalis rectis, fol. bipinnatis.
locality: H. in ſyluaticis montoſis bey Tochheim und bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Offic. PVLSATILLAE Herba. Qualitas plantae acerrima, vt vix ſine noxa agat. Vog.

morphology: pedunc. inuolucrato, petalis apice reflexis, foliis bipinnatis.
locality: H. in collibus aridis bey Dornburg .
additional information: Flos minor quam praecedentis, et magis obſcurus. Nuper a Stoerckio aduerſus oculorum adfectus commendari coepit ſub nomine Pulſatillae nigricantis; de qua videndus eſt libellus eius ſingularis.

morphology: ſem. acutis, foliolis inciſis, caule vnifloro.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. RANVNCVLI ALBI Flores. Verrucis et clauis impoſita medetur. Corolla alba.

morphology: ſem. acutis, foliolis inciſis, petalis ſubrotundis, caule ſubbifloro.
locality: H. ad ſepes im Schloßgarten ; im Gnez copioſiſſime.
additional information: Corolla flaua.

morphology: fol. ouato-lanceolatis petiolatis, caule declinato.
locality: H. in pratis depreſſis dem Schloſſe gegen über, et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. RANVNCVLI Herba. Planta acerrima, rubefaciens et veſicatoria, febres intermittentes ſaepe curat moderante anicula. Linn.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis, caule erecto.
locality: H. in ſtagnis trans Albim zwiſchen Gödniz und Dornburg .
additional information: Planta bicubitalis ſpecioſa.

morphology: fol. cordatis angulatis petiolatis, caule vnifloro.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. CHELIDONII MINORIS Radix, Herba. Folia primo vere cum oleribus coquuntur et ad acetaria adhibentur. Scorbuticam dyſcraſiam corrigit; coagula ſanguinis diſſoluit; gingiuarum putredinem exſtinguit. Vog.

morphology: fol. radicalibus reniformibus crenatis inciſis; caulinis digitatis linearibus, caule multifloro.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Petala primo vere in flore vnum aut duo, ſaepe nulla, demum quina perfecta.

morphology: fol. inferioribus palmatis, ſummis digitatis, fructibus oblongis.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen Cyprena , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Planta eſt corroſiua. Habetur pro herba Sardonia veterum, ex cuius eſu oritur Spaſmus cynicus in vultu aegri, riſus Sardonius dictus. Rupp. Ien. p. 103.

morphology: calyc. retroflexis, pedunc. ſulcatis, caule erecto multifloro, fol. compoſitis.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: calyc. patulis, pedunc. ſulcatis, ſtolonibus repentibus, fol. compoſitis.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Radix fibroſa, nec bulboſa. Caules late diffuſi repentes, nec erecti.

morphology: calyc. patulis, pedunc. ſulcatis, caule erecto, fol. multipartitis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme ; in Cyprena ; auf Ranies ; et alibi.
additional information: Differt a R. acri ſtatura duplo maiore, foliis profundius et acutius diſſectis et magis glabris, petiolis parum ſulcatis, ſapore non acri.

morphology: calyc. patulis, pedunc. teretibus, foliis tripartito-multifidis; ſummis linearibus.
locality: H. in pratis bey der Elbfähre , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. RANVNCVLI Herba. Lobi foliorum ſeſſiles. Caulis pilis arcte adpreſſis. Vires vt R. Flammulae, modo debiliores. Vog.

morphology: calyc. patulis, pedunc. teretibus, caule petiolisque hirſutis, fol. trifidis lobatis crenatis holoſericeis.
locality: H. in editis bey Zens um den Mühlinger Berg .

morphology: ſem. aculeatis, fol. ſuperioribus decompoſitis linearibus.
locality: H. inter ſegetes gegen Pömelte , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: fol. ſubmerſis capillaceis, emerſis peltatis.
locality: H. in foſſis et ſtagnis vbique .
additional information: Petala non, vt reliquae ſpecies, ſquamulam gerunt, ſed tantum porum melliferum.

morphology: floribus pentapetalis, fructibus ouatis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes in Cyprena frequens.
additional information: Petala 5 ad 8, ochroleuca, baſi intus nigra vel violacea. Rami etiam floriferi, floribus inferioribus altioribus. Caeterum ſequenti ſimillima.

morphology: floribus octopetalis, fructibus ſubcylindricis.
locality: H. inter olera in hortis .
additional information: Flores atro-purpurei. Rami etiam ſaepius floriferi.

morphology: fol. caulinis lanceolatis trilobis.
locality: H. ad ſepes hinter den Baraken , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Offic. CARDIACAE Herba. Eſt planta leniter calefaciens. In vulneribus et contuſionibus folia contuſa et adplicata ſunt optima. Boerh.

morphology: fol. ouatis lanceolatisque ſerratis, calycibus ſeſſilibus ſpinoſis.
locality: H. am Gnez , et alibi in dumetis et ad ſepes, copioſe .

morphology: fol. reniformibus crenatis.
locality: H. ad ſepes, in dumetis, vbique .
additional information: Offic. HEDEREAE TERRESTRIS Herba. Scabiem ſanat. Flatus diſcutit. In colica prodeſt. Vog.

morphology: ſpicis oblongis, fol. oblongis tomentoſis ſerratis ſeſſilibus, ſtam. corolla longioribus.
locality: H. ad riuulos trans Albim unterhalb Gödniz .

morphology: fl. capitatis, fol. ouatis ſerratis petiolatis, ſtaminibus corolla longioribus.
locality: H. an der Elbe beym Schloßgarten ; beym ſauren Ziez , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Planta non hirta; odore gratiore, quam M. aruenſis.

morphology: fl. verticillatis, fol. ouatis acutis ſerratis, ſtaminibus corolla breuioribus.
locality: H. an der Saale bey Werkleiz ; im Buſche bey Grünberg , et alibi.
additional information: Simillima M. aruenſi, at minus hirta; corollae infima lacinia acuta.

morphology: fl. verticillatis, fol. ouatis acutis ſerratis, ſtaminibus corollam aequantibus.
locality: H. in agris bey der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. MENTHAE SYLVESTRIS Herba. Mentha omnis prohibet lactis coagulationem, bubones mammarum tollit, menſes pellit. Linn. Planta tota hirta, corollae lacinia infima obtuſa. Sed quod ad ſtaminum longitudinem attinet, quae ad characterem ſpecificum in plerisque menthis refertur, ea ſaltim in M. aruenſi admodum ludere videtur. Nam ſaepius duo exemplaria in agro iuxta ſe poſita obſeruaui, vbi in vno ſtamina e tubo corollae non eminebant, in altero vltra corollae limbum porrigebantur.

morphology: fl. verticillatis, fol. ouatis obtuſis ſubcrenatis, caulibus ſubteretibus repentibus, ſtam. corolla longioribus.
locality: H. am Graben auf dem Anger ; am Wege gegen Walternienburg , copioſe.
additional information: Offic. PVLEGII Herba. Securum remedium eſt in vteri affectibus et flatulentia. Loeſecke. Vſitata, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. oblongis ſeſſilibus dentato-ſerratis, floribus geminis axillaribus pedunculatis, caule diffuſo.
locality: H. am Graben beym Gnez ; bey Werkleiz ; hinter Monplaiſir an der Elbe .
additional information: Offic. SCORDII Herba. Ad veterem tuſſim et febres intermittentes facit: in peſte praeſtantiſſimum eſt antidotum. Vog. Trita, eximia, Linn.

morphology: tetragono-pyramidalis villoſa, fol. radicalibus maximis.
locality: H. in pratis ſiccis zwiſchen Stekby und Steuz .
additional information: Offic. CONSOLIDAE MEDIAE Herba. Vim habet adſtringentem. Stolones in hac nulli.

morphology: foliis tomentoſis lineatis, calycibus hirſutis.
locality: H. in ſiccis im Zeizer Buſche ; bey Gödniz ; in Brands Heide .
additional information: ſimplex. Flores ſaturate caerulei. Hinc et ipſe ad deſcriptionem A. alpinae accedere crediderim.

morphology: glabra, ſtolonibus reptantibus.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: fol. cordatis acuminatis ſerratis petiolatis, verticillis vigintifloris.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee , et alibi ad ſepes et dumeta, frequens .

morphology: fol. cordatis obtuſis petiolatis.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe , ad ſepes, et alibi, copioſe .
additional information: Et haec cum oleribus primo vere coqui poteſt.

morphology: fol. floralibus ſeſſilibus amplexicaulibus obtuſis.

additional information: : attamen flores non ſemper ſatis explicantur.

additional information: Corollae rubrae labium inferius macula lutea ſtriisque purpureis notatum.

locality: H. in ſiccis an dem Mühlinger Berg .

additional information: Caulis erectus pedalis. Folia inferiora dentibus ſaepe obſoletis; quatuor ſuperiora lanceolata dentibus maioribus. A P. vulgari tantillum diſtincta.

additional information: Vbi planta copioſa, ibi butyrum luteum et praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. lanceolato-linearibus confertis, caule erecto, ſpicis terminalibus ſeſſilibus, flor. imbricatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, copioſe. | H. ad muros zwiſchen dem Schloßgarten und Paradiſe .
additional information: Offic. LINARIAE Herba. Venenata, viroſa, repellens, pellens. Eximia. Linn. Vnguentum de Linaria in haemorrhoidibus coecis commendatur. Loeſ. Huc pertinet PELORIA , tamquam Linariae proles hybrida, vel potius tantum Linaria degener. Corolla huic regularis, quinqueſida, quinquecorniculata, pentandra. Naturae prodigium, inquit Linneus. | Radicibus ſeſe multiplicat; ſed fructus ſemper abortiunt. Creſcere tamen vidimus in rimis muri perpendicularis, vbi radices vix repere potuerunt. Vidimus etiam, plane vt Schreberus et ipſum vidiſſe mihi per litteras teſtatur, flores Linariae conſuetos et vnum alterumue peloriformem in vna eademque ſtirpe. Quin Schreberus vidit, Peloriam ſenſim in Linariam reduci, et Linariam frequenti transplantatione iterum Peloriam fieri. Referenda ergo erit Peloria ad flores impletos, quorſum olim iam retulit Linneus Philoſ. Bot. p. 83.

morphology: corollis ecaudatis, flor. ſubſpicatis, calycibus corolla longioribus.
locality: H. in agris gegen Zeiz , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. ANTIRRHINI Herba. Venenata planta. Linn. Vulgus pro antimagica habet. Capſula dehiſcens refert cranium ſimiae.

additional information: Offic. NASTVRTII AQVATICI Herba. Planta omni laude maior in ſcorbuto, in phthiſi, pulmonibus licet iam paene conſumtis, et ad ſcirrhos viſcerum. Succus ad quatuor vncias quotidie ſumi debet. Vog. Erfordiae cultura cicuratur et ad exteros in copia exportatur.

morphology: ſiliquis declinatis oblongo-ouatis, foliolis lanceolatis ſerratis.
locality: H. in ambulacris horti ſeminarii; ad margines agrorum, et alibi, copioſe .

morphology: ſiliquis declinatis oblongo-ouatis, foliolis pinnatifidis ſerratis.
locality: H. cum ſuis varietatibus im Teiche bey der Lindenallee ; an der Elbe in arenoſis, et alibi ad foſſas, copioſe .
additional information: Siliquae huic breuiores duarum circa linearum, vt fere ſiliculae.

morphology: caule ſubfolioſo ramoſo, fol. lyratis rectanguto-dentatis hiſpidis; pilis ramoſis.
locality: H. in agris an der Lindenallee rarius; in agris arenoſis trans Albim bey Jüterglück , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Folia radicalia lanceolato-lyrata; caulina lanceolata dentata; pilis bifidis ſeu trifidis.

morphology: petalis calyce minoribus, fol. decompoſito-pinnatis.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe , et alibi in ruderatis, frequens .
additional information: Offic. SOPHIAE Semina. Ad abſtergenda vulnera olim chirurgi Galli vſi ſunt. Dyſenteriam tam hominum quam boum ſemina curare creduntur.

morphology: pedunculis multifloris, flor. pentandris, fol. pinnatis inciſis obtuſis, caule ramoſo.
locality: H. auf dem Anger ; in campis et alibi; copioſe .
additional information: Petala ſuperiora macula viridi notantur.

morphology: pedunc. bifloris, fol. ſubpeltatis quinquelobis inciſo-ſerratis, caule erecto, petalis emarginatis.
locality: H. trans Albim gegen Flöz .

morphology: pedunc. bifloris longiſſimis declinatis, petalis integris, foliis quinquelobis inciſis.
locality: H. ad alneta zwiſchen Gödniz und Dornburg .
additional information: Rami diuaricatiſſimi, bifariam angulati angulis obtuſis. Petala neruis 3 fuſcis, baſi villoſa.

morphology: pedunc. bifloris, fol. ſubpeltatis multipartitis rugoſis acutis, petalis integris. Ger. batrachiodes, Gratia Dei Germanorum. C. B. P. p. 318.
locality: H. im Gnez et in pratis frequens .

morphology: pedunc. bifloris, calycibus piloſis decemangulatis.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. GERANII ROBERTIANI Herba. Odor hircum redolet. Cimices herba recens contuſa pellere dicitur. Succus recens melle ſubactus vlcera ſordida purgat. Vog.

morphology: pedunc. bifloris foliisque floralibus alternis, petalis bifidis, calycibus muticis, caule erectiuſculo.
locality: H. in hortis et agris vbique .
additional information: Petala ſemibifida, calyces ſubmutici, corolla breuiores. Stipulae bifidae.

morphology: pedunc. bifloris folio longioribus, fol. quinquepartito-multifidis, arillis glabris, calycibus ariſtatis.
locality: H. extra term. Fl. Barb. ad ſepes bey Glien .

morphology: pedunc. bifloris, petalis ſubintegris longitudine calycis, caule proſtrato, fol. reniformibus inciſis.
locality: H. in agris an der Lindenallee , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Petala integra, obtuſa, incarnata. Calyces mucronati. Planta ſubuiſcoſa.

morphology: pedunculis vnifloris, fol. quinquepartitis trifidis orbiculatis.
locality: H. im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt .
additional information: Flores magni rubri.

morphology: caule herbaceo, fructibus denudatis, calycibus inciſis.
locality: H. ad dumeta bey der Saalfähre hinter Werkleiz .

morphology: caule proſtrato, fol. cordato-orbiculatis obſolete quinquelobatis, pedunc. fructiferis declinatis.
locality: H. ad vias bey Colphus , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. MALVAE VVLGARIS Radix, Herba, Semina. Planta emolliens. In alui et vrinae difficultatibus, in tuſſi et raucedine frequentis eſt vſus, tam in decoctis et infuſis, quam in clyſteribus. Inter edulia olim vſurpabatur. Vog.

morphology: caule erecto herbaceo, fol. ſeptemlobatis acutis, pedunculis petiolisque piloſis.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe , et alibi in ruderatis, frequens .
additional information: Conuenit quoad vires medicas cum praecedente.

morphology: caule erecto, fol. multipartitis ſcabriuſculis.
locality: H. hinter Monplaiſir am Elbdamme , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Adpellatur etiam Fellriß, quod pannos oculorum diſcutiat. Rupp. p. 16. Caulis ſcaber pilis faſciculatis expanſis.

morphology: fol. ſimplicibus tomentoſis.
locality: H. am Teiche hinter den Baraken ; hinter Monplaiſir ad foſſas, et alibi, copioſe .
additional information: Offic. ALTHAEAE Radix, Herba, Semina. Eſt inter quinque herbas emollientes. Inter cataplaſmata recipitur, vbi dolores leniendi vel abſceſſus maturandi. Trita, eximia. Linn.

morphology: caule ſimplici, bracteis longitudine florum.
locality: H. im Gnez ; in Cyprena ; copioſe.
additional information: Offic. FVMARIAE BVLBOSAE ſ. ARISTOLOCHIAE FABACEAE Radix. lnter ariſtolochica medicamenta, ſeu quae lochialem ſanguinem et menſes vrgent, recipitur: ſed mediocris eſt effectus. Loeſ. Floribus albis, rubris, caeruleis, eleganter ludit.

morphology: pericarpiis monoſpermis racemoſis, caule diffuſo.
locality: H. in hortis et agris copioſe .
additional information: Offic. FUMARIAE Herba, Semina. Planta amariſſima, corroborans, antacida; melancholicis, hypochondriacis, cachecticis, ſcorbuticis, ſcabiosis medicina in infuſo, conſerua, extracto. Linn.

morphology: flor. criſtatis racemoſis, caul. herbaceis ſimplicibus procumbentibus, fol. lineari-lanceolatis.
locality: H. in paſcuo beym Zeizer Buſche , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Variat corolla violacea, carnea, alba. Vis radicis forſan eadem, ac P. Senegae, licet debilior. Linn. Contra phthiſin in puluere, vna cum Infuſo herbae, Viennae cum effectu data eſt. Candon.

morphology: fol. ternatis ſolitariisque, ramis inermibus angulatis.
locality: H. in ſyluaticis zwiſchen der Poleymühle und Tochheim , et alibi in ſyluis trans Albim , copioſe.
additional information: Planta, dum floret in ſteriliſſimis, specioſa. E ramis fiunt ſcopae, et e frutice combuſto ſal geniſtae paratur. Stipites eius paullo altiores ob aureum nitorem baculos elegantes ad deambulandum ſubminiſtrant.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis glabris, ramis ſtriatis teretibus erectis.
locality: H. bey Tochheim ; hinter Grünberg ; et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. GENISTAE Herba. Flores, Semina. Luteo-tinctoria eſt. Sal geniſtae in hydrope decantatum remedium est. Rarior, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis obtuſis, caule tuberculato decumbente.
locality: H. in aridis zwiſchen Prezien und Gommern .
additional information: Ouium deliciae. Schreb.

morphology: ſpinis compoſitis, ramis floriferis inermibus, fol. lanceolatis.
locality: H. im Buſche bey Friederikenberg , et alibi.

morphology: herbacea, fol. pinnatis inaequalibus, capitulo duplicato.
locality: H. ad margines agrorum hinter Döben ; am Mühlinger Berge gegen Zens .
additional information: Decocta vel contuſa et vulneribus adplicata detergit, ſuppurationem inhibet et labia coniungit. Boerh.

morphology: flor. racemoſis geminatis, fol. ternatis, ſuperioribus ſolitariis, ramis inermibus ſubuilloſis. Ononis ſpinoſa. Sp. Pl. p. 1006.
locality: H. auf dem Anger , et alibi ad vias et verſuras, copioſe .
additional information: Offic. ONONIDIS Radix, Herba. Radix diuretica decantata in calculo, ictero, et in primis in febre Hungarica. Planta prima aeſtate inermis, adultior ſpinoſa euadit. Ob radicem reptantem agricolis inuiſa. Aratrum libere tranſire non ſinit: hinc Gallis Arrête-boeuf, arreſta bouis, dicitur.

morphology: fol. pinnatis ouatis, ſtipulis ſemiſagittatis integerrimis, caule ſimplici.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Flos exhilarat ſub frondeſcentia coryleta purpureis ſpecioſiſſimisque floribus.

morphology: fol. pinnatis lanceolatis, ſtipulis ſemiſagittatis integerrimis, caule ſimplici.
locality: H. im treugen Buſche hinter Monplaiſir .
additional information: Radix ob dulcem ſaporem a Scotis pro cibo ac medicamento adhibetur, quo famem pariter, ac ſitim et pectoris morbos depellunt. Vog.

morphology: caule ramoſo, fol. ſexiugis ouato-oblongis.
locality: H. in ſyluaticis bey Tochheim .
additional information: Radix dulcis.

morphology: petiolis teretibus, ſtipulis inferne rotundatis crenatis, pedunc. multifloris.
locality: H. in agris inter ſegetes paſſim .
additional information: Colitur in agris apud nos frequens, et eius varietates in hortis.

morphology: pedunc. multifloris, cirris diphyllis; foliolis oualibus, internodiis nudis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes copioſe .
additional information: Corolla roſeo colore et odore. Aqua ex floribus deſtillata aquae roſarum odori fere accedit. Rupp. Tubera radicis menſae inſeruiunt in Germania praeſertim inferiore. A ſuibus poſt meſſem diligenter exquiruntur. Planta pabularis egregia, in pratis praeſtantiſſima; agrorum vitium non tolerandum.

morphology: pedunc. multifloris, cirris diphyllis ſimpliciſſimis; foliolis lanceolatis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et in pratis et dumetis, copioſe .
additional information: Praeſtans in pratis pabulum.

morphology: pedunc. multifloris, cirris diphyllis; foliolis enſiformibus, internodiis membranaceis.
locality: H. in editis am ſteilen Elbufer oberhalb Tochheim .
additional information: Foliola linearia, nec caule latiora. Stipulae ſubulatae anguſtiſſimae.

morphology: pedunc. multifloris, cirris diphyllis; foliolis lanceolatis, internodiis membranaceis.
locality: H. in nemoroſis trans Salam am Damme zwiſchen Groß- und Kleinroſenburg ; auch diſſeits der Saalfähre ; frequens.
additional information: Folia elliptica, caule multoties latiora. Stipulae etiam caule latiores et fere haſtatae.

morphology: pedunc. multifloris, cirris polyphyllis, ſtipulis lanceolatis.
locality: H. in foſſis am Felddamme gegen Gelinde hin, rariſſime.

vernacular name: Groſſe Waldwicken mit weiſſen Blumen und blauen Streifen.
morphology: pedunculis multifloris, foliolis oualibus, ſtipulis denticulatis.
locality: H. in ſyluis bey Breitenhagen .

morphology: pedunc. multifloris, flor. imbricatis, foliolis lanceolatis pubeſcentibus, ſtip. integris.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee , et in ſepibus, dumetis, agris, copioſe .

morphology: leguminibus ſeſſilibus ſubbinatis erectis, fol. retuſis, ſtipulis notatis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes frequens; in primis tamen varietas foliis anguſtioribus ſublinearibus, flore ſolitario .
additional information: Seritur pro pabulo equorum pecorumque: etiam farina pani pauperum immiſcetur. Stipulae ſubtus macula quaſi inuſta notatae.

morphology: leguminibus ſeſſilibus ſolitariis erectis glabris, foliolis ſenis; inferioribus obcordatis.
locality: H. in der kleinen Weidenallee ; trans Albim in arenoſis gegen Jüterglück , et alibi, paſſim.

morphology: legum. pedicellatis ſubquaternis erectis, foliolis ouatis integerrimis; exterioribus decreſcentibus.
locality: H. im Gnez , et in pratis, copioſiſſime.

morphology: cauleſcens proſtratus, legum. ſubgloboſis inflatis mucronatis piloſis.
locality: H. in pratis extra term. Fl. Barb. über Staßfurt bey Winningen .

morphology: cauleſcens proſtratus, leguminibus ſubtriquetris arcuatis, foliol. oualibus pedunculo longioribus.
locality: H. im Trizer Buſche ; bey Cyprena , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. ASTRAGALI Radix. Ex vino cocta et ore detenta gingiuas purgat; naſo intruſa haemorrhagias ſiſtit. Vog. Folia commanducata ſapore ſunt dulci, vt Glycyrrhizae radix.

morphology: ſubcauleſcens procumbens, flor. ſubracemoſis erectis, fol. tomentoſis.
locality: H. in arenoſis bey Friederikenberg ; auch auf Reinen um Döben .

morphology: leguminibus racemoſis nudis diſpermis rugoſis acutis, caule erecto.
locality: H. et flore albo et luteo am Gnez ; am Elbdamme hinunter; copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. MELILOTI Herba, Flores, Semina. Suaueo lens pellit acaros. Planta emolliens et reſoluens vteri et veſicae vitiis dicata. Linn. In fotu, emplaſtro, clyſtere vſurpata dolores lenit, tumores diſcutit, abſceſſus maturat. Vog.

morphology: capitulis vmbellaribus, leguminibus tetraſpermis, caule adſcendente.
locality: H. in gramineis im Elbwerder ; in der Gurgel , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Flores colore albo roſeoque. Planta pabularis praeſtans. | Trifolio pratenſi non multo inferior, quae pari ratione coli meretur. Sed Semina difficulter maturat et magis decumbit, quam T. pratenſe. Schreb.

morphology: capitulis vmbellaribus, leguminibus tetraſpermis, caule repente.
locality: H. in paſcuis, pratis, agris requietis, vbique .
additional information: Offic. TRIFOLII ALBI Flores. Ad arthritidem commendatur: ſed vera documenta deſunt. Vog.

morphology: ſpicis villoſis longis, corollis monopetalis, caule erecto, fol. ſerrulatis.
locality: H. in ſylua trans Albim bey Grünberg ; frequentius in Brands Heide .
additional information: Calyx nudus dentibus piloſis. Foliola in noſtris non ſerrulata. Calycis dens infimus longitudine corollae, reliquis breuibus.

vernacular name: Gemeiner rother Wieſenklee. | Varietas huius ſeritur in agris ad iumentorum pabulum, ſub nomine Spaniſcher Klee, bey Döben , et alibi.
morphology: ſpicis ſubuilloſis cinctis ſtipulis oppoſitis membranaceis, corollis monopetalis.
locality: H. in pratis vbique.

morphology: ſpicis ſubgloboſis villoſis terminalibus, caule erecto, fol. lanceolatis ſerrulatis.
locality: H. in dumetis in der Gurgel ; ad margines agrorum um Gnadau und Döben , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Simile T. pratenſi quoad flores et T. montano quoad folia. Huic alpeſtri ſtipulae virides, pratenſi ſcarioſae venis rubris; hoc ſtipulis vltimis vtrimque lanceolatis, illud ſubouatis. Folia ſupra glabra, ſtriata, infra hirſuta, vix ſerrulata.

morphology: spicis villoſis oualibus, dentibus calycinis ſetaceis villoſis aequalibus.
locality: H. auf dem Anger ; in agris, copioſe .
additional information: Alae intus eleganti macula ſanguinea.

morphology: capitulis ſeſſilibus lateralibus ouatis, calyc. laciniis inaequalibus rigidis recuruis.
locality: H. ad aggeres bey den Pröbsſümpfen ; in agris arenoſis zwiſchen Flöz und Walternienburg , frequens.
additional information: Calycis lacinias exteriores longiores, validiores. Corollae albidae, anguſtae, longitudine calycis.

morphology: ſpicis ſubrotundis, calycibus inflatis bidentatis reflexis, caul. repentibus.
locality: H. auf dem Anger copioſe.
additional information: Flores apud nos plerumque purpurei.

morphology: ſpicis ſubimbricatis ſubtribus; vexillis ſubulatis emarceſcentibus, calycibus nudis, caule erecto.
locality: H. in paſcuo am Zeizer Buſche , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Flores tetrapetali albi. Capitulum eſt vere racemus coarctatus, bracteis ſubulatis minimis interſtinctus.

morphology: ſpicis oualibus imbricatis; vexillis deflexis perſiſtentibus, calyc. nudis, caule erecto.
locality: H. in agris gegen Pömelte , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Corollae flauae, nec ſpadiceae.

morphology: ſpicis oualibus imbricatis; vexillis deflexis perſiſtentibus, caulibus procumbentibus.
locality: H. in gramineis in der kleinen Weidenallee ; hinter dem Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: A T. agrario differt capitulis minoribus, paucifloris, vexillis anguſtioribus, parum ſtriatis, nec plicatis. Praeterea caules longi decumbunt; modo vno alterouo erecto.

morphology: fol. pinnatis, legum. monoſpermis aculeatis, corollarum alis calycem aequantibus, caule elongato.
locality: H. in editis bey Zens ; auch im Garten bey Döben .
additional information: Seritur vt pabulum iumentorum praeſtans: non tamen apud nos, vbi Medicago ſatiua ob ſolum fertile vtilior et frequentior.

morphology: herbacea, legum. erectis teretibus toroſis numeroſis, foliolis plurimis glabris.
locality: H. in dumetis beym Weinberge ; praeſertim in agris arenoſis gegen Zerbſt copioſe.

morphology: fol. pinnatis, leguminibus incuruatis.
locality: H. in agris arenoſis zwiſchen Tochheim und Friederikenberg .
additional information: Planta glabra procumbens. Folia petiolata. Pedunculi longitudine foliorum. Flores lutei vexillo rubro reticulato.

morphology: pedunc. racemoſis, legum. lunatis, caule proſtrato.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee ; ad vias et ſepes, frequens .
additional information: Pro foeno in apricis glareoſis ſteriliſſimis ſerenda. Linn. Ab aliis etiam nuper in ſcriptis oeconomicis in hunc vſum commendata eſt: ſed inutilis inuenta, cum tota humi procumbat.

morphology: ſpicis oualibus, legum. reniformibus monoſpermis, caulibus procumbentibus.
locality: H. auf dem Anger ; in cultis, agris, pratis; copioſiſſime .
additional information: Legumina ſtriato-rugoſa, pilis rigidis ſubhiſpida.

morphology: legum. cochleatis, ſtipulis dentatis, caule diffuſo. λ. minima: legum. cochleatis, aculeis vncinatis alternis externe donatis, ſtipulis integris.
locality: H. ad aggeres bey den Pröbsſümpfen ; in ſterilibus glareoſis auf dem Anger gegen Monplaiſir .

morphology: pedunc. ſubbifloris, ſem. compreſſis conuexis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes aeſtiuas frequens .
additional information: Offic. LENTIS Semen. Farina emollit et maturat. Vſus oeconomicus pro menſa et pecoribus.

morphology: pedunc. ſubbifloris, ſem. globoſis quaternis.
locality: H. in hortis et agris; in gramineis in der kleinen Weidenallee , frequens.

morphology: pedunc. multifloris, ſem. globoſis binis.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe ; inter ſegetes in agris vbique .

morphology: legum. ſolitariis membranaceo-quadrangulis, caul. procumbentibus, fol. ſubtus pubeſcentibus.
locality: H. ad foſſas beym ſauren Ziez ; bey Gnadau , et alibi.

morphology: capitulis depreſſis, caulibus decumbentibus, legum. cylindricis patentibus.
locality: H. auf dem Anger , et in pratis, verſuris, vbique .
additional information: Varietas β. flore maiore luteo ſplendente C. B. frequens ad foſſas occurrit cis et trans Albim .

morphology: flor. trigynis, caule quadrato herbaceo.
locality: H. beym ſauren Ziez ; in humidis, paſſim .

morphology: flor. trigynis, caule ancipiti, fol. obtuſis pellucido-punctatis.
locality: H. im Gnez ; ad ſepes et dumeta, copioſiſſime .
additional information: Offic. HYPERICI Herba, Flores, Semina. Balſamica planta poſſidet virtutem detergentem et vulnerariam. Oleum coctum in iuſculo ſumtum egregium tuſſis remedium perhibetur. Vog . Flores inficiunt ſpiritum et oleum carmeſino colore. Antherae puncto atro. Stigmata ſanguinea.

morphology: flor. trigynis axillaribus ſolitariis, caul. ancipitibus proſtratis filiformibus, fol. glabris.
locality: H. in ſiccis bey Tochheim ; oberhalb Grossroſenburg , paſſim.
additional information: Folia punctis in margine nigris.

morphology: flor. trigynis, calyc. ſerrato-glanduloſis, caule tereti erecto, fol. ouatis glabris.
locality: H. in ſyluaticis bey Breitenhagen .

morphology: flor. trigynis, calyc. ſerrato-glanduloſis, caule tereti erecto, fol. ouatis ſubpubeſcentibus.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi in dumetis, frequens .

morphology: flor. geminis ſeſſilibus, fol. runcinatis.
locality: H. ad vias et in verſuris vbique .
additional information: Offic. CICHOREI Radix, Herba, Flores. Radix in obſtructionibus viſcerum valde prodeſt: praeſtat autem ſpontanea, magis amara, prae culta; pro menſa culta dulcior. Radix hodie a multis colitur, et diſſecta, exſiccata, toſta, pulueriſata, Coffeae ſubſtituitur.

morphology: glabra, calyc. oblongis imbricatis caule ramoſo nudo, fol. dentato-ſinuatis.
locality: H. in agris arenoſis bey Gödniz , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Corollae minutae; calycis ſquamae laeues.

morphology: fol. runcinatis obtuſis ſcabris, caule ramoſo nudo laeui, pedunc. ſquamoſis.
locality: H. in paſcuis am Zeizer Buſche ; bey Dornburg , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Corollae magnae, calycis ſquamae carina ciliata. Flores clauduntur hora 3 poſt meridiem.

morphology: calycibus corollae radium aequantibus, fol. integris ſtrictis.
locality: H. in der kleinen Weidenallee et in pratis frequens .
additional information: Radix habitu et virtute Scorzonerae radici ſimilis eſt. More aſparagi cocta ſapida eſt, ideoque in hortis culta. Flos euigilat primo mane ſaepe h. 3. Obdormit inter 9 et 10 antemeridianam, niſi tempeſtate moretur.

morphology: perianthiis laxis, fol. integris, pedunculis ſquamatis in calycem.
locality: H. ad ſepes bey Cyprena ; an der Stadtmauer gegen Gethſemane , et alibi.
additional information: Folia lanceolata. Pedunculi in calycem vsque adſperſi ſquamis ſubulatis, donec calyx fere imbricatus fiat.

morphology: calyce ſquamis interne reflexis, fol. runcinatis denticulatis laeuibus.
locality: H. in cultis, pratis, vbique .
additional information: Offic. TARAXACI Radix, Herba. Folia primo vere ad acetaria colliguntur. Praeſtantiſſima in cachecticis | morbis, ſcabie, ictero. Epotus ſuccus maxime iuvat. Vog.

morphology: caule ramoſo, pedunc. ſquamosis, fol. lanceolatis dentatis integerrimis glabris.
locality: H. in verſuris, paſcuis, pratis vbique.
additional information: Genus huius difficile aſſignatur: a Scorzonera differt pappo ſeſſili, ſubſtipitato; a Crepi calyce ſimplici imbricato. Euigilat a hora 7 ad 3 pomeridianam. Radix praemorſa. Variat calycibus modo tantum pubeſcentibus, modo villis nigris tectis.

morphology: calyce toto erecto, fol. dentatis integerrimis hiſpidis; ſetis furcatis.
locality: H. am Zeizer Buſche , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Bractea linearis infra florem. Pappus ſeſſilis plumoſus. Varietas calyce admodum hirto eſt frequentiſſima. Alia varietas non tam frequens habet folia lanceolata, parum repanda, obtuſa, digito vix longiora. Scapus eſt glaber. Calyx glaber, in quo tamen vnum alterumue pilum furcatum inuenire licet. Corollae ſubtus vireſcentes.

morphology: pedunc. calycibusque hiſpidis ſubumbellatis, fol. runcinatis baſi cordatis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes copioſiſſime .
additional information: Radix reptans, hinc agrorum vitium. Flos ſoliſequus.

morphology: pedunculis tomentoſis, calyc. glabris.
locality: H. in cultis vbique .
additional information: Varietates foliis modo laeuibus modo ſpinoſiſſimis, nunc valde nunc minus laciniatis, habitum plantae ſatis diuerſum reddunt. Excubias Florae agit ab hora 6. ſ. 7. in 11. ſ. 12. antemeridianam. Pro acetariis hieme vſurpari poteſt.

morphology: caule ſubnudo vnifloro, fol. lato-lanceolatis neruoſis planis.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche ; im Buſche bey Friederikenberg , paſſim.
additional information: Offic. SCORZONERAE Radix, Semina. Praeſtat pro officinis huius radicem ſumere quam S. hiſpanicae ſatiuae mere oleraceae. Linn. Radicis virtus abſtergens, temperans et leniter nutriens; vnde in decoctis hordeaceis vſurpatur. Vog.

morphology: fol. ſubulatis integris, pedunc. incraſſato, caule baſi villoſo.
locality: H. in ſyluaticis gramineis , rechter Hand, ehe man nach Friederikenberg kommt.
additional information: Caulis ſimplex totus fere lanuginoſus. Folia radicalia latiuſcula, baſi etiam lanuginoſa; caulina anguſta ſubulata.

morphology: fol. linearibus dentatis acutis, caule erecto, calycis ſquamis patulo-mucronatis.
locality: H. in der Schanze bey Zeiz ; auf Erdwänden bey Eikendorf .
additional information: Vigilat vsque ad horam 9. matutinam. Poſtea difficulter reperitur, quia folia a gramine non facile diſtinguuntur.

morphology: fol. lanceolato-runcinatis ſeſſilibus laeuibus, inferioribus dentatis.
locality: H. in arenoſis hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Structura et facie admodum variat planta polymorpha. Folia radicalia Taraxaci; caulina L. auctumnalis; ramea integra, linearia, ſubſagittata, marginibus reuolutis. Styli antheris egreſſi, ſunt fuſci.

morphology: fol. runcinato-pinnatifidis ſcabris; baſi ſuperne dentatis, calyc. muricatis.
locality: H. in gramineis am Elbdamme , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Caulis angulatus, ſcaber, fragilis.

morphology: foliis radicalibus runcinatis, caulinis linearibus integris. Chondrilla iuncea. Sp. Pl. 2. p. 1120.
locality: H. ad ſepes bey Flöz ; auch in marginibus agrorum arenoſorum zwiſchen Flöz und Walternienburg , frequens.
additional information: Seminibus muricatis differt a Lactuca. Corolla lutea ſubtus purpuraſcens. Caulis inferne ſtrigoſus.

morphology: floſc. quinis, fol. runcinatis.
locality: H. im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt ; im Schloßgarten zu Dornburg ad muros .
additional information: Pappus ſtipitatus.

morphology: fol. runcinatis denticulatis acutis, ſubtus laeuibus; caule glabro.
locality: H. in nemoroſis im Trizer Buſche frequens.
additional information: Folia inferiora runcinata; ſuperiora pinnatifida, laciniis denticulatis acutis. Caulis ſaepe ſexpedalis. Planta lacteſcens, vt congeneres.

morphology: foliis verticalibus carina aculeatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi ad aggeres et ſepes, copioſiſſime .
additional information: Offic. SCARIOLAE ſ. INTYBI ANGVSTI Semen.

morphology: fol. haſtato-linearibus ſeſſilibus, carina aculeatis.
locality: H. paullo extra term. Fl. Barb. in ſalſis bey Staßfurt ; forte etiam ad ſalinas Salzenſes .
additional information: Icon Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 207. tab. 4.

morphology: fol. integerrimis ouatis ſubtus tomentoſis, ſtolonibus repentibus, ſcapo vnifloro.
locality: H. in aridis ſiccis auf dem Anger gegen Monplaiſir , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. AVRICVLAE MVRIS Herba. Ad haemorrhagias quascunque in decocto et epithemate adhibetur vtiliter. Vog.

morphology: fol. integris ouato-oblongis, ſtolonibus repentibus, ſcapo nudo multifloro.
locality: H. in editis ſiccis trans Albim zwiſchen Flöz und Walternienburg .
additional information: Folia obtuſa, pilis rarioribus adſperſa. Caulis parum hirſutus, vno alteroue foliolo donatus; flores 2 aut 3 in cacumine ferens.

morphology: fol. integerrimis lanceolatis, ſtolonibus repentibus, ſcapo nudo multifloro.
locality: H. in caeſpitoſis im Schloßgarten , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Folia acuta. Caulis et calyces nigris ſetis adſperſi. Folia pilis longis hiſpida.

morphology: caule ramoſo, fol. radicalibus ouatis dentatis, caulino minori.
locality: H. β. ſyluaticum im Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Excubias agit ab hora 6. matutina in horam 2. pomeridianam.

morphology: caule erecto multifloro, fol. ouato-lanceolatis dentatis ſemiamplexicaulibus.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche .

morphology: fol. linearibus ſubdentatis ſparſis, flor. ſubumbellatis.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche frequens.
additional information: Tingit lanas eleganti luteo colore. Linn. Calyces ſquarroſi.

morphology: calyc. fructus angulatis, pedunculis tenuibus ramoſiſſimis.
locality: H. inter olera in hortis , auch im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Papillaris aliquibus dicitur, quia fiſſuras papillae in mammis ſanare traditur; vnde Anglis Nipple-Wort. Rupp. Ien. p. 209.

morphology: caule diuiſo nudo, pedunc. incraſſatis.
locality: H. in agris arenoſis trans Albim hinter Walternienburg , et alibi, copioſe.

morphology: caule multifloro corymboſo, flor. terminalibus, calyc. radio albo.
locality: H. beym Zeizer Buſche , rarius; am Wege zwiſchen Tochheim und Friederikenberg paſſim.

morphology: fol. pinnatifidis carinatis nudis, bracteis concauis integris ſubcoloratis.
locality: H. in humentibus zwiſchen dem Dorfe Nuthe und Zerbſt .
additional information: Folia vere loco braſſicae coqui et edi poſſunt.

morphology: fol. cordatis inermibus petiolatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , im Kuhwerder , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. BARDANAE Radix, Herba, Semina. Radix blande aperit et reſoluit, hinc ad multos morbos vtilis. In cereuiſia decocta ad articulares morbos commendatur. Vog. Caules in noſtris dumetis vltra ſexpedalem altitudinem excreſcunt: hinc hieme a pauperibus virgultorum loco in vſum fornacis diligenter conquiruntur.

morphology: fol. decurrentibus pinnatifidis hiſpidis, laciniis diuaricatis; calyc. ouatis ſpinoſis villoſis, caule piloſo.
locality: H. auf dem Anger , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Flores vices coaguli praeſtant. Linn.

morphology: fol. ſemidecurrentibus ſpinoſis, flor. cernuis; ſquamis calycinis ſuperne patentibus.
locality: H. cum praecedente vulgaris .
additional information: Styli reflexi verſus latera. Flos noctu ſuaueolens. Semina carduelibus gratum pabulum.

morphology: fol. decurrentibus ſinuatis, margine ſpinoſis; calycibus pedunculatis ſolitariis erectis villoſis.
locality: H. in marginibus agrorum bey Colphus , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Flores minores, quam in C. nutante, maiores quam in C. criſpo. Pedunculi alis criſpis ſpinoſi.

morphology: fol. decurrentibus ſinuatis, margine ſpinoſis; flor. aggregatis terminalibus; ſquamis inermibus ſubariſtatis patulis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi in dumetis, frequens .
additional information: Folia ſubtus albido-tomentoſa, parum pungentia. Excreſcit ſaepe ad altitudinem vltra ſexpedalem.

morphology: fol. decurrentibus dentatis, margine ſpinoſis; flor. racemoſis erectis; pedunc. inermibus.
locality: H. in humidis hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Calyx arcte imbricatus laeuis. Pedunculi inermes. Caulis plerumque fuſco-rufus. Planta tenerior editur a Smolandis. Linn.

morphology: fol. pinnatifidis linearibus integerrimis inermibus ſeſſilibus, ſubtus tomentoſis.
locality: H. in aridis am ſteilen Elbufer oberhalb Tochheim frequens.
additional information: Prior tantum varietas Monoclonos apud nos repentur. Non confundendus eſt cum C. molli Linnei . In noſtro folia omnia ſunt ſeſſilia, plana, margine aliquantulum reflexo, laciniis longis; ſquamae calycinae lineares anguſtiores, aequalis longitudinis, laxae, longiores, in pauciores ſeries digeſtae. Hunc noſtrum carduum a plantis e | ſeminibus Sibiricis enatis nihil differre, et Suinofurti in Franconia etiam habitare, Schreberus , quocum exemplar communicauimus, certiores nos fecit.

morphology: fol. amplexicaulibus haſtato-pinnatifidis ſpinoſis, calycibus aphyllis; ſpinis canaliculatis duplicato-ſpinoſis.
locality: H. im Elbwerder , rarius; ad muros in hortis paſſim .
additional information: Offic. CARDVI MARIAE Herba, Semina. Siccatis foliis peculiaris virtus in pectoris adfectibus tribuitur.

morphology: acaulis, calyce glabro.
locality: H. in paſcuis beym Zeizer Buſche ; Hinter Werkleiz , paſſim.
additional information: Caulem paruum ſaepius habet.

morphology: calyc. ſquarroſis, ſquamis patentibus, fol. ouato-oblongis ſinuatis.
locality: H. um Stadtgraben beym Fürſtenhauſe , et alibi in ruderatis et ad vias, frequens .
additional information: Iuniores caules et diſcus, vt Cynarae, eſculenti. Cancri ſpecificum ex veterum obſeruatione.

morphology: fol. lyrato-pinnatifidis, pinna terminali maxima, floſculis conformibus.
locality: H. auf der groſſen Wieſe , frequens.
additional information: Pro luteo colore ad pannos rudiores tingendos colligitur et vſurpatur. Varietas foliis omnibus ſerratis, ſed inciſura carentibus C. B. Pin. p. 235. n. 1. creſcit ad Salam in der Hinterluke . Folia ciliata.

morphology: foliis dentatis ſpinoſis.
locality: H. in agris et paſcuis vbique .
additional information: Vitium agrorum et paſcuorum, ob radicem ſerpentem eo magis agricolis odioſum. Primo vere cibus equorum gratus et ſalubris.

morphology: fol. digitatis.
locality: H. ad Albim wo man nach Tochheim gehet; auch bey der Poleymühle .
additional information: Offic. EVPARTORII Herba. Valde amara eſt et odorata. Roborante virtute gaudet ac diſcutiente. Vog. Radix ad pugillum decocta aluum mouet. C. Gesner. In hydrope et febribus intermittentibus vtilis. Hall.

morphology: fol. trifidis, calyc. ſubfolioſis, ſem. erectis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi ad foſſas et ſtagna, copioſiſſime .
additional information: Herba tingit lanas fuluo colore.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis ſeſſilibus floribus ſeminibusque erectis.
locality: H. in agris arenoſis humidis bey Gödniz am Wege nach Flöz .
additional information: Varietas eſt B. tripartitae ſecundum Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 15.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis amplexicaulibus, flor. cernuis, ſem. erectis.
locality: H. in alnetis gegen die Poleymühle , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Coreopſis Bidens huic ſimillima, ſed radiata.

morphology: fol. multifidis linearibus, caulibus procumbentibus virgatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi in verſuris ſiccioribus, paſſim .
additional information: Infuſum laudari coepit in pleuritide. Racemi ſimplices, alterni, floribus ſolitariis.

morphology: fol. compoſitis multifidis; flor. ſubgloboſis pendulis; receptaculo villoſo.
locality: H. ad vias nach dem Anger zu, rarius; bey Grünberg , et alibi ad pagos trans Albim , frequens.
additional information: Offic. ABSINTHII VVLGARIS Herba. Vſus multiplex et praeclarus contra febrem, calculum, ſcorbutum et alios morbos. Cereuiſiae acidae immiſſa aceſcentiam tollit. Trita, eximia. Linn.

morphology: fol. pinnatifidis planis inciſis ſubtus tomentoſis; racemis ſimplicibus recuruatis; flor. radio quinquefloro.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: Offic. ARTEMISIAE RVBRAE, ALBAE , Herba. | Carbo ſub radicibus, e radice ipſa, veteribus prodigioſus. In decocto ſumta curſum menſtruum et ipſum partum promouet. In cataplaſmate ambuſtis medetur. Vog. Trita, praeſtans. Linn. Vſus culinaris in anſeribus aſſatis notiſſimus.

morphology: fol. bipinnatis inciſis ſerratis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. TANACETI Flores, Semina. Anthelminticum, dum ſemina melle ſubacta ſumuntur. Roborat praeterea et ventriculo imbecillo ſuccurrit. Vog. Praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: herbaceum, fol. lanceolatis, inferioribus obtuſis; corymbo compoſito, caul. ſimpliciſſimis.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe ; in arenoſis trans Albim frequens.
additional information: Offic. STOECHADIS CITRINAE Flores. In ſtranguria flores pani butyraceo inſperſi et ſic comeſti commendantur.

morphology: ſarmentis procumbentibus, caule ſimpliciſſimo, corymbo ſimplici, flor. diuiſis.
locality: H. in aridis ſterilibus gegen Monplaiſir rarius; bey Tochheim , et alibi trans Albim , copioſe.
additional information: Offic. GNAPHALII Flores. Flores cum pane butyraceo vitulis in diarrhoea dantur. Mares calyces ſubrotundos, feminae ſubcylindricos ferunt. Coloribus eleganter ludunt. Exoleta, infida. Linn.

morphology: caule herbaceo ſimpliciſſimo erecto, flor. ſparſis.
locality: H. in ſylua hinter der Poleymühle , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: caule herbaceo ramoſo diffuſo, flor. confertis terminalibus.
locality: H. in humidis auf dem Anger , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Capitula nigricantia.

morphology: ſcapo nudo.
locality: H. in gramineis vbique .
additional information: Offic. BELLIDIS MINORIS Flores. Recenti ſucco vis ineſt refrigerans, aperiens, demulcens et emolliens. Contra calculum eſt optima planta. In oculis inflammatis flores in aqua cocti et impoſiti, ſunt optimi. Boerh. Trita, infida, Stahliana. Linn.

morphology: fol. compoſtis planis; foliolis ouatis inciſis, pedunculis ramoſis.
locality: H. ad ſepes beym Elbhafen , et alibi, rarius.
additional information: Offic. MATRICARIAE Herba, Flores. In malo hyſterico, colica flatulenta, menſium obſtructione vſurpatur in infuſo. Vſitata, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: recept. conicis, radiis deflexis, ſquamis calycinis margine aequalibus.
locality: H. ad viam wo man nach dem Anger gehet, et alibi in ruderatis et inter ſegetes .
additional information: Receptaculum albicans. Folia tenuiter inciſa.

morphology: recept. conicis, radiis patentibus, ſquamis calycinis margine aequalibus.
locality: H. inter ſegetes vbique .
additional information: Offic. CHAMOMILLAE NOSTRATIS Herba, Flores. Vires inſignes ſunt. In externarum partium doloribus et paralyticis affectibus vel cataplasmatis vel fomenti forma, vniuerſaliter fere applicantur. Interne ſpecificum contra febres intermittentes remedium praebent. Vog.

morphology: fol. amplexicaulibus oblongis, ſuperne ſerratis, inferne dentatis.
locality: H. in pratis vbique; in cultis paſſim .
additional information: Offic. BELLIDIS PRATENSIS ſ. MAIORIS Herba. Folia cum floribus vulneraria ſunt, vrinam mouent, tuſſientibus auxiliantur, in ſucco aut decocto. Vog. Exoleta. Linn.

morphology: fol. pinnatis multifidis, caule ramoſo diffuſo. Matricaria inodora. Fl. Suec. p. 297.
locality: H. ad agros bey der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Calyx margine ſcarioſo hanc Chryſanthemis adſociat.

morphology: fol. pinnatis inciſo-ſerratis, caule multifloro.
locality: H. in nemore ad Salam in Wölbke .

morphology: fol. amplexicaulibus, ſuperne laciniatis, inferne dentato-ſerratis.
locality: H. apud nos rariſſime bey Walternienburg .
additional information: In Saxonia inferiore tam frequens eſt vitium agrorum, vt in regionibus Hannoueranis ad plantam hanc eradicandam agricolas per edicta regia admonere neceſſarium viſum ſit. Beckm.

morphology: fol. ouatis integris, caulinis geminis oppoſitis.
locality: H. in gramineis ſyluaticis bey Friederikenberg rechter Hand , rariſſime.
additional information: Offic. ARNICAE Herba, Flores. Panacea lapſorum, vnde, teſte Ruppio, Fallkrant in Luſatia adpellatur. Sanguinem coagulatum potenter reſoluit. Vnus vel duo pugilli pro decocto parando ſufficiunt; alias cardialgiam, nauſeam et vomitum mouet. Vog. Trita, heroica. Linn.

morphology: fol. amplexicaulibus cordato-oblongis, caule villoſo paniculato, ſquamis calycinis ſetaceis.
locality: H. ad foſſas gegen den Zeizer Buſch ; zwiſchen Gnadau und Döben , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. CONYZAE Herba. In dyſenteria laudatur de- | cocti forma. Sed male in quibusdam officinis pro Arnica venditur; licet fabrica, ſapore et odore diuerſa. Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 181. et Vog.

morphology: fol. amplexicaulibus vndulatis, caule proſtrato, flor. ſubgloboſis radio breuiſſimo.
locality: H. in inundatis exſiccatis am Wege nach dem Anger , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Caulis ſaepius erectus.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis recuruis ſerrato-ſcabris, ramis angulatis, flor. inferioribus altioribus.
locality: H. ad marginem ſyluae , wenn man über Grünberg nach Gödniz gehet.

morphology: fol. ſeſſilibus lanceolatis recuruis ſubſerrato-ſcabris, caule teretiuſculo ſubpiloſo, floribus inferioribus altioribus.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi ad ſepes et foſſas, copioſe.
additional information: Ab I. ſalicina differt foliis latioribus, obtuſioribus, vix manifeſte ſerratis, caule vbique tereti. Calyx quaſi folioſus.

morphology: caule floribus paniculatis, hirtis, fol. lanceolatis ciliatis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme , et alibi in cultis et ruderatis, copioſiſſime .
additional information: Planta quondam Americana pappo ſuo mire ſe propagans, nunc vulgaris in Germania.
