morphology: pedunculis alternis vnifloris.
locality: H. auf dem Anger bey der groſſen Weidenallee , et alibi in ſiccis, paſſim .
additional information: Herba Ruga Wedelii, quam recte inter abſtergentia re- | fert. Decocti ſpecie pituitam pulmonum incidit et expurgat. Vog.

locality: H. varietas altior foliis integerrimis im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt ; auch gegen Gommern hin.
additional information: Offic. VIRGAE AVREAE Herba. Inter praecipuas vulnerarias tonicasque refertur, eoque nomine balſamis vulnerariis et decoctis additur. Vog.

morphology: floribus corymboſis, fol. lato-lanceolatis dentato-ſinuatis, caule villoſo. Iacobaea paluſtris altiſſima ſuaueolens foliis diſſectis. Rupp. Ien. p. 178.
locality: H. in paludibus zwiſchen Colphus und Cyprena , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: corollis nudis, fol. pinnato-ſinuatis amplexicaulibus, flor. ſparſis.
locality: H. inter olera in cultis copioſiſſime .
additional information: Aeſtum temperat et vulnerariam poſſidet virtutem. Externe in lacte coctus ad teſtium inflammationes admo- | uetur. Vog. Seminibus delectantur paſſeres canori caueis incluſi.

morphology: corollis reuolutis, fol. pinnatifidis viſcidis, ſquamis calycinis laxis longitudine perianthii.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe ; in arenoſis hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: corollis reuolutis, fol. pinnatifidis denticulatis, caule corymboſo erecto.
locality: H. in ſylua zwiſchen der Poleymühle und Tochheim .
additional information: Hall. Rupp. Ien. p. 177. tab. 3.

morphology: corollis radiantibus, fol. pinnatifidis dentatis ſubhirtis, caule erecto.
locality: H. ad dumeta bey Cyprena frequens.

morphology: corollis radiantibus, fol. pinnato-lyratis, laciniis lacinulatis, caule erecto.
locality: H. ad dumeta in der Gurgel , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Herba viridi colore tingit.

morphology: corollis radiantibus, fol. enſiformibus acute ſerratis ſubtus ſubuilloſis, caule ſtricto.
locality: H. ad ſtagna hinter Monplaiſir ; ad Salam in der Hinterluke , frequens.
additional information: Planta procera ad ſexpedalem altitudinem adſcendens.

locality: H. trans Albim in ſaliceto rechter Hand, ehe man nach Tochheim kommt.

morphology: corollis radiantibus, flor. corymboſis, fol. lanceolatis ſerratis glabriuſculis.
locality: H. in dumetis bey Cyprena ; im Buſche hinter Kleinroſenburg .
additional information: Laudatur ad mala ex lapſu in decocto potatus. Folia lato-lanceolata, glabra, acute ſerrata. Corollae radii plerumque quinque.

morphology: ſcapo vnifloro imbricato, fol. subcordatis angulatis denticulatis.
locality: H. in humidis in der Gurgel ; bey Döben ; bey Tochheim .
additional information: Offic. TVSSILAGINIS ſ. FARFARAE Radix, Herba, Flores. Vis leniens et aperiens. Vſus maxime eſt in morbis thoracis, tuſſi, raucedine, aſthmate. Vel ex aqua decoquitur, vel ſuccus potatur. Vog. Externe folia vlceribus imponi ſolent.

morphology: thyrſo faſtigiato, floſculis semineis nudis paucis.
locality: H. ad Albim auf Ranies bald Gelinde gegen über.

morphology: fol. Ianceolatis integerrimis carnoſis glabris, ramis inaequatis, flor. corymboſis.
locality: H. ad Albim bey den Schifmühlen copioſe.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis obtuſis ſcabris trineruiis integris, pedunc. nudiuſculis corymboſis, ſquamis calycinis obtuſis.
locality: H. im Elbwerder ; rarius.
additional information: Eſt etiam flos in pratis, cui nomen Amello. Virg.

morphology: recept. conicis, paleis ſetaceis, ſem. coronato-marginatis.
locality: H. ad vias am Ende der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi in agris et ad eorum margines, frequens .

morphology: recept. conicis, paleis ſetaceis, ſem. nudis.
locality: H. in plateis vorm Schloßthore ; am Stadtgraben gegen das Fürſtenhaus ; copioſe.
additional information: Offic. COTVLAE FOETIDAE Herba, Flores. Ab antecedente praecipue loco et odore, vt et habitu, diſtinguitur. Bufonibus gratiſſima planta. Aſthmate correptis pecoribus porrigitur. Inſueta, eximia. Linn. Vrinam pellere, pulmones liberare, bilem atram ducere dicitur. Vog.

morphology: fol. bipinnatis ſerratis ſubtus tomentoſis, caule corymboſo.
locality: H. ad dumeta trans Albim dem Schloſſe gegen über, et alibi.
additional information: Flores praebent colorem luteum.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis acuminatis argute ſerratis.
locality: H. im Elbwerder , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. PTARMICAE Herba, Flores. Acris eſt et aromatica. Puluis in nares attractus pituitam prolicit. Vog.

morphology: fol. bipinnatis nudis, laciniis linearibus dentatis, caulibus ſuperne ſulcatis.
locality: H. ad vias, et alibi, copioſiſſime .
additional information: Offic. MILLEFOLII Herba, Flores. Vniuerſaliter in omnibus morbis internis, qui a ſpaſmis oriuntur, magnae eſt vtilitatis. Externe inflammationes diſcutit et vulnera conſolidat. Vog. Stahliana, trita. Linn.

morphology: fol. bipinnatis, inferioribus nudis planis, ſuperioribus obtuſis tomentoſis, corymbis conuexis confertiſſimis.
locality: H. in aridis apricis auf dem Mühlinger Berge , frequens.
additional information: Vires medicae in hac ſunt eaedem, ac in praecedenti; ſed adhuc praeſtantiores. Vog. Folia in ramis ſummis floralibus ſimplicia, ſemipinnata, integerrima. Caules non ſulcati. Florum radius demum reflectitur, vt non appareat.

morphology: calyc. recuruato-plumoſis, fol. indiuiſis oblongis ſcabris.
locality: H. im Friedrichsholze bey Zerbſt .

morphology: calyc. ſerratis, fol. linearibus integerrimis, infimis dentatis.
locality: H. inter ſegetes vbique .
additional information: Offic. CYANI Flores. In infuſione vrinam cient, hincque in hydrope laudantur. Vog. Exoleta, infida, ſuperflua. Linn.

morphology: calyc. ciliatis, ſquamis planis; fol. bipinnatis, rameis pinnatifidis linearibus, caule paniculato.
locality: H. auf dem Anger hinter der Gurgel an der Elbe ; bey Zeiz und Döben in verſuris et collibus frequens.

morphology: calyc. ciliatis, fol. pinnatifidis, pinnis lanceolatis.
locality: H. in verſuris bey Calbe ; bey Zens ; circa Barbium rarius.

morphology: calyc. ſcarioſis laceris, fol. lanceolatis; radicalibus ſinuato-dentatis, ramis angulatis.
locality: H. in pratis et gramineis vbique .
additional information: Tingit lanas colore flauo.

morphology: calyc. ſubduplicato-ſpinosis ſeſſilibus, fol. pinnatifidis linearibus dentatis, caule piloſo.
locality: H. auf dem Anger et in aggeribus et verſuris, frequens .
additional information: Offic. CALCITRAPAE Radix. Vſus in febribus intermittentibus. Inſueta. Linn. Flos purpureus. Caulis prolifer.

morphology: calyc. duplicato-ſpinoſis ſolitariis, foliis rameis decurrentibus inermibus lanceolatis; radicalibus lyrato-pinnatifidis.
locality: H. in campis vor dem Gnez ; forte cum ſemine Medicaginis ſatiuae aliunde allata .
additional information: Corolla lutea. Flores terminales ſolitarii. Pedunculi longiſſimi, folioſi. Spinae calycis longiores ſub calyce, baſi tantum dentatae.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis ſerratis oppoſitis amplexicaulibus.
locality: H. in vliginoſis hinter Walternienburg ; auch gegen Gommern .
additional information: Simillima Bidenti cernuae; ſed flos eleganter radiatus, quod non in illa.

morphology: panicula dichotoma, flor. rotundatis axillaribus hirſutis, fol. acutis.
locality: H. in agris bey der Lindenallee , et alibi in ſiccis, frequens .
additional information: Magnitudine capitulorumque diſpoſitione variat.

morphology: caule ſubdichotomo erecto, floribus conicis terminalibus axillaribusque.
locality: H. in ſiccis ſterilibus auf dem Anger gegen Monplaiſir , frequens.
additional information: Foliis tenuibus, floribus ſparſis albis diſtinguitur.

morphology: caule paniculato, flor. conicis lateralibus.
locality: H. in agris ad viam gegen Zeiz , et alibi.
H. inter olera im Herzogsgarten , et alibi in cultis .
additional information: Offic. CALENDVLAE Herba, Flores, Semina. Vis pellens, emmenagoga, ſudorifera. Trita, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: capitulis globoſis, fol. ſinuatis pubeſcentibus.
locality: H. ad dumeta bey der Böſener Mark inter Carduos et Dipſacum .
additional information: Planta ſpecioſa, alias etiam in hortis culta.

locality: H. hinter dem Gnez ; um Gnadau ; frequentius autem in ſiccis aridis trans Albim .

morphology: acaulis, fol. cordatis piloſo-hiſpidis.
locality: H. trans Salam von der Fähre nach Großroſenburg hin.

morphology: acaulis, fol. reniformibus.
locality: H. in turfoſis paludoſis hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle ; auch bey Gommern .
additional information: Corolla alba aut coeruleo-albida, petalo inferiore venis purpureis picto.

morphology: acaulis, fol. cordatis, ſtolonibus reptantibus.
locality: H. ad ſepes im Schloßgarten , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. VIOLEA Flores, Semina; it. VIOLARIAE Herba. Herba ad emollientes refertur et clementer aluum ſubducit. Flores cordialibus accenſentur, analepticam obtinent virtutem, tuſſim leniunt, raucitatem tollunt. Vog. Trita, praeſtans; Herba ſuperflua. Linn.

morphology: caule adultiore adſcendente, fol. oblongo-cordatis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, paſſim.

morphology: caulibus erectis, fol. cordatis oblongis.
locality: H. ad ſyluam linker Hand, ehe man nach Flöz kommt.

morphology: caule triquetro diffuſo, fol. oblongis inciſis, ſtipulis pinnatifidis.
locality: H. trans Albim in agris arenoſis vbique ; et quidem varietates flore candido et luteo; atque flore coeruleo et candido.
additional information: Planta vix datur, in qua euidentius perſpicitur generationis opus, quatn in huius cauo apertoque ſtigmate. Linn.

morphology: pedunculis multifloris ſolitariis, fol. ouatis, geniculis caulinis tumentibus.
locality: H. an der Nuthe hinter Walternienburg ; et alibi trans Albim in ſyluis vmbroſis .
additional information: Capſulae maturae tactae ſemina elaſtice explodunt. Noctu obdormit foliis pendulis. Venenata perhibetur. Folia tamen extus imponi poſſunt haemorrhoidibus, Vog.

morphology: bulbis indiuiſis, nectarii labio lanceolato integerrimo; cornu longiſſimo, petalis patentibus.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Offic. SATYRII Radix. Tabidis et ſenibus commendatur. Tormina dyſentericorum compeſcit. Flos noctu odoratiſſimus. Labium lanceolatum. Petala alba patentia.

morphology: bulbis indiuiſis, nectarii labio reſupinato trifido; media emarginata, cornu breui petalis apice ſubulatis.
locality: H. in editis gegen Zens .
additional information: Bulbi fuſiformes. Spica denſiſſima breuis. Flores reſupinati, purpuraſcentes.

locality: H. bey Friederikenberg im Birkenbuſche .
additional information: >Labium trifidum, ſerratum.

morphology: bulbis indiuiſis, nectarii labio quadrifido crenulato; cornu obtuſo adſcendente, petalis obtuſis conniuentibus.
locality: H. im Lietzker Buſche hinter Gehren .
additional information: Offic. SALEP Radix. Vis lubricans, nutriens, aphrodiſiaca. Labium lateribus crenulatum, trifidum media emarginata. Petala obtuſa, lineata.

morphology: bulbis indiuiſis, nectarii labio quadrifido punctis ſcabro; cornu obtuſo, petalis diſtinctis.
locality: H. cum praecedente .
additional information: Labium trifidum media biloba productiore punctis ſcabris. Petala diſtincta.

morphology: bulbis ſubpalmatis rectis, nectarii cornu conico; labio trilobo lateribus reflexo; bracteis flore longioribus.
locality: H. in alnetis bey Walternienburg linker Hand , et alibi.
additional information: Radices in duos vel tres digitos diuiſae. Folia parum maculata. Petala duo lateralia ſurſum flexa; tria vero conniuentia. Nectarii labium ſerratum, obſcure trilobum. Caulis fiſtuloſus.

morphology: bulbis ſubpalmatis rectis, nectarii cornu conico, labio ouato ſubtrilobo; bracteis longitudine florum.
locality: H. hinter Walternienburg linker Hand, wo man nach Gehren gehet.
additional information: Variat floribus albis et rubris. Labium ſerratum, trilobum, media emarginata punctis purpureis. Deſcriptio ampla videatur Fl. Suec. 2. p. 313.

morphology: bulbis palmatis patentibus, nectarii cornu germinibus breuiore; labio plano, petalis dorſalibus erectis.
locality: H. bey Stekby ; bey Gödniz , et alibi.
additional information: Labium crenatum, trilobum, media anguſtiſſima integerrima. Caulis ſolidus. Calcar breuius. Petala lateralia patula. Bracteae non flore longiores.

morphology: bulbis palmatis, nectarii cornu setaceo germinibus longiore; labio trifido, petalis duobus patentissimis.
locality: H. in pratis fyluaticis bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Labium aequale trifidum crenulatum, intermedia integerrima.

morphology: bulbis fibroſo-faſciculatis, caule vaginato aphyllo, nectarii labio bifido.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche .

morphology: bulbo fibroſo, caule bifolio, fol. ouatis, nectarii labio bifido.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche .
additional information: Labium lineare.

morphology: bulbis fibroſis, fol. ouatis amplexicaulibus, flor. pendulis. Serapias Helleborine. Sp. pl. p. 1344.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche ; auch in ſyluaticis auf Ranies , frequens.
additional information: Flores frustusque penduli. Nectarium lineis nullis. Folia amplexicaulia. Spica multiflora, longa. Petioli longi.

morphology: fol. cordatis, caule erecto, flor. axillaribus confertis.
locality: H. bey Cyprena ; auch am Thierberge bey Zachmünde in dumetis .
additional information: Offic. ARISTOLOCHIAE VVLGARIS Radix. Ad podagrae tam praeſeruationem quam curationem laudatur. Externe puluis carnes fungoſas abſumit, cariem repurgat, et vlcera vulneraque ſanat.

morphology: fol. cordatis, ſpatha plana, ſpadice vndique hermaphrodito.
locality: H. am Butterdamme bey Zerbſt .
additional information: Panis paratur e radice in Weſtbotnia. Linn.

morphology: caulibus laeuibus, frondibus interne dentatis.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen Zeiz , wenn man nach Salze gehet.
additional information: Inter Cryptogama relata Sp. Pl. 2. p. 1624. et Fl. Suec. 2. p. 427.

morphology: fol. petiolatis lanceolatis.
locality: H. im Graben bey den Baraken , et alibi.
additional information: Creſcit more Opuntiae ſiue prolifero caule et complanato, ſemper decuſſato.

morphology: fol. ſeſſilibus vtrimque planiuſculis, radic. ſolitariis.
locality: H. in aquis quietis vbique .
additional information: Anatum cibus gratiſſimus. Floret quotannis ſub canicula.

morphology: fol. ſeſſilibus ſubtus hemiſphaericis, radic. ſolitariis.
locality: H. im Teiche bey Colphus , et alibi cum praecedente, cuius varietas tantum eſt ſecundum Gerardum.
flowering time: Fl. Iulio, durante floreſcentia per tres hebdomadas.

morphology: fol. ſeſſilibus, radic. confertis.
locality: H. in foſſis et ſtagnis cum praecedentibus copioſe .

morphology: ſpica compoſita, ſpiculis androgynis; inferioribus remotioribus foliolo longiori inſtructis, culmo triquetro.
locality: H. in arenoſis hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi trans Albim , copioſe.
additional information: Deſcriptio Fl. Suec. 2. p. 325.

morphology: ſpica compoſita, ſpiculis ouatis ſeſſilibus approximatis alternis androgynis nudis.
locality: H. in gramineis im Schloßgarten ; bey der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: ſpica ſupradecompoſita inferne laxiore, ſpiculis ouatis androgynis glomeratis; ſuperne maſculis.
locality: H. ad foſſas bey den Windmühlen , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Culmus craſſus, firmus, exquiſite triangularis.

morphology: ſpiculis ſubouatis ſeſſilibus remotis androgynis, capſulis acutis diuergentibus ſpinoſis.
locality: H. beym ſauren Ziez , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Spica breuis. Folia carinata.

morphology: ſpicis ouatis ſubſeſſilibus remotis androgynis, bracteis culmum aequantibus. β. Carex axillaris. Sp. Pl. p. 1382.
locality: H. in alnetis humidis an der Nuthe hinter Walternienburg .
additional information: Spiculae plerumque duae haerent in alis foliorum culmum ſuperantium; tum vnica cum folio florali mediocri; tandem ſpiculae circa quatuor ſubnudae.

morphology: ſpiculis oblongis ſeſſilibus remotis androgynis, capſulis ouatis acutis.
locality: H. cum praecedente .
additional information: Spica vniuerſalis conſtat circiter ſex ſpiculis, inferioribus duas lineas, ſuperioribus vnam lineam a ſe inuicem diſtantibus.

morphology: ſpicis femineis ſeſſilibus ſubſolitariis ouatis maſculae approximatis, culmo nudo, capſulis pubeſcentibus.
locality: H. ad viam am Graben gegen Zeiz wo man nach Salze gehet.
additional information: Folia mollia, flaueſcentia. Culmi filiformes, nudi, ſpithamei. Spica feminea euadit maturitate nigra.

morphology: ſpica maſcula oblonga, feminea ſeſſili ouata folio florali breuiori approximata.
locality: H. ad vias et aggeres foſſarum an der Pfingſtwieſe bey Gnadau , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: ſpica maſcula oblonga, femineis ſeſſilibus oblongis; inferiore foliolo proprio breuiore.
locality: H. trans Salam gegen Breitenhagen .

morphology: ſpicis pendulis, pedunculis geminatis.
locality: H. in paludoſis beym Teiche hinter Badez .

morphology: ſpicis erectis cylindricis ternis ſubſeſſilibus; maſcula terminali, culmo triquetro.
locality: H. ad foſſam gegen Zeiz auf dem Wege nach Salze .
additional information: Deſcriptio Fl. Suec. 2. p. 333.

morphology: ſpicis remotiſſimis ſubſeſſilibus, bractea vaginali, capſulis angulatis mucronatis.
locality: H. ad foſſas um die Pfingſtwieſe bey Gnadau .
additional information: A C. caeſpitosa differt ſpicis longe diſtantibus, breuiter pedunculatis, nec nutantibus; capſulis acuminatis; ſquama calycina acuta.

morphology: ſpicis maſculis pluribus, femineis ſubſeſſilibus, capſulis obtuſiuſculis.
locality: H. in foſſis bey der Böſener Mark , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: In pratis ſiccis vncialis, in aquoſis ſaepe tripedalis euadit polymorpha planta.

morphology: ſpicis maſculis pluribus, femineis pedunculatis, capſulis inflatis acuminatis.
locality: H. ad foſſas bey Cyprena , et alibi.
additional information: Varietas β. Gramen cyperoides ſyluarum tenuius ſpicatum RAII , etiam occurrit ad foſſas paſſim.

morphology: ſpicis remotis, maſculis pluribus, femineis ſubpedunculatis erectis, capſulis hirtis.
locality: H. auf dem Anger , et alibi, copioſe .
additional information: Pubeſcunt folia, ſpicae maſculae et capſulae. Spicae | maſculae ſaepius tres ſunt, feminea valde remota, erecta, pedunculata. Carices omnes in aetate tenera pecoribus pabulo, ſi aliud non ſuppetat, eſſe poſſunt. Si autem adoleuerint, a pecoribus comedi nequeunt, iisque ſunt noxiae; hinc e pratis, si fieri poteſt, eradicandae. Schreb.

morphology: foliis erectis triquetris.
locality: H. in foſſis et ſtagnis vbique .

morphology: fol. ſubenſiformibus, ſpica maſcula femineaque approximatis.
locality: H. in foſſis vom Weinberge nach Pömelte zu; et alibi.
additional information: Spathae a deciduae, altera ad ſpicae maſculae baſin, altera ad eius medium.

morphology: fol. ſemicylindricis, ſpica maſcula femineaque remotis.
locality: H. in ſtagnis vor der kleinen Weidenallee ; in den Pröbsſümpfen , et alibi; frequentior, quam praecedens .
additional information: Foliis vtuntur vietores ad doliorum circulos firmandos. Pappus typharum loco plumarum a pauperibus immittitur puluinaribus.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis ouatis ſerratis, amentis fructiferis globoſis.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe , rarius.
additional information: Offic. VRTICAE ROMANAE ſemen. Vim diureticam habet. Ad ſanguinis fluxus ſiſtendos praedicatur.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis oualibus.
locality: H. in cultis vbique .
additional information: Recens conſciſſa pullis meleagridum in cibo datur. Recipitur etiam primo vere in iuſcula, aut pani butyro illito immittitur. Contra phthiſin a nonnullis extollitur. Stupenda ſtructura plantae, qua pungat et vrat, oculo armato inſpicienda. Linn.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis cordatis, racemis geminis.
locality: H. in ruderatis vulgaris .
additional information: Offic. VRTICAE MAIORIS Radix, Herba, Semina. Et haec primo vere coquitur et editur. Ouibus ſalutaris exiſtimatur. Adſtringens eſt in mictu cruento, haemoptyſi et haemorrhagiis ſcorbuticis, dum ad aliquot vncias ſuccus bibendus datur. Vog. Schaefferus papyrum e cortice conficere docuit.

morphology: fol. ouatis acuminatis ſerratis.
locality: H. im Zeizer Buſche ; trans Albim frequentius.
additional information: Offic. BETULAE ſuccus. Cortice primo vere, antequam folia proueniant, inciſo, hic ſuccus profluit, et eſt contra calculum, ſcabiem, ſcorbutum. Vſitata, praeſtans. Linn. Lignum ad varia inſtrumenta ruſtica vtiliſſimum.

morphology: pedunculis ramoſis.
locality: H. cis Albim beym Gnez , et alibi, infrequens; trans Albim paſſim copioſe.
additional information: Offic. ALNI Folia, Cortex. Folia vlceribus tibiarum et fonticulis prurientibus maximo cum fructu imponi dicuntur. Vog. Lignum pro fornace minoris pretii, ſed ſub aqua perenne; hinc, vbi ſub aqua fundamenta pro aedificiis conſtruenda, et in ſimilibus caſibus, vtiliſſimum. Carbones ſunt ad puluerem pyrium.

morphology: caule inermi, fol. cordatis trineruatis.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe ; am Stadtgraben gegen Gethſemane ; et alibi in ruderatis humidiuſculis .
additional information: Offic. XANTHII Semina. Succus laudatur ad ſcrophulas et ad depurandum ſanguinem. Vog. Semen intus ſumtum in Eryſipelate tamquam arcanum habetur. Linn.

morphology: glomerulis lateralibus, floribus trifidis, fol. ouatis, retuſis; caule diffuſo.
locality: H. inter olera in hortis et cultis frequens .

morphology: fol. ſagittatis acutis.
locality: H. in foſſis auf dem Anger , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Chinenſes Sagittariam ſerunt, vt bulbum radicis pro culina obtineant, quem copioſe edunt. Linn.

morphology: flor. maſculis interrupte ſpicatis.
locality: H. in foſſis et piſcinis von Colphus nach Cyprena , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Spica aphylla.

morphology: flor. omnibus verticillatis hermaphroditis.
locality: H. cum praecedente, paſſim .
additional information: Folia quaterna.

morphology: fol. dichotomo-bigeminis, fruct. triſpinoſis.
locality: H. im Graben gegen Cyprena , et alibi in ſtagnis ſub aqua, frequens .

morphology: fol. dichotomo-trigeminis, fructibus muticis.
locality: H. in foſſis gegen Badez .
additional information: Fructus glabri. Planta minor et tenerior, quam praecedens: folia etiam minora.

morphology: inerme, caulibus ſubanguloſis.
locality: H. inter olera in hortis noſtris, paſſim ; forſan olim ſata.
additional information: Offic. PIMPINELLAE MINORIS ſ. SANGVISORBAE Herba, Semina. Vis adſtringens, vulneraria. Ad plantas pertinet, quae in iuſculis frequenter comeduntur.

morphology: fol. ouatis obſolete ſerratis.
locality: H. apud nos culta im Herzogsgarten ; trans Albim paſſim vaſtas ſyluas conſtituens .
additional information: Offic. FAGI Fructus. Vis temulentans, cephalalgica. Exoleta, infida. Linn. Arbor topiaria pro ſepibus. Glandibus pingueſcunt ſues lardo laxo.

morphology: fol. deciduis oblongis ſuperne latioribus, ſinubus acutioribus, angulis obtuſis.
locality: H. vbique, et noſtras praecipue conſtituit ſyluas .
additional information: Offic. QVERCVS Cortex, Folia, Glandes, Cupulae. Glandes ad ſodam efficaces ſunt. Decoctum ore exceptum odontalgiam ſedat. Vog. Trita, praeſtans. Linn. Glandibus ſues pingueſcunt. Ligni vſus notiſſimus.

morphology: ſtipulis ouatis obtuſis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. CORYLI Lignum, Nuces. Nucum oleum anodynum eſt, et calculoſis hominibus ob vim lenientem ſalutare. Vog. Carbones ad delineationes pictorum, ſculptorum, aurifabrorum vſurpantur.

morphology: ſquamis ſtrobilorum planis.
locality: H. culta hinter dem Gnez ; auf Ranies , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Arbor topiaria pro ſepibus. Lignum album tenaciſſimum, pondera ſuſtinet immenſa. Cortex interior lanas luteo colore inficit. Linn.

morphology: fol. geminis; primordialibus ſolitariis glabris.
locality: H. trans Albim bey Friederikenberg , et alibi, ſyluas conſtituens .
additional information: Offic. PINI Turiones ſ. Summitates, Reſina. Summitates ſcorbuticos humores corrigunt; dolores articulorum et rheumaticos curant: decoctae ex cereuiſia vel vino potantur. Vog. Trita, praeſtans. Linn. Arbor ſicca amans, longaeua ad 400 annos; ad domos, aſſeres, ciſtas, et alia, praeſtans.

morphology: fol. ſolitariis emarginatis.
locality: H. trans Albim in ſyluis Serueſtanis.
additional information: Inter tres noſtrates haec ſpecies elegantiſſima, ob folia ſaturate viridia horizontaliter diſpoſita, ramificationes | regulares, et truncum ſtrictum albicantem. Sed lignum eius pro fornace ex his tribus eſt minimi pretii. Terebinthinam communem fundunt tres noſtrae Pini ſpecies; optimam tamen et copioſiſſimam haec P. Picea ex veſiculis in trunco ſub cortice inueniendis et cultro incidendis. Vog.

morphology: fol. ſolitariis ſubulatis mucronatis laeuibus bifariam verſis.
locality: H. im Gnez und im Schloßgarten plantata; trans Albim bey Friederikenberg paſſim.
additional information: Offic. ABIETIS Reſina. Spiritus e tenellis frondibus ſuccedaneum Aquae reginae Hungaricae. Rarior, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: fol. palmatis vtrimque calloſo-ſcabris.
locality: H. in ſepibus im Schloßgarten ; gegen Gethſemane , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Offic. BRYONIAE Radix, Baccae, Semina. Radix purgante virtute ſatis forti praedita eſt, vt et reſoluente. Hinc ad hydropem, aſthmata et arthritidem conducit. Vog. Vnguentum externe in pleuritide ſolatium adfert. Vſitata, eximia, Linn.

morphology: fol. ſerratis glabris, flor. triandris.
locality: H. ad Salam et Albim frequens.

morphology: fol. ſerratis ouatis acutis glabris; ſerraturis cartilagineis, petiolis calloſo-punctatis.
locality: H. am Teiche im Paradiſe ; am Teiche bey der Lindenallee .
additional information: Squamae inter ſtamina flauae. Haec ſpecies hortulanis aptiſſima ad arbores alligandas, ob ramulorum eximiam tenacitatem.

morphology: fol. ſerratis glabris lanceolatis petiolatis, ſtipulis trapeziformibus.
locality: H. im Elbwerder , et alibi ad Albim , frequens.

morphology: fol. ſerratis glabris ouato-lanceolatis, petiolis dentato-glanduloſis.
locality: H. ad Albim paſſim; im Kuhwerder , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Haec ſpecies et S. alba ſunt maximae et in arbores vaſtas excreſcunt; cum reliquae ſpecies noſtrates humiliores et debiliores maneant. Hinc ambae frequenter plantantur pro lignis ad focum obtinendis: ſed S. alba praeferenda eſt.

morphology: fol. ſerratis glabris lanceolatis, inferioribus oppoſitis.
locality: H. am Elbdamme gegen den Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Rami ſaepe ſanguineo-corallini. Stipulae nullae. Folia inferiora ſuboppoſita.

morphology: fol. integris ouatis acutis ſupra ſubuilloſis, ſubtus tomentoſis.
locality: H. in paludoſis bey Friederikenberg , et alibi.

morphology: fol. integerrimis lanceolatis; ſubtus villoſis nitidis, ſtipulis ouatis acutis.
locality: H. in vliginoſis bey den Pretziener Feldern gegen Dornburg .

morphology: fol. integerrimis ouatis ſubtus pubeſcentibus.
locality: H. in arenoſis humidis gegen Dornburg .
additional information: Gemma vniualuis bipartita. Folia minima ſupra et amenta communiter nigreſcunt. Affines ſunt S. arenaria, incubacea, repens, fuſca.

morphology: fol. ouatis rugoſis ſubtus tomentoſis vndatis, ſuperne denticulatis.
locality: H. ad foſſas am Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Decoctum in cardialgia ſputatoria Lapponibus vſitatum. Linn.

morphology: fol. ſubintegerrimis lanceolato-linearibus longiſſimis acutis ſubtus ſericeis, ramis virgatis.
locality: H. ad Albim und im Kuhwerder , copioſiſſime.
additional information: Frutex cito creſcens. Rami ad corbes vſitatiſſimi.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis acuminatis ſerratis vtrimque pubeſcentibus; ſerraturis infimis glanduloſis.
locality: H. in ſalicetis vbique . Arbores duae, mas et femina, numquam amputatae et in paſcuo gegen das Fährhaus iuxta ſe poſitae, praecipue ſpectabiles.
additional information: Offic. SALICIS Folia, Cortex. Lappones in decocto corticis inueniunt remedium ad dolores colicos. Extractum corticis medii ad pulmones vlceratos commendatur. Vog. De cortice Salicis cortici Peruuiano ſubſtituendo duas diſſertationes edidit Iuſt. Guil. Günz, Lipſiae 1772.

morphology: fol. lanceolatis obtuſis, caule dichotomo, ſpicis axillaribus.
locality: H. in arboribus im Gnez , frequens.
additional information: Offic. VISCI QVERNI Lignum. Specificum contra epilepſiam habetur: datur in puluere frequenter et liberaliter, ſuperbibito ſimul decocto eiusdem calido. Loeſ. Vog. Rarior, praeſtans. Linn. Frutex ſingula- | ris paraſiticus absque radice, ſemperuirens, mare feminae oppoſito. Viſcus pro auibus capiendis ex baccis paratur.

locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi in ſepibus et dumetis, copioſiſſime .
additional information: Offic. LVPVLI Coni ſ. Strobili. Viſcera infarctu liberat, ſtomachum roborat, vermes expellit. Externe aduerſus tumores in ſacculis prodeſt. Vog. Vſus oeconomicus pro cereuiſia notus.

morphology: fol. ſubrotundis dentato-angulatis ſubtus tomentoſis.
locality: H. bey Cyprena ; bey der Böſener Mark ; frequens.
additional information: Folia a vento agitata, quia ſubtus ſunt albiſſima, praebent ſpectaculum, ac ſi arbor niue tecta eſſet.

morphology: fol. ſubrotundis dentato-angulatis vtrimque glabris.
locality: H. auf der alten Burg , et alibi, paſſim. Petioli apice compreſſi, vnde folia tremula. Lignum leuiſſimum, albiſſimum, ſub dio perenne. Cortex primarius eſt cibus Caſtorum. Linn.

morphology: fol. deltoidibus acuminatis ſerratis.
locality: H. hinter dem Gnez ; im Kuhwerder , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. POPVLI Gemmae ſ. Oculi. Gemmae ſunt odoratiſſimae et vere balſamicae. Si infunduntur in oleo amygdalarum dulcium vel lini, ſiſtunt balſamum traumaticum interne et externe ſalutare. Vog. Arbor ſeſtinans; hinc nuper eius varietas ramis coarctatis erectis ob celerius incrementum formamque venuſtam iunceam in ſcriptis oeconomicis ad ſaliceta plantanda ſub nomine Populi Italicae admodum commendata. Differentiam enim ſpecificam inter noſtram Populum et inter ita dictam Populum Italicam aliunde huc transplantatam non video.

locality: H. in ſtagnis bey der alten Burg ; in foſſis gegen die Poleymühle .

morphology: fol. ternis patentibus mucronatis, bacca longioribus.
locality: H. ad murum im Schloßgarten ; caeterum in noſtris regionibus rara arbor .
additional information: Offic. IVNIPERI Baccae, Lignum. Baccae calefaciunt, roborant, vrinam pellunt; in arthriticis et ſcorbuticis maxime ſalutares. Baccae ſecundo anno demum maturant, turdis grata eſca. Praebent etiam, vt ipſum lignum, gratum ſuffimentum. Trita, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: glumis bifloris villoſis; floſculo hermaphrodito mutico; maſculo ariſta recurua.
locality: H. an der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Gramen molliſſimum et fere holoſericeum. Ab ouibus libenter comeditur, hinc in illarum vſum colimeretur. Schreb.

morphology: flor. maſculis quadrifidis, pedunc. diphyllis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi in dumetis, copioſe .
additional information: Dicitur eſſe vulneraria et adſtringens, et optime conducere in herniis, ſi folia eius decocta externe forma cataplaſmatis adhibeantur. Boerh.

morphology: fol. lobatis obtuſis emarginatis.
locality: H. in ſepibus im Schloßgarten ; trans Albim in ſylua gegen Tochheim copioſe.

morphology: fol. lanceolato-ouatis, pedunculis dichotomis, calycibus diphyllis.
locality: H. ad muros im Schloßgarten zwiſchen der Fichtenhecke; an der Stadtmauer gegen Gethſemane ; copioſe.
additional information: Offic. PARIETARIAE Herba. Eſt inter herbas quinque emollientes. Sanguinem in partibus contuſis reſoluit; diureſin monet et renum morbis maxime appropriata eſt. In clyſteribus aluum laxat. Vog.

morphology: caule herbaceo, fol. incanis ſerratis, fructibus quadrangularibus dentatis. Atriplex ſylueſtris fructu roſeo compreſſo. Rupp. Ien. p. 341.
locality: H. am Stadtgraben gegen Gethſemane ; ad muros bey Pömelte , copioſe.

morphology: caule herbaceo, calycis valuulis femineis magnis deltoidibus ſinuatis.
locality: H. in dumetis am Gnez ; am Damme hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Rami patentes, infimi procumbentes; folia viridia.

morphology: caule herbaceo patulo, fol. ſubdeltoideo-lanceolatis, calycibus feminum diſco dentatis.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee , et alibi in cultis et ruderatis vbigue .

morphology: fol. ſerratis, flor. apetalis.
locality: H. im Trizer Buſche ; auch beym Weinberg .
additional information: Offic. FRAXINI Lignum, Cortex, Folia; Semina ſ. Lingua auis. Semen eſt aperitiuum, diureticum et antipleuriticum. Lignum cum cortice roborat et reſoluit. Vog. Arbores aliae hermaphroditae; aliae etiam feminae ſunt. Lignum tenax, durum, ad inſtrumenta ruſtica vtiliſſimum. Cito creſcit in loco apto; hinc etiam a noſtris hodie diligenter colitur.

morphology: caule ſpicato, frondibus compoſitis.
locality: H. in nemoribus an der Saale ; auch hinter Kleinroſenburg , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Equis primarium inter omnes plantas pabulum Iemtiis. Linn.

morphology: ſcapo fructificante nudo; ſterili frondoſo.
locality: H. hinter dem Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Offic. EQUISETI Herba. Decoctum in aqua vel cereuiſia remedium eſt in nephritide calculoſa. Vog. Pollen quam primum e ſpica excutitur, ſaltat ac ſi viueret. Exoleta, eximia. Linn.

morphology: caule angulato frondibus ſimplicibus.
locality: H. in aquoſis unterhalb Gödniz , et alibi, paſſim.

morphology: caule ſtriato, frondibus ſubſimplicibus.
locality: H. ad ſtagna gegen Dornburg , et alibi.
additional information: Diſſecatur in pabulum boum, vt vaccae lac copioſius praebeant. Equis minus acceptum. Linn. Caules floriferi a ſterilibus diſtincti, vt E. aruenſis. Hall.

morphology: caule ſubnudo laeui.
locality: H. ad ſtagna ſyluatica hinter der Poleymühle , et alibi.
additional information: Praecedenti nimis affine.

morphology: caule nudo ſcabro baſi ſubramoſo.
locality: H. ad ſtagna hinter Monplaiſir , et alibi.
additional information: Caulis viridis, ſcaber, radens. Vaginae articulorum pallidae, baſi margineque atris, denticulis obſoletis. Equis ſalutare; vaccis noxium. Linn. Opifices eo vtuntur ad perpolienda ſua opera.

morphology: ſcapo caulino ſolitario, fronde pinnata ſolitaria.
locality: H. in ſiccis auf der Pfingſtwieſe bey Gnadau .
additional information: Flores noctu odorati. Planta gaudet vi temperante. Alchymici de eius viribus multa fabulantur. Gled.

morphology: frondibus lanceolatis pinnatifidis, laciniis confluentibus integerrimis parallelis.
locality: H. trans Albim in ſyluaticis zwiſchen Gödniz und Dornburg , rarius.
additional information: Frondes fertiles multo ſterilibus anguſtiores ſunt. Cereuiſiae immitti ſolet cum emolumento ſanitatis. Rupp. Ien. p. 346.

morphology: frond. bipinnatis, pinnis obtuſis crenulatis, ſtipite paleaceo.
locality: H. ad muros im Schloßgarten bey der Prinzeß ; in ſyluaticis trans Albim bey Friederikenberg , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Offic. FILICIS Radix, Herba. In cataplaſmate herba cocta vlceribus vetuſtis vtiliſſime imponitur. Radix in obſtructionibus viſcerum cum atonia iunctis, multis ſalutaris viſa eſt. Huius et ſubſequentis plantae cineres ad fictilia Chinenſium paranda recipiuntur. Cinis aqua ſubbactus, in globulos formatus, deinceps ſiccatus lotricibus loco ſaponis inſeruit. Vog. Flores reniformes.

morphology: fronde bipinnata; pinnulis lanceolatis pinnatisidis acutis.
locality: H. in alnetis hinter Walternienburg , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Flores ouati, ſubciliati, ſolitarii.

morphology: fronde bipinnata; pinnis pinnatifidis integerrimis, ſubtus vndique polline tectis. Acroſtichum Thelypteris. Sp. Pl. p. 1528. Mant. 2. p. 505.
locality: H. in alnetis vmbroſis am Wege hinter der Poleymühle .
additional information: Habitus P. Filicis maris. Stipes glaber. Pollen tegit totam paginam folii; ſed in tenellis frondibus per puncta diſtinctum.

morphology: frondibus pinnatis, pinnis ſubrotundis crenatis.
locality: H. an der Mauer des Schloſſes bey der Bibliothek , rarius.
additional information: Offic. ADIANTI RVBRI ſ. TRICHOMANIS Herba. Quoad virtutes medicas par cenſetur Adianto Capillo Veneris; ideo etiam inter ſic dictas herbas capillares cenſetur. In tuſſi, adſectibus pectoris et cal | culoſis, melancholia, ſuppreſſione vrinae interne adhibitum eſt cum ſucceſſu. Weis.

morphology: frondibus alternatim decompoſitis; foliolis cuneiformibus crenulatis.
locality: H. ad muros im Schloßgarten beym Altan .
additional information: Offic. RVTAE MVRARIAE Herba. Et hoc inter herbas capillares refertur. Viribus cum praecedente conuenit; ſed debilius eſt. Laudatur vt tonicum et pectorale medicamen. Weis.

vernacular name: Gemeine äſtige Flügelfaren; groß Farnkraut; Jeſus-Chriſt-Wurzel.
morphology: frond. ſupradecompoſitis; foliolis pinnatis, pinnis lanceolatis, infimis pinnatifidis, ſuperioribus minoribus.
locality: H. paullo extra term. Fl. Barb. trans Albim über Lindau ; ſaltim propius nondum inuenta .
additional information: Radix transuerſim oblique ſecta crucis, vel ſi manis, aquilae bicipitis imperialis, imaginem refert: hinc eſt nomen germanicum vltimum, et nomen triuiale Radicis variae virtutes medicae extolluntur; in primis contra vermes et ad obſtructiones viſcerum ſoluendas laudatur. Ad coria praeparanda haec planta etiam vſurpatur. Weis.

morphology: fol. oppoſitis ſimplicibus.
locality: H. in piſcina gleich hinter der Poleymühle .
additional information: Rami natantes. Folia bifaria, ouata, complicata, adſperſa ſupra glomerulis e filamentis 4, albis, apice cirroſis: inter radices globi 3-7, ſtylo inſtructi, poly | ſpermi. Mant. 2. p. 506. Rara planta Schreber. quondam Lipſiam transmiſſa, qui illam pro hac Marſilea agnouit.

morphology: fol. ſparſis filamentoſis, ſpicis teretibus peduncularis geminis.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Offic. MVSCI CLAVATI Herba. LYCOPODII Semen. Pollen ob inſignes virtutes medicas adhibetur externe adſperſum ad puerorum intertriginem, ad vulnera, ad papillarum fiſſuras: interne ad tabem, diarrhoeam, dyſenteriam, tormina puerorum. Eſt quoque frequens eius vſus ad pillulas gummoſas laeuigandas. Weis. Non madefit pollen aqua, nec fulgurat ad candelam, niſi depluens aut inſufflatum.

morphology: fol. bifariis connatis, ſuperficialibus ſolitariis, ſpicis geminis peduncularis.
locality: H. bey Zerbſt paſſim.

morphology: ramis deflexis.
locality: H. in humidis an der Nuthe gegen die Poleymühle , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Hoc replet ſtagna, vt demum tranſeant in paludes, paſcua et prata, conſtituendo foco aptum caeſpitem. Antherae diſſiliunt cum ſono et crepitu. Mant, 2. p. 506.

morphology: acaule, anthera ſeſſili, fol. ouatis acutis. Phaſcum (cuſpidatum) cauleſcens, foliis ouatis cuſpidatis patulis; ſummis erectis conniuentibus. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 72.
locality: H. in areis hortorum , im Paradiſe , et alibi.

morphology: acaule, anthera ſeſſili, foliis ſubulato-ſetaceis patulis. Phaſcum (ſubulatum) cauleſcens, foliis lanceolato-linearibus patulis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 71.
locality: H. ad aggeres hinter dem Gnez .

morphology: caule ſimplici, anthera parallele-pipeda. α. P. quadrangulare vulgare, yuccae foliis ſerratis; β. P. quadrangulare iuniperi foliis breuioribus et rigidioribus; γ. P. quadrangulare minus, iuniperi foliis piloſis; ſunt nomina Dilleniana, et habentur pro varietatibus.
locality: H. in alnetis hinter Walternienburg , et in aridis bey Friederikenberg , copioſe.
additional information: Offic. ADIANTI AVREI Herba. Cenſetur inter herbas capillares. Vis ipſi blande adſtringens et traumatica. Vulgus inter antimagica remedia refert. Vog. Exoleta, inutilis. Linn.

morphology: caule ramoſo, androgynum.
locality: H. in alneto hinter Walternienburg am Wege bey der Nuthe , copioſe.
additional information: Setae femineae ſunt breuiſſimae cum capitulis perfecte ſphaericis, paruis, puluere conſperſis, viridibus. Paullo poſt has ſetas eadem planta emittit ſetas capſuligeras vnciales, purpureas cum antheris oblongis, ſubnutantibus.

morphology: acaule, anthera nutante, calyptra reflexa tetragona.
locality: H. varietas maior et minor, in locis humidis im Paradiſe ; in der Gurgel ; etiam ad muros .

morphology: caule dichotomo; axillis pedunculiferis, anthera erecta, foliis carinatis. Bryum purpureum. Weis Cryptog. Gotting. p. 198.
locality: H. ad muros et in terra frequens .

morphology: foliis arefactione reuolutis. Hypnum cirratum. Weis Cryptog. Gott. p. 207. Bryum cirratum. foliis capillaceis congeſtis tortilibus, capſulis ouato-cylindraceis breuiſſime ciliatis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 78.
locality: H. in ſepimentis putridis an der Lindenallee , et ad muros .
additional information: Minutum ramoſum.

locality: H. in ſyluaticis vdis bey Friederikenberg .

morphology: antheris pendulis, foliis ouatis ſetiferis carinatis, pedunculis longiſſimis. Bryum capillare. Sp. Pl. p. 1586. Hypnum capillare. Weis Crypt. Gott. p. 206.
locality: H. ad muros hinter den Baraken gegen den Anger , et alibi.

morphology: calyptra villoſa. Polytrichum nanum, Aloës folio non ſerrato. Weis Crypt. p. 175. Var. β.
locality: H. ad aggeres arenoſos bey Friederikenberg .

morphology: pedunculis aggregatis, foliis patentibus pellucidis.
locality: H. in humidis ſyluaticis bey Friederikenberg , et alibi; β. etiam in der Lindenallee .
additional information: Hae quatuor varietates tamquam totidem Bryi ſpecies recenſentur a Schreber. Spic. Lipſ. p. 84. 85.

morphology: antheris sessilibus terminalibus, calyptra minima.
locality: H. in lapidibus am Elbdamme beym Gnez ; etiam ad truncos arborum .
additional information: Operculum coccineum.

morphology: antheris ſeſſilibus ſparſis, calyptris ſtriatis ſurſumue piloſis. Polytrichum bryoides. Weis Crypt. p.175.
locality: H. ad arbores im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe; etiam in muris paſſim .

morphology: antheris erectis ſphaericis.
locality: H. ad muros im Schloßgarten .
additional information: Caules vnciales; ſetae ſemunciales, pallide rubentes; capſulae globoſae.

morphology: antheris erectis obouatis, calyptra ſubulata, ſurculis acaulibus, fol. ouatis muticis.
locality: H. ad aggeres in der Gurgel hinter dem Gnez ; auch im Schloßgarten .

morphology: anthera erecta oblonga minori, calyptris laxis aequalibus.
locality: H. ad muros ſepimentorum hinter den Baraken gegen den Anger .
additional information: Extinctorium dictum ob calyptram, quae quaſi refert inſtrumentum, quo candelae cereae in templis exſtinguuntur.

morphology: antheris erectiuſculis, foliis piliferis recuruis. Hypnum rurale. Weis Crypt. p. 210.
locality: H. in tectis; in terra in der Lindenallee , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Tecta ſtraminea per ſaeculum incorrupta ſeruat. Linn.

morphology: antheris erectis, foliis piliferis rectiuſculis, ſurculis ſimplicibus caeſpitoſis.
locality: H. in muris im Schloßgarten und Paradiſe , et alibi, copiose.
additional information: Cum Bryo puluinato conuenit, a quo autem ſetis longioribus rectis differt.

morphology: antheris erectiuſculis, pedunculis aggregatis, foliis ſecundis recuruatis, caule declinato. Hypnum ſcoparium. Weis Crypt. p. 213.
locality: H. ad radices arborum im Buſche bey Friederikenberg , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: antheris erectiuſculis, pedunculis ſubſolitariis, foliis lanceolatis, carinatis, vndulatis patentibus ſerratis.
locality: H. in vmbroſis humidis ſyluaticis gegen die Poleymühle .

morphology: antheris erectis oblongis, pedunculis axillaribus, ſurculis in ſummitate craſſioribus. Mant. 2. p. 309. Bryum capſulis vrceolatis operculo longo obliquo, foliis lanceolatis tortilibus, cauliculis erectis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 78.
locality: H. in arenoſis hinter dem Gnez auf dem Anger , et alibi in hortorum areis, muris, et ad vias .

morphology: antheris erectis ſubrotundis, operculo mucronato.
locality: H. in campis humidis gegen den Gnez ; am Elbdamme hinter Monplaiſir ; et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Eſt e minimis muſcis. Tegit, teſte autopta Haſſelquiſtio, rudera Hieroſolymitana et muros: hinc per minutiſſimum Hyſſopum e pariete naſcentem, de quo(1 Reg. 4, 33.) Salomo diſſeruit, hunc muſcum intelligi, dubium vix videtur. Linn.

morphology: antheris erectis ouatis, foliis lanceolatis acuminatis imbricato-patulis.
locality: H. ad muros bey der Steinbuhne am Elbhafen , et alibi.
additional information: Exiguum valde, cauliculis vnius ad ſummum trium linearum longitudine.

morphology: antheris pendulis, ſurculis cylindricis imbricatis laeuibus.
locality: H. in muris an der Steinbuhne beym Elbhafen ; in ollis hortulanorum, et alibi, frequens .

morphology: antheris ſubrotundis, pedunculis reflexis, foliis piliferis.
locality: H. in muris, tegulis, et alibi, frequens .
additional information: Setae deorſum arcuatae incuruantur, vt capſulae paene inter folia abſcondantur.

morphology: antheris pendulis, foliis lanceolatis acuminato-ſetaceis, pedunculis longiſſimis. Hypnum caeſpiticium. Weis Crypt. p. 203.
locality: H. in muris beym Elbhafen , et alibi.
additional information: Setae vnciales, inferne purpureae, ſuperne luteae.

morphology: fronde ſimpliciſſima pinnata lanceolata, apice pedunculifera.
locality: H. in vmbroſis im Gnez ; auch in Gethſemane auf den Gartenbeeten , frequens.
additional information: Minutiſſimum inter Hypna, frondibus duarum triumue linearum longitudine. Pinnarum ſeptem aut octo paria.

morphology: fronde pinnata ramoſa, foliolis imbricatis acutis complicatis compreſſis.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum im Gnez , paſſim.
additional information: Foliola latiuſcula ſurſum conuexa, deorſum concaua, pallide viridia.

morphology: ſurculis ramoſis, frond. ſubpinnatis; foliis vndulatis planis.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum im Buſche bey Friederikenberg .

morphology: ramis vagis recuruis, foliis ouatis recuruatis patulis.
locality: H. am Graben im Schloßgarten ; im Gnez , copioſe.
additional information: ſed nondum flores vidimus. Haec ſpecies ob ſurculorum longitudinem et elaſticitatem ad vaſa vitrea atque murrhina inuoluenda et peregre transmittenda, ſimilesque vſus, adhiberi ſolet.

morphology: ramis vagis ſubrepentibus, foliis ouatis mucronatis imbricatis.
locality: H. ad muros et ſepes im Schloßgarten ; ad arbores im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Antherae ad modum rutabuli incuruatae.

morphology: ſurculis proliferis plano-pinnatis, pedunculis aggregatis.
locality: H. in gramineis im Schloßgarten ; in der Lindenallee ; im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Vna frons alterius medio ſeu diſco inſeritur ſaepius; vnde nomen triuiale.

morphology: ſurculis plano-pinnatis continuatis, pedunculis aggregatis.
locality: H. in humidis ſyluaticis bey Friederikenberg ; auch im Gnez .
additional information: Simile H. prolifero; ſed facies magis plana; cauliculi maiores; rami fasſiculati, conferti; pinnulae laxiores; folia magis diſtincta. Hoc in primis parietum rimae in aedificiis ligno exſtruendis replentur; vnde nomen triuiale.

morphology: ſurculis ſubpinnatis decumbentibus; ramulis remotis, foliis ouatis, antheris cernuis.
locality: H. in ligno putrido im Paradiſe ; et alibi in truncis arborum et in terra .
additional information: Surculi ad ſpithamae longitudinem et vltra excreſcunt, ſibi inuicem denſe inſtrati, coloris e pallido viridis. Folia parua, triangularia, pilo terminata adunco. Weis.

morphology: ſurculis pinnatis repentibus, ramis confertis, foliis imbricatis ſubulatis, antheris erectis.
locality: H. ad radices arborum im Gnez .
additional information: Setae ſemunciales, ſubrubentes ſ. fuſcae, copioſae. Folia ſub lente lanceolata, concaua, pilo breui tenui terminata.

morphology: ſurculis ſubpinnatis, foliis fecundis recuruis apice ſubulatis.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Surculi et rami peculiarem quamdam faciem planam catenulatam referunt ſuperne. Weis.

morphology: ſurculis erectiuſculo-ſubramoſis, foliis ſecundis recuruis ſubulatis, ramis recuruatis.
locality: H. ad foſſas hinter den Baraken .

morphology: ſurculis repentibus, ramis vagis teretibus, foliis patulis acuminatis.
locality: H. ad arborum truncos, praecipue vlmorum , im Gnez , copioſiſſime.
additional information: Cauliculi ſicci teretes et quaſi contorti apparent, foliis capillaceis, adpreſſis, quae irrigata expanſa ſunt. Color ex obſcuro viridis, luteſcens.

morphology: ramis vagis, foliis lanceolatis complicato-carinatis, quinquefariam recuruatis.
locality: H. in gramineis humidis im Schloßgarten ; in der Lindenallee ; im Gnez ; copioſe.
additional information: ; ſed flores nondum vidi. Quoad caulem purpureum et habitum foliorum multum conuenit cum H. triquetro. Sed caules magis erecti, minus ramoſi; folia vndique reflexa et cincinnata.

morphology: ſurculo erecto, ramis faſciculatis terminalibus ſimpliciuſculis, antheris erectis.
locality: H. in humidis alnetis hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle .
additional information: Arbuſculam eleganter refert.

morphology: furc. vagis teretibus, fol. ouatis acutis patulis, antheris pendulis.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum im Buſche bey Friederikenberg .

morphology: ſurculis pinnato-ſparſis ſubulatis, foliis ouatis obtuſis conniuentibus.
locality: H. in humidis ſyluaticis bey Gommern , und gegen die Poleymühle .
additional information: Longis, teretibus, nitentibus, ſubrectis ſurculis, puriſſimis ab omni ſqualore terrae, ſe diſtinguit.

morphology: ſurculis ramisque vagis teretibus erectiuſculis obtuſis.
locality: H. im Gnez , et alibi inter muſcos terreſtres, frequens .

morphology: ſurculis vagis, apice foliis conuolutis acuminato. β. Hypnum cuſpidatum inerme. Weis Crypt. p. 233.
locality: H. ad oras ſtagni hinter dem Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Ramulorum extremitates cuſpidatae leniter pungentes.

morphology: ſurculo repente, ramis confertis erectis, foliis ſubulatis, antheris erectis.
locality: H. ad arbores im Gnez und in der Lindenallee ; ad muros im Paradiſe , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: ſurculo repente, ramis confertis erectis, foliis ſubulatis, antheris ſubnutantibus.
locality: H. ad terram auf dem Anger , et alibi, frequens.

morphology: ſurculis repentibus, ramis filiformibus, foliis oblitteratis.
locality: H. in ſaxis am Elbdamme beym Gnez ; ad terram vdam et arborum truncos im Gnez , frequens.

additional information: Color ex obſcuro viridis, per aetatem e rubiginoſo fuſcus.

morphology: ſurculis ramoſiſſimis, ramis ſubulatis vtrimque attenuatis teretibus.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum im Gnez .
additional information: Surculi reptantes bi-tri-quadriunciales. Folia arcte imbricata in pilum terminata, e laete gramineo viridi ſplendentia. Weis.

morphology: capſulis oblongis in ſetis breuioribus. Dill. muſc. p. 331. tab. 42. fig. 65.
locality: H. ad radices arborum im Gnez ; etiam in ſaxis am Elbdamme .
additional information: Cauliculi repentes implicati. Setae capſuligerae ſemunciales, inferius purpureae, ſuperius luteae. Calyptrae conicae, longae, albidae. Folia minutiſſima, ſubulata, acuta; etiam in ſiccis patentiuſcula. Color e rufeſcente pallide viridis.

morphology: arboreum trichodes maius, cauliculis ramoſis. Dill. p. 331. tab. 42. fig. 66.
locality: H. ad truncos vel radices arborum, praecipue vlmorum , im Gnez , rarius.
additional information: Cauliculi ramoſiſſimi, ſuberecti, inferius rubiginoſi, ſuperius pallide virides, vnciales aut biunciales. Folia ſubulata, minuta, acuta; in ſiccis cauli adpreſſa. Setas capſuligeras nondum vidi.

morphology: ſurculis ramoſiſſimis, ramis incuruatis, apice gracileſcentibus, foliis ſecundis ouatis carinatis obtuſis, capſulis erectis cuſpidatis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 100.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum im Gnez , praeſertim in vlmis amputatis putreſcentibus, paſſim .
additional information: Deſcriptio videatur apud Schreberum l. c.

morphology: foliis complicato-carinatis trifariis acutis, antheris lateralibus.
locality: H. in foſſis zwiſchen Colphus und Cyprena .
additional information: Caules fibroſi purpurei dodrantales. Folia duas lineas longa, vnam lata. Infarctus muſcus inter caminum et parietem ligneum, incendium penetrare non ſinit. Coctus cum cereuiſia ſecundaria pro pediluuio in febre pectorali Dalis. Linn.

morphology: calyce communi decemfido.
locality: H. in vmbroſis beym Gartenhaus am Paradiſe ; auch im Schloßgarten in terra humida .
additional information: Virtute medica commendatur in decocto cum ſero lactis contra hepatis aliorumque viſcerum abdominalium obſtructiones. Weis.

morphology: frondibus ſimpliciter pinnatis, foliolis ouatis ſubciliatis.
locality: H. in vmbroſis im Gnez , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: , ſed rarius.

morphology: frondibus ſimpliciter pinnatis apice floriferis, foliolis bidentatis. I. (bidentata) ſurculis procumbentibus ramoſis, apicibus floriferis, foliis ouatis bicuſpidatis, ſtipulis lanceolatis quadridentatis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 104.
locality: H. in vmbroſis in terra im Gnez .
additional information: Foliorum apex ſemilunari ſectione in duos dentes acutos diuiſus.

morphology: frondibus ſimpliciter pinnatis medio floriferis, foliolis bidentatis. I. (bicuſpidata) ſurculis procumbentibus, foliis diſtichis quadratis bidentatis, ſtipulis nullis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 105.
locality: H. in aggeribus humidis inter muſcos im Trizer Buſche , et alibi.
additional information: Foliorum apex ad angulum acutum in duos dentes acutos diuiſus.

morphology: ſurculis repentibus, foliolis inferne auriculatis duplicato-imbricatis, ramis aequalibus.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum im Gnez , frequens.

morphology: ſurculis repentibus, foliolis inferne auriculatis duplicato-imbricatis, ramis apice latioribus.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum, praecipue vlmorum , im Gnez ; im Schloßgarten , et alibi.
additional information: Differt a I. complanata, cui valde ſimilis eſt, foliis minoribus, magis eleuatis, ſurculis ramoſioribus ſuperne dilatatis, colore obſcurius viridi.

morphology: foliis imbricatis ſerie duplici; ſuperioribus ſubrotundis conuexis obtuſis quadruplo maioribus.
locality: H. ad arbores im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Color in paullo adultis rubiginoſo-fuſcus. Foliola minuta arcte ſibi inuicem incumbentia, in ſuperficie ſuperiori admodum conuexa.

morphology: ſurculis procumbentibus ſubtus imbricatis, foliolis cordatis acutis.
locality: H. in corticibus vlmorum im Schloßgarten am Graben; im Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Surculi ſuberecti, longitudinem digiti aequantes. Rami patuli brachiati. Color ſaturate viridis.

morphology: acaulis, fronde oblonga ſinuata pingui.
locality: H. bey Zerbſt am Butterdamme .

morphology: acaulis, fronde lineari ramoſa; extremitatibus furcatis obtuſiuſculis.
locality: H. in corticibus pinorum bey der Mauer auſſen im Schloßgarten .
additional information: Minuta planta, cauliculis vix ad vncialem longitudinem protenſis.

morphology: frondibus obcordatis ciliatis.
locality: H. in aquis ſtagnantibus hinter Walternienburg gegen die Poleymühle , aquis innatans .
additional information: Viget vere. Frondes circa ſemunciales. Cilia rariora albida.

morphology: leproſus albicans, lineolis nigris ramoſis characteriformibus.
locality: H. in corticibus arborum , praeſertim Iuglandis regiae, im Gnez , et alibi. Perſiſtens.

morphology: leproſus flaueſcens, lineolis nigris mappam referens.
locality: H. in ſaxis praegrandibus in agris gegen Kleinlüps ; ad muros im Schloßgarten , rarius. Perſiſtens.

morphology: leproſus albus, tuberculis concoloribus hemiſphaericis. Mant. p. 132.
locality: H. in ſaxis paſſim; etiam in tiliis vetuſtis in der Lindenallee .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Tubercula maiuſcula.

morphology: leproſus albicans, lineolis ſimplicibus punctisque nigris confertis.
locality: H. in carpinis hinter dem Gnez ; etiam in malis et prunis iunioribus, copioſe .
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: leproſus cinereo-vireſcens, tuberculis atris.
locality: H. in truncis arborum paſſim .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Tubercula ſubgloboſa, magna, non nitida, diffracta intus rubra.

morphology: leproſus fuſcus, tuberculis atris.
locality: H. ad muros seminarii im botaniſchen Garten , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: leproſus candidus, tuberculis atris.
locality: H. an der Stadtmauer im Elbwerder . Perſiſtens. Ad tingendum colore rubro, ſcarlatino ſimili, vſurpari dicitur. Weis.

morphology: leproſus tuberculis nigris albo marginatis.
locality: H. in ſaxis an der Stadtmauer , paſſim.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Similis L. fuſco-atro; ſed tuberculis minoribus. Margo lichenis niger eſt.

morphology: leproſus albus, tuberculis albis farinaceis. Lichen (orbiculatus) cruſtaceus albicans, tuberculis albis farinaceis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 135.
locality: H. in fagis im Herzogsgarten frequens.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

locality: H. ad cortices carpinorum, malorum, prunorum, praecipue iuniorum , vor und hinter dem Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Ex commixtione huius et L. rugosi in dictarum arborum corticibus oriuntur maculae, mappas geographicas referentes. Lichen carpineus prouincias, et Lichen rugosus lineis suis nigris fluuios aut terminos repraesentat. Weis.

morphology: leproſus candidus, tuberculis incarnatis.
locality: H. in ericetis zwiſchen Tochheim und Friederikenberg .
additional information: Fungillus incarnatus minimus ab aliis nominatus eſt; quem etiam re vera repraeſentat.

morphology: cruſtaceus flauus, ſcutellis luteis.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Muſcum abradunt et ſebo immiſcent, vt candelas obtineant pulcre flauas pro diebus feſtis, ruſtici Smolandiae. Linn.

morphology: cruſtaceus exalbido-vireſcens, ſcutellis flaueſcentibus, margine albo.
locality: H. an der Stadtmauer im Paradiſe .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Colorem pulcrum rubrum more orocellae ex eo parant Weſtgothi. Linn.

morphology: cruſtaceus albicans, ſcutellis pallidis. Lichen (muralis) imbricatus flauo-vireſcens, ſcutellis concoloris demum luteſcentibus; margine pallido. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 130.
locality: H. in aſſeribus vetuſtis bey der Lindenallee ; in corticibus arborum, et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: cruſtaceus albicans, ſcutellis nigris; iunioribus vrceolatis cauis. α. L. ſubfuſcus ater; β. L. ſubfuſcus rufus; γ. L. ſubfuſcus luteus. Weis Cryptog. p. 49. 50.
locality: H. ad arbores et muros im Paradiſe , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: imbricatus, foliolis obſolete multifidis laeuibus albidis centrifugis, ſcutellis rufofuſcis.
locality: H. in columnis lapideis beym Altan im Schloßgarten , et alibi in ſaxis, frequens.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Progrediendo a centro ad peripheriam, ſenſim in medio deliqueſcendo, primo intuitu dignoſcitur. Linn.

morphology: imbricatus, foliolis ſinuatis ſcabris lacunoſis, ſcutellis badiis. Lichen laciniatus ſaxatilis. Weis Cryptog. p. 55.
locality: H. in ſaxis; etiam in ſepimentis vetuſtis et prunis antiquis im Gnez .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Offic. VSNEAE Herba. Ad haemorrhagias valere dicitur: ſed hanc virtutem cum tota gente communem habet. Vog. Inferpe nigricat. Tingit colore purpuraſcente. Exoleta, inutilis. Linn.

morphology: imbricatus, foliolis lobatis nitidis liuidis.
locality: H. in ſalicibus et in aliis arboribus iit dep Weidenallee und im Gnez , frequens; etiam ad ſaxa.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Peltae orbiculatae, eleuatae, membranaceae, vndique liberae. Colore fuſco-virenti diſtinguitur, praeſertim madefactus.

morphology: imbricatus, foliolis criſpis fuluis, peltis concoloribus fuluis.
locality: H. ad arbores, ſepimenta, muros, vbiquo. Perſiſtens.

morphology: imbricatus, laciniis obtuſis ſubinflatis. Lichen laciniatus phyſodes. Weis Crypt. p. 57.
locality: H. ad ſaxa; ad arbores im Gnez , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: imbricatus, foliolis oblongis laciniatis anguſtis cinereis, ſcutellis pullis.
locality: H. in ramis arborum vbique .
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: foliaceus erectiuſculus, laciniis linearibus ciliatis (viridibus acutis), ſcutellis peduncularis crenatis.
locality: H. in arboribus vbique .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Siccatus cineraſcit.

locality: H. in ſalicibus am Anger hinter den Baraken , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Praecedente longe minor. Siccus pariter ac humidus albus eſt. Scutella margine vix crenata.

morphology: foliaceus laciniatus obtuſus glaber; ſupra lacunoſus, ſubtus tomentoſus.
locality: H. extra term. Fl. Barb. in fagis über Lindau gegen Brands Heide , copioſe.
additional information: Offic. PVLMONARIAE ARBOREAE Herba. Adſtringit et ſiccat. Tuſſientibus et ictericis auxiliatur. Sibiriaci loco lupuli cereuiſiae incoquunt. Vog. Trita, praeſtans. Linn.

morphology: foliaceus decumbens furfuraceus, laciniis acutis, ſubtus lacunoſis atris.
locality: Brands Heide H. in ſepimentis vetuſtis hinter den Baraken , rarius.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: foliaceus erectus compreſſus ramoſus, verrucis marginalibus farinoſis.
locality: H. ad ſalices in der Weidenallee ; im Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Magnitudine foliorum ludit. Extremitates laciniarum a verrucis nodoſae apparent. Rubro colore tingit. Weis.

morphology: foliaceus rectus oblongus lanceolatus ſublaciniatus lacunoſus glaber, ſcutellis ſubpedunculatis.
locality: H. in tiliis et ſalicibus in den Alleen , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: foliaceus erectiuſculus lacunoſus, ſubtus tomentoſus albus.
locality: H. in prunis im Gnez , et alibi, copioſiſſime.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Rubro colore tingit. Variat figura, magnitudine et colore pro diuerſo loco natali et aetate. Puluis cyprius fertur ex foliis parari poſſe praeſtantiſſimus. Linn.

morphology: pallide viridis rugoſus, margine vndulatus.
locality: H. in arboribus im Gnez , et alibi; etiam in ſaxis paſſim .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Glauceſcente-luteus ſeu ſulphureus parum vireſcens; parum foliaceus, raro ſcutellas proferens.

morphology: coriaceus repens ouatus planus; ſubtus venoſus villoſus, peltis marginalibus horizontalibus.
locality: H. ad ſcrobes bey den Pröbsſümpfen , et alibi.
additional information: Folia ſemuncialia et vncialia, ſuperne ſubrotunda plana, inferne cunei inſtar decurrentia.

morphology: coriaceus repens lobatus obtuſus planus, verrucis ſparſis, pelta marginali adſcendente. Lichen caninus γ. aphthoſus. Weis Crypt. p. 80.
locality: H. in ſterilibus montoſis zwiſchen der Poleymühle und Tochheim .
additional information: Offic. MVSCI CVMATILIS Herba. Infuſum cum lacte infantibus aphthis laborantibus propinatur. Infuſum aquoſum purgat et vermes pellit Linn. Folia ſiccata ſunt glauca, virentia vero ſaturate viridia.

morphology: coriaceus repens lobatus obtuſus planus; ſubtus venoſus villoſus, pelta marginali adſcendente. Lichen caninus α. cinereus; β. rufeſcens. Weis Cryptog. p. 78. 79.
locality: H. α. ad terram im Schloßgarten am Graben ; β. in ſyluis gegen Tochheim .
additional information: Offic. MVSCI CANINI Herba. Vt ſpecificum contra morſum animalium rabidorum laudatus eſt. Folia quaſi farina cinerea ſunt tecta. Pelta marginalis brunnea, ſubtus laeuis et incarnata.

morphology: ſcyphifer ſimplex integerrimus, ſtipite cylindrico, tuberculis coccineis. Lichen pyxidatus f. cocciferus. Weis Crypt. p. 90.
locality: H. in ſepimentis putridis hortorum an der Lindenallee , et alibi.
additional information: Offic. MVSCI PYXIDATI Herba; Herba ignis. Commendatur infuſum ad tuſſim conuulſiuam. Vog.

morphology: ſcyphifer ſimplex crenulatus, tuberculis fuſcis. Lichen pyxidatus b. tuberculatus. Weis Crypt. p. 85.
locality: H. ad muros im Paradiſe , et alibi.

morphology: ſcyphifer ſimplex denticulatus, ſtipite cylindrico. Lichen pyxidatus e. fimbriatus. Weis Crypt. p. 88.
locality: H. ad ſepimenta vetuſta bey Gethſemane ; in glareoſis trans Salam oberhalb Großroſenburg .

morphology: ſcyphifer ramoſus denticulatus filiformis. Lichen pyxidatus h. gracilis. Weis Crypt. p. 93.
locality: H. in ericetis trans Albim gegen Friederikenberg , et alibi.

morphology: ſcyphifer ſimpliciuſculus ſubuentricoſus, calycibus integris. Lichen pyxidatus c. cornutus. Weis Cryptog. p. 86.
locality: H. in ſterilibus trans Albim zwiſchen der Poleymühle und Tochheim , et alibi.

morphology: fruticuloſus perforatus ramoſiſſimus, ramulis nutantibus.
locality: H. var. β. L. rangiferinus ſyluaticus in ſterilibus auf dem Anger zwiſchen dem Damme und Monplaiſir , et alibi trans Albim , copioſe.
additional information: Alpeſtris differt a ſyluatico, vt flos plenus a ſimplici. Ramificationes ad alas perforatae ſunt. Huic Licheni innititur oeconomia et ſalus totius Lapponiae; hoc enim hieme tota ſuſtentantur Rangiferi, Lapponum pecora. Linn. Etiam apud nos cerui hiemis tempore hunc lichenem, niue abraſa, comedere ſolent.

morphology: fruticuloſus perforatus, ramulis breuiſſimis acutis.
locality: H. in ſterilibus ſyluaticis zwiſchen der Poleymühle und Tochheim .
additional information: Caules longitudine vix pollicari, ſubnudi, candicantes.

morphology: fruticuloſus ſubdichotomus, ramis ſimplicibus ſubulatis.
locality: H. cum praecedente und gegen Friederikenberg .

morphology: filamentoſus pendulus ſubarticulatus, ramis patentibus.
locality: H. extra term. Fl. Barb. in Brands Heide .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Cauliculi ad ſemipedalem longitudinem et vltra protenſi alte dependent ex arboribus. Si aliquamdiu in aqua maceratur, rubrum accipit colorem, vel aurantiacum: hinc in Penſyluania, referente Dillenio, pro tingendo colore aurantiaco vſurpatur. Weis.

morphology: filamentoſus pendulus, axillis compreſſis. Vſnea iubata nigricans Dillenii.
locality: H. cum praecedente.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: filamentoſus ramoſus diuaricatus decumbens implicato-flexuoſus.
locality: H. in ſepimentis vetuſtis hinter den Baraken ; rariſſime.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: filamentoſus ramoſiſſimus erectus, tuberculis farinaceis ſparſis.
locality: H. in ſepimentis vetuſtis; in arboribus im Gnez , et alibi, copioſe.
additional information: Perſiſtens. In decocto ad firmandos pilos facere dicitur. Weis.

morphology: filamentis plumoſis natantibus. Byſſus latiſſima papyri inſtar ſuper aquam expanſa. Dill.
locality: H. in ſtagnis bey der Gurgel hinter dem Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: In exſiccatis alba euadit. Secundum Weiſium Cryptog. p. 19. non pertinet ad viuas plantas, ſed eſt collecta materia e particulis putredine deſtructarum plantarum aquaticarum.

morphology: capillacea viridis, filamentis ramoſis.
locality: H. ad foſſas exſiccatas am Gnez , et alibi.

morphology: puluerulenta atra. Lichen antiquitatis. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ p . 138.
locality: H. an der Stadtmauer im Paradiſe , frequens.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: puluerulenta cinerea rupes operiens.
locality: H. an den Bildſäulen im Schloßgarten ; am Schloſſe ſelbſt; et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: puluerulenta flaua lignis adnaſcens. Lichen flauus. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 139.
locality: H. in ſepimentis vetuſtis bey der Lindenallee ; in corticibus arborum im Gnez ; et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens.

morphology: puluerulenta viridis. Tremella botryoides. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 141.
locality: H. in ſalicibus cauis in der kleinen Weidenallee ; in ollis hortulanorum; et alibi .
additional information: Viget aeſtate et auctumno.

morphology: puluerulenta incana, farinae inſtar ſtrata. Lichen incanus. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 139.
locality: H. ad foſſas am Anger gegen Colphus ; et alibi.
additional information: Viget auctumno et hieme.

morphology: puluerulento-cruſtacea albiſſima. Lichen lacteus. Schreb. Spic. Lipſ. p. 139.
locality: B. in corticibus praeſertim prunorum , im Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Viget hieme.

morphology: ſeſſilis membranacea auriformis fulua.
locality: H. in editis ſiccis von Dornburg nach Gommern hin.
additional information: Viget Aprili. Membranacea gelatinoſa, luteſcente-virens. Siccata fragilis, nigricans. Mant. p. 508.

morphology: plicata vndulata.
locality: H. ad terram auf dem Anger hinter der Gurgel an der Elbe , vbi poſt tempus plunioſum menſe Decembri copioſe vigebat; auch im Schloßgarten in den Gängen beym Graben .
additional information: Viget praecipue vere et aeſtate. Folio conſtat, quod radices non habet, ſed tantum terrae impoſitum eſt. Color ſordide vireſcens, et in ſtatu ſicco nigricans. Vires medicae praeſtantes ei tribuuntur. Vulneraria et anodyna virtute pollere dicitur, et intus aſſumta, ſiue in puluere ſiue in aqua deſtillata, dolores arthriticos in primis ſedare. In ſpiritu vini infuſa et huius potatoribus clam propinata efficit, vt hunc ſpiritum faſtidiant. Vog.

morphology: ſubgloboſa ſeſſilis ſolitaria glabra.
locality: H. in ramis emortuis et moribundis in der Lindenallee ; im Schloßgarten ; et alibi.
additional information: Viget hieme. Excludenda, ſecundum Weiſium Crypt. p. 30. ex hocce genere, et pro initio agarici cuiusdam habenda.

morphology: tubuloſa ſimplex.
locality: H. in foſſis et ſtagnis bey der Gurgel hinter dem Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Viget aeſtate. Ad longitudinem vlnarem et craſſitiem pollicarem accreſcit.

morphology: globoſa farcta viridis. V. ſphaerica aggregata. Sp. Pl. 2. p. 1633. Tremella globoſa. Weis Crypt. p. 28.
locality: H. am Elbdamme beym Gnez .
additional information: Viget hieme et veris initio. | Veſiculis conſtat viridibus diuerſae magnitudinis, ad piſi vsque magnitudinem peruenientibus.

morphology: filamentis ſimpliciſſimis aequalibus longiſſimis.
locality: H. in foſſis et ſtagnis bey Cyprena ; auch im Graben des Schloßgarten , et alibi.
additional information: Viget a vere in auctumnum. Vulneratas partes glutinare dicitur et oſſa fracta mirabili celeritate, ſi ipſis imponatur et arefacta aqua ſubinde humidetur. Vog.

morphology: filamentis aequalibus ramoſis, bullas aëreas includentibus.
locality: H. in ſtagnis et foſſis gegen Gelinde , et alibi.
additional information: Viget aeſtate. Poſt inundationes nonnumquam prata obducit, et ſub forma ſtupae tenerae exſiccatur, quae veſtibus faciendis inferuire poteſt. Sed in Thuringia quondam hoc experimento facto, ii qui eiusmodi veſtimentis vſi ſunt, in faeuos inciderunt dolores articulares. Weis.

morphology: filamentis aequalibus ramoſis, exſiccatione coëuntibus in aculeos.
locality: H. in foſſis et vdis, vbi aquae viciſſitudines ſeruant , in der Gurgel , et alibi.
additional information: Viget aeſtate.

morphology: filamentis reticulato-coadunatis.
locality: H. in ſtagnis gegen Dornburg .
additional information: Viget aeſtate. Areolae 5- et 6-angulares plerumque ſunt. Color etiam in ſiccitate viridis. Forte generis proprii planta, vt Schreberus in litteris ad me datis adnotat, cuius ſingula indiuidua ſunt ſacculi cylindracei, reticulati, e filis breuiſſimis in figuras pentagonas vel hexagonas digeſtis compoſiti. Pulcra plantulae fabrica.

morphology: ſtipitatus, lamellis ramoſis decurrentibus.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Septembri. Eſculentus; Gleditſchio tamen ſuſpectus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo ſubflaueſcente partito, lamellis albidioribus interne dentato-connexis.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee .
additional information: Aeſtate.

morphology: ſtipitatus, lamellis dimidiatis ſolitariis, ſtipite voluato; apice dilatato, baſi ouata.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg , et alibi.
additional information: Septembri. Variat pileo albo, rubro, coccineo et verrucoſo. Cum lacte muſcas occidit. Liquamen e contuſo fungo parietibus lectoque inunctum expellit cimices. Linn.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo conuexo, lamellis baſi mucrone dentatis.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee ; am Damme gegen Gelinde .
additional information: Auctumno. Pileus flaueſcens, ſubuiſcidus. Lamellae baſi a ſtipite diſcedentes, vbi denticulo acuminato inſtructae. Confertim naſcitur.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo teſtaceo, ſucco luteſcente.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg , frequens.
additional information: Auctumno. Eſculentus inter optimos.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo conuexo ſquamato albido, lamellis rufis.
locality: H. auf dem Anger bey der groſſen Weidenallee , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Eſculentus inter primarios.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo flauo conuexo, lamellis albis.
locality: H. auf dem Anger .
additional information: Maio. Eſculentus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo ſordide flauo, lamellis luteo-rufis.
locality: H. bey Tochheim ; auch bey Gethſemane am Wege nach der Stadt .
additional information: Auctumno. Eſculentus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo conuexo acuminato griſeo, lamellis conuexis griſeis crenatis, ſtipite nudo.
locality: H. in pomariis an der Lindenallee , et alibi.
additional information: Octobri, Nouembri.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo hemiſphaerico viſcido acuminato lamellis albis, ſtipite longo cylindrico albo.
locality: H. in gramineis an der Lindenallee .
additional information: Auctumno.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo campaniformi albido lacero, lamellis niueis, ſtipite ſubbulboſo ſubulato nudo.
locality: H. auf dem Schloßhofe , et alibi.
additional information: Aeſtate.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo campanulato lacero, lamellis nigris lateraliter flexuoſis, ſtipite fiſtuloſo.
locality: H. in ſtercoratis beym Weinberge , et alibi.
additional information: Pernicioſus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo campanulato ſtriato pellucido, lamellis adſcendentibus, ſtipite nudo.
locality: H. inter olera im Paradiſe , et alibi.
additional information: Lamellae cinereae ſ. atrae. Stipes nudus longiſſimus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo laeui liuido, lamellis nigricantibus ſeparatis, ſtipite bulboſo voluato.
locality: H. in der Lindenallee .
additional information: Lamellae baſi a ſtipite diſtinctae. Stipes longus cylindricus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo conuexo viſcido pellucido lamellisque luteis, ſtipite nudo.
locality: H. am Wege im Elbwerder ; etiam ad arbores .
additional information: Auctumno.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo plicato membranaceo, lamellis baſi latioribus.
locality: H. inter muſcos im Trizer Buſche ; am Graben beym Gnez , et alibi.
additional information: Octobri Minutus.

morphology: ſtipitatus albus, pileo plicato membranaceo, ſtipite nigro. Ammanita minima muſcoſa Dillenii.
locality: H. im Schloßgarten auſſen bey den Fichten am Elbhafen , et alibi.
additional information: Octobri, Nouembri. Stipes capillaris. Lamellae tenuiſſimae. Minutus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo luteo conuexo ſtriato, lamellis ſtipiteque albis.
locality: H. inter folia deiecta im Gnez .
additional information: Nouembri, Decembri. Pileus in noſtro flauus. Statura in minoribus clauum repraeſentat.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo ſemiouato ſordido margine inflexo, lamellis fuſcis, ſtipite attenuato ſordido. Leyſ. Hall. p. 217. Linn. Fl. Suec. 2. p. 446. n. 1217.
locality: H. auf dem Anger gegen Colphus .
additional information: Auctumno.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo concauo infundibuliformi e nigricante fuſco. Leyſ. Hall. p. 217.
locality: H. am Wege von den Baraken nach dem Anger .
additional information: Nouembri.

morphology: acaulis, lamellis labyrinthiformibus.
locality: H. in lignis putreſcentibus hortorum an der Lindenallee , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Hic eſt praecipue, qui in domibus humidis ligna inueſtit illorumque corruptionem promouet.

morphology: acaulis coriaceus villoſus; margine obtuſo, lamellis ramoſis anaſtomoſantibus. Ein rauher weiſſer geſtreifter und ſchuppenartig wachſender Baumſchwamm, ſonder Stiel, von Geſtalt einer Kammmuſchel. Gled.
locality: H. in truncis betularum aliarumque arborum bey Friederikenberg , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Vix carnoſus et fere coriaceus, zonis variis magis villoſis, aliisque interiectis magis glabris. Lamellae firmae, rarius inter ſe conuexae.

morphology: acaulis, lamellis bifidis puluerulentis.
locality: H. in alnis an der Nuthe hinter Walternienburg .
additional information: Vere. Minor; plures imbricatim creſcentes.

morphology: acaulis puluinatus albus laeuis, poris acutis difformibus.
locality: H. ad truncos alnorum hinter Walternienburg .
additional information: Perſiſtens. Coriaceo-conuexus, villoſus, albus. Pori rotundi flexuoſique. Inſeruit loco ſuberis. Linn.

morphology: acaulis puluinatus inaequalis obtuſus, poris teretibus aequalibus glaucis.
locality: H. ad ſalices in der kleinen Weidenallee , et alibi, paſſim.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Facies pedis equini. Supra albus, vix villoſus. Inſeruit pro fomite. Linn.

morphology: acaulis puluinatus laeuis, poris tenuiſſimis.
locality: H. in ſalicibus et aliis arboribus im Gnez , et alibi, frequens.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Agaricus pedis equini facie. Tournef. Ex hoc maxime fomes paratur.

morphology: acaulis, faſciis diſcoloribus, poris albis.
locality: H. ad truncos arborum antiquarum im Trizer Buſche ; in der Weidenallee ; in lignis ſepoſitis bey der Bleichſchenke , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Pori ſubtus, etiam oculo armato, ſaepius vix apparent, ſed potius ſuperſides glabra lurida. Faſciae ſupra ſunt hirſutae. In ſtatu ſicco eſt coriaceus.

morphology: acaulis, ſuperne laeuis, ſalicinus.
locality: H. ad ſalices in der groſſen Weidenallee , et alibi.
additional information: Perſiſtens. Odore grato diſtinguitur. Colligitur et portatur a Lappis ad gratiam conciliandam. Inſeruit ad pellendos acaros inter veſtimenta repoſitus. Linn.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo puluinato viſcido, poris teretibus conuexis immerſis diſtinctis, ſtipite lacero.
locality: H. in truncis bey Gommern .
additional information: Auctumno.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo puluinato fubuiſcido, poris rotundatis conuexis flauiſſimis, ſtipite albido.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Auguſto. Eſculentus, ſed minoris pretii.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo glabro puluinato marginato, poris compoſitis acutis; porulis angulatis breuioribus. Var. α. Kuhpilz , quae in ſyluis ad notabilem magnitudinem excreſcere ſolet. Var. β. Judenpilz , quae non veſca. In fungo diffracto color flauus ex tempore in viridem mutatur. Var. γ. Herrnpilz; Steinpilz . Haec varietas in deliciis habetur.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Auguſto.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo viſcido puluinato, poris teretibus ſubangulatisque truncatis; angulo granulato.
locality: H. in terra ſubhumida in ſylua bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Auctumno. Stipes pileo breuior. Pileus margine acuto cinctus.

morphology: ſtipitatus, pileo albido, poris difformibus oblongo-flexuoſis niueis.
locality: H. in ſyluis paſſim in terra; etiam ad arbores im Gnez .
additional information: Auctumno. Magnus carnoſus albido-flaueſcens, nec glaber nec viſcidus, ſed ſubſquamoſus. Pileus, ſi ad truncos arborum creſcit, dimidiatus. Stipes breuis.

morphology: ſtipitatum, pileo plano-infundibuliformi.
locality: H. in ſylua bey Friederikenberg .
additional information: Auctumno. Pileus coriaceus fuſcus aut cinereus, tomentoſus, centro peruius. Aculei albi. Stipes fuſcus.

morphology: pileo ouato celluloſo, ſtipite nudo rugoſo.
locality: H. ad dumeta hinter Monplaiſir ; auch in der Vorderluke ; rarius.
additional information: Aprili, Maio. Hic ad cibos et iuſcula expetitur; hinc etiam ſiccatus ad ſeruatur et diuenditur.

morphology: campanulata lentifera.
locality: H. in ſepimentis putridis im Paradiſe ; in ciſtis et ollis hortulanorum, et alibi .
